izzyondroid:com.linkedcamera.app.summary: Privacy-focused camera with automatic Nextcloud sync for field work
izzyondroid:com.linkedcamera.app.description:
Linked Camera is a powerful, privacy-focused camera app designed for professionals who need seamless photo management in the field.
 KEY FEATURES
 Professional Camera Controls
 Manual focus, ISO, shutter speed, and white balance
 RAW (DNG) photo capture support
 Video recording with customizable quality
 Grid overlays and level indicator
 Geotagging with GPS coordinates
 Automatic Nextcloud Sync
 Instantly upload photos to your own Nextcloud server
 WiFi-only upload option to save mobile data
 Queue system for offline shooting - uploads when connected
 Progress notifications showing upload status
 Optional auto-delete after successful upload
 Privacy First
 No cloud accounts required - use YOUR server
 No analytics or tracking
 No ads, no in-app purchases
 Open source foundation (based on Open Camera)
 Your photos stay under your control
 Field Work Ready
 Works offline - queue photos for later upload
 Battery efficient background uploading
 Quick settings tiles for instant camera access
 Widget support for home screen shortcuts
 Bluetooth remote control support
 PERFECT FOR:
 Field researchers and surveyors
 Construction site documentation
 Real estate photography
 Insurance adjusters
 Anyone who needs organized photo workflows
 NEXTCLOUD SETUP (Simple!)
 Create a public share folder in Nextcloud with upload permissions
 Copy the share link to Linked Camera settings
 Start shooting - photos upload automatically!
 Linked Camera combines the powerful features of a professional camera app with seamless integration to your own cloud storage. Keep your photos organized and backed up without relying on third-party cloud services.
 Built upon the solid foundation of Open Camera by Mark Harman, Linked Camera extends the functionality with Nextcloud integration and field-optimized features.

Meet Gallery, your intelligent, lightweight, and lightning-fast photo and video gallery crafted with Jetpack Compose. Gallery loads images faster than Google Photos or any other gallery app out there. It is incredibly fast and uses very little device storage—just 3MBs—with almost no battery usage.  App Lock - Secure your media with PIN, Pattern, or Fingerprint. Choose when to lock: instantly, after 1 minute, or after 30 minutes.
 Favorites Album - Mark and access your favorite photos and videos in one place.
 Quick Share - Share multiple files instantly—no hard limits like 100 items.
 Built-in HD Video Player - Enjoy your videos without switching apps.
 Instant Media Updates - New files appear immediately—no manual refresh needed.

izzyondroid:dev.prathameshkhade.sysadmin.name: SysAdmin - Linux Server Management
izzyondroid:dev.prathameshkhade.sysadmin.summary: Linux server management in your pocket. Manage servers on the go via SSH!
izzyondroid:dev.prathameshkhade.sysadmin.description:
SysAdmin is an open-source mobile application that puts the power of Linux server administration in your pocket. Built with Flutter, it provides a sleek, intuitive GUI for managing your Linux servers on the go - no laptop required.
 "Command your servers, not your schedule. Admin anywhere, anytime." 
 Key Features:
 Dashboard - View server status, system metrics, and connection details at a glance
 SSH Manager - Store and manage multiple server connections securely
 User Management - Create, Update, Deletes or see information about users
 System Information - Detailed hardware information about your connected server
 Real-time System Resource Monitoring - Track CPU, RAM, and swap usage with graphs
 SFTP File Explorer - Browse, upload, download, and manage files with ease
 Schedule Jobs - Create one-time and recurring tasks
 Environment Variables - Manage both local and global environment variables
 Terminal - Full terminal access when you need the command line
 Coming Soon:
 Group Management
 Service & Log Management
 Package Management
 Firewall Configuration
 Container Management (Docker/Podman)
 Disk & Network Management
 VNC Support
 Why SysAdmin?
 Traditional server management requires either physical access or an SSH session through a terminal, which can be inconvenient when you're on the move. SysAdmin solves this by providing:
 Mobile-First GUI for Linux server management
 Multi-Server Support - manage all your servers from one app
 Secure Connections using SSH/SFTP with password or key-based authentication
 No Command Line Required (but available when you need it!)
 Security Features:
 Local Authentication - Biometric/pin protection using your device's screen lock
 Encrypted Communications - All server communications use SSH/SFTP encryption
 Secure Credential Storage - Connection details are stored in your device's secure storage
 No Server-side Components - Your credentials never leave your device
 This app is completely free and open source software (FOSS) licensed under GPL-3.0.
 "Because server management shouldn't require a desk."

fdroid:chat.delta.lite.name: ArcaneChat Private Messenger
fdroid:chat.delta.lite.summary: Keeping your chats secret • Anonymous, encrypted, decentralized messenger
fdroid:chat.delta.lite.description:
ArcaneChat is a private messenger and secure chat app for people who want digital privacy and independence. Anonymous sign-up, end-to-end encrypted messaging and, unlike WhatsApp, Telegram and Signal, ArcaneChat requires no phone number to work and it has zero ads.
• Secret: No one can know you are using the app or discover your profile, only people you show your QR or share your contact invite link with can contact you. This also means you are free from spam or scam calls from strangers.
• Anonymous: We do not ask for your phone number, email, or any personal data. We know nothing about you.
• Confidential: Every message and call is end-to-end encrypted. Not even we can read your messages or listen to your calls. Unlike most other chat platforms, we also have no access or control over the list of groups and channels you join or create.
• Interactive Mini-Apps: Elevate your group messaging with synchronized, in-chat tools. Play games, create shared shopping lists, split bills, and use a rich text editor with your group in real time. All data inside mini-apps is end-to-end encrypted and they work even while offline.
• Secure Audio & Video Calls: High-quality, encrypted voice and video calls keep you close to family, friends, and colleagues, even while traveling.
• Multi-Profile: Manage different identities effortlessly. Separate work or club activities from private life.
• Resilient: Offline-first and designed to work reliably on slow or poor connectivity (2G/3G/weak Wi-Fi) when other messaging apps fail to connect.
• Sovereign: Your profile lives in your pocket, not on a corporate cloud server. You truly own your data.
• Powerful: Unlimited pinned chats, unlimited pinned messages, unlimited profiles, no limits on amount of groups and channels you can join or create.
• Open Source & Decentralized: Fully open-source and auditable. Built on decentralized protocols. Interoperable with Delta Chat and other chatmail clients. To check out our source code, visit https://github.com/ArcaneChat
Why "Arcane Chat"?
"Arcane" means secret, hidden, known only to a few. We chose this name to reflect our core mission: providing you with a hidden, secure space for your private conversations, backed by robust, modern cryptography.
Take control of your digital footprint.
Download ArcaneChat and experience private messaging as it should be.
Follow us on:
• Mastodon/Fediverse: https://fosstodon.org/@arcanechat
• Our channel inside ArcaneChat itself! Get the invite link at: https://arcanechat.me/#contact

fdroid:com.atharok.barcodescanner.description:
Barcode Scanner is a free and open-source app that allows you to read and generate barcodes. It can collect information about food products, cosmetics books and music (CDs, Vinyls…).
Different barcodes formats are managed by the app :
• 2 dimensions bar codes: QR Code, Data Matrix, PDF 417, AZTEC
• 1 dimension bar codes: EAN 13, EAN 8, UPC A, UPC E, Code 128, Code 93, Code 39, Codabar, ITF
Collect information about a product during a scan :
• Food products with Open Food Facts
• Cosmetics with Open Beauty Facts
• Food products for pets with Open Pet Food Facts
• Books with Open Library
• Music CDs, Vinyls… with MusicBrainz
App features :
• Simply point your smartphone's camera to a barcode and instantly receive information about it. You can also scan barcodes through a picture in your smartphone.
• With a simple scan, read business cards, add new contacts, add new events to your agenda, open URL or even connect to Wi-Fi.
• Scan Food products barcodes to receive information about their composition thanks to the databases Open Food Facts and Open Beauty Facts.
• Search information about the product you scan, with a quick research on different websites such as Amazon or Fnac.
• Keep track of all your scanned barcodes with the history tool.
• Generate your own barcodes
• Customize the interface with different colors, with a light theme or a dark one. The interface is built with Material 3 and is compatible with Material You, allowing you to adjust colors based on your wallpaper for devices running on Android 12 or later.
• Texts are entirely translated in English, Arabic, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Russian, German, Turkish, Italian, Ukrainian, Polish, Dutch, Romanian and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional).
This app respects your privacy. It does not contain any trackers and does not collect any data.
The source code is available here: https://gitlab.com/Atharok/BarcodeScanner

fdroid:com.dessalines.rankmyfavs.name: Rank-My-Favs
fdroid:com.dessalines.rankmyfavs.summary: Rank your favorite things, using simple pair-wise matchups.
fdroid:com.dessalines.rankmyfavs.description:
Do you keep lists of your favorite things, such as movies, books, recipes, or music albums? You might keep list(s) that looks like this:
 Network (1976)
 Lone Star (1996)
 Devils (1971)
 The Seventh Seal (1957)
 ... Many more films_h 
But how do you rank these?
You might be tempted to order them by preference, but this could quickly get overwhelming for long lists.
A much easier method is to use pairwise comparisons , which shows you single head-to-head pairs, and has you choose which one you like best.
After doing a small number of these matchups, Rank-My-Favs can confidently create a ranked list for you.
Under the hood, Rank-My-Favs can sort by either the win-rate, or the more advanced Glicko rating system.

fdroid:com.maze_squirrel.name: The Squirrel's Maze 2D
fdroid:com.maze_squirrel.summary: Help the Squirrel. Different maze each time. Many levels.
fdroid:com.maze_squirrel.description:
If you are looking for a Maze or Squirrel puzzle game, this app is better to try.
 The goal is to walk in the maze and find a way to escape the Squirrel.
 The mazes are each time different and difficulty and size start from easy and small, and slowly step by step, go up to very hard and huge, so the game will sequentially challenge your brain more and more.
 In some levels, there are companies of other animals, which makes the game more dynamic and with an element of action game.
 Playing instructions: 
 There are left and right joysticks, one for movement in the 4 directions and one for throwing the acorns again in the 4 directions.
 If you prefer to control with swapped joysticks, they could be switched from the menu.
 When you walk inside the maze, you could collect acorns. If you have acorns, you could throw them to the other animals in order to feed them.
 This way you keep your hearts, because if an unfeed animal touches you, it takes one of your hearts.
 The goal is to help the squirrel by collecting the key and finding the exit door.
 Meanwhile, if you collect 3 starts you go to the next level.
 Features: 
 Increasing difficulties and sizes of labyrinths.
 Each time different mazes.
 Keeps track of your best result as High scores
 Supports different color palettes for different tastes.
 Permissions: 
 The app uses ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE and INTERNET permsisions, because it shows home ads and they open the default browser on the device, going to one of our other apps' page on the store or on the website of Metatrans Apps.
To be more precise, if the other app is available on the store, from which the app is downloaded, then opens the app page of the other app on the same store. If still the app is not available on the store, then opens the app page on our website.
The app pages on our website have app demo video on YouTube, so a connection to youtube domain will also be listed in order to visualize the page in the browser.
Our website is created by WordPress, so connections to other domains could be opened as well for technical purposes (e.g. downloading text fonts css).
Your feedback and/or review is more than welcome.

fdroid:com.skj.money.swield.expense.trac.name: Money Swield
fdroid:com.skj.money.swield.expense.trac.summary: Offline expense tracker: quick entry, clear reports. No account, no ads.
fdroid:com.skj.money.swield.expense.trac.description:
Money Swield answers one question: where did my money go? See it by week, month, year, category or event. Everything stays on your phone: no account, no server, no sync, no ads and no tracking.
 Record an expense in seconds 
 Title, amount, category, Save. Type a title you've used before and the rest is filled in for you.
 Do the math in the amount field: 120 + 85 × 2.
 Add events (a trip, a wedding, a festival), a payment method, a note and up to 10 photos of the receipt.
 Leave the form at any time; your draft is kept.
 See where it went 
 Home shows this week's, month's or year's total with a trend chart. Swipe the card to switch.
 Filter by category, event or text, and group the list by day, week, month or year.
 Reports with charts and highlights, exported to PDF or Excel.
 Many currencies, kept apart 
Spend in rupees at home and dollars on a trip: each currency keeps its own total, and amounts are never converted or added across currencies.
 Recurring payments 
Rent, subscriptions and bills are added on their due date. Change a price from a given date without touching past expenses, or skip a payment once.
 Suggestions from bank SMS (optional) 
Turn it on and the app reads debit SMS from banks while it is open, and suggests them as expenses. The SMS text is never stored and never leaves your phone. It never runs in the background.
 Your data is safe 
 Deleted expenses go to a bin for 30 days, with Undo.
 Back up to a single zip file, with or without photos, and restore it on any phone. A restore can be undone.
 The database is backed up before every app update changes it.
 Make it yours 
Light or dark theme, colors from your wallpaper or a color you pick, your own categories, events and payment methods. Available in English, Spanish and Hindi.
 Permissions 
The app has no internet permission at all. It asks to read SMS only if you turn on SMS suggestions. Photos are taken with your camera app, so no camera permission is needed.

fdroid:fr.odrevet.fujiten.name: Fujiten
fdroid:fr.odrevet.fujiten.description:
Fujiten is an offline Japanese dictionary application made with the Flutter framework.
Definition and kanji comes from the EDICT dictionary, compiled as a database from the edict_database project.
 Setup 
In order for fujiten to work, the Expression Database and the Kanji Database are needed.
The databases can be downloaded and installed from fujiten via the "settings/databases" menu or by downloading the database manually from https://github.com/odrevet/edict_database .
 Top menu 
 Bars 
Access the settings menu.
The settings menu allows you to download the dictionaries, set brightness and read legal information.
 Insert 
 Radicals <> 
Will match kanji composed with the selected radicals.
 Kanji character Ⓚ 
Will match any kanji.
 Kana character ㋐ 
Will match a hiragana/katakana character.
 Joker .* 
Any match.
 Convert 
In case your device is not equipped with a Japanese input keyboard, fujiten can convert Latin character (romaji) to hiragana or katakana.
Lowercase romaji will be converted to hiragana, uppercase romaji will be converted to katakana.
 Kotoba / Kanji search 
When Kotoba is selected, fujiten will search for expression.
When Kanji is selected, fujiten will search for kanji.
 Clear 
Clear the input field.
 Search 
Run the search.
 Tips 
• Search are performed with regular expression, quantifiers "{}" and meta-characters like "." and others can be used
• Use search by radical < > when searching for an expression which you do not know a kanji but recognize some of its radicals example: ＜化＞
• When no results, add ".*" at the beginning or/and the end of your search
fdroid:fr.odrevet.fujiten.category: Reading, Science & Education, Translation & Dictionary, Writing

fdroid:org.codeberg.pako.tubester.name: Tubester
fdroid:org.codeberg.pako.tubester.summary: Scan Hitster cards and play their songs on YouTube
fdroid:org.codeberg.pako.tubester.description:
Tubester lets you play the Hitster music board game using YouTube instead of a
Spotify subscription. Point it at the QR code on a card and it opens the matching
song in an external player of your choice, such as NewPipe or the YouTube app.
A Hitster QR code contains only the card's identity, not the song. Tubester reads
the language and card number, looks the card up in the community
"songseeker-hitster-playlists" dataset to find the exact track, and hands the
YouTube link to your external player.
To keep the round fair, Tubester shows a "turn the phone upside down" hint and a
short countdown before playback starts, because the external player displays the
video title. The answer (year, title and artist) stays hidden behind a Reveal
button. For a fully spoiler-free experience, set NewPipe to open links in the
background so no title is ever shown.
Features:
* Scans Hitster QR cards with a fast, on-device, fully open-source scanner.
* Plays songs through an external player (NewPipe recommended, or YouTube).
* Spoiler-safe game flow with a flip-the-phone hint and hidden answer.
* Supports many sets and expansions via the community mapping dataset.
* Caches mapping data on device.
Privacy: no accounts, no ads, and no analytics or tracking. Tubester needs only
the Camera permission (to scan) and Internet (to fetch mappings and open links).
Note: Tubester is not affiliated with Hitster or its publishers, Spotify, Google
or YouTube. It relies on YouTube, a non-free network service.

KEY CAPABILITIES
• Adaptive nutrition coach: smart algorithms personalize your calorie and macro intake targets, just like a nutrition coach would, and weekly check-ins keep you on track
• Best-in-class expenditure estimate (TDEE): calculates how many calories you actually burn from your own logs and weight data, so your plan fits your body instead of a generic formula

HOW IT WORKS
1. Set your goal (lose, maintain, or gain) and choose your rate of weight change to set your calorie deficit or surplus.
2. Log your meals in the food log and weigh in with the weight tracker as usual.
3. Each week, MacroFactor compares your calorie and macro intake with your weight trend to calculate your true energy expenditure (TDEE) and detect changes in your metabolism.

It estimates your energy expenditure from your food logs and weight trend, then adjusts your targets at each weekly check-in.

Nothing breaks. The algorithm is adherence neutral, so your check-in and calorie adjustment still work, with no warnings or red numbers.

Snap a photo with AI food logging, describe your meal, speak it, or scan a barcode or nutrition label.

[Automatic iCloud sync]
Events added on your iPhone automatically appear on your iPad and Mac. Events sync through your connected calendar accounts, while individual event colors, date ranges, and other details set in Tempo sync through iCloud.

Add a large monthly calendar widget to your iPhone or iPad Home Screen. See a whole month of events at once, switch months, and add events right from the widget. Tap a date to open that day in your calendar.

Get notified at the time you choose so you don’t miss an important appointment. Tap a notification to go straight to the event. Tempo integrates smoothly with Apple’s notification system for a simple, familiar experience.

Quickly find events by title. Search ignores differences in case and diacritics, so even part of a word can help you find a matching event.
What Tempo stands for
[Smooth interactions]
Every interaction should feel instant. Tempo focuses on natural, lightweight responses rather than heavy animations or complicated screen transitions.
[Minimal design]
Essential information is clear, and unnecessary elements are left out. By reducing visual clutter, Tempo helps you focus on your events.
[At home in the Apple ecosystem]
Tempo follows the design language of iOS, iPadOS, and macOS. It makes natural use of Apple’s built-in calendar, notifications, widgets, iCloud, and more.
On the move or at your desk, keep your day flowing with Tempo.
Tempo. A calendar in tune with your day.

flathub:dev.mariinkys.Oboete.description:
Oboete is a straightforward and efficient flashcard application designed to help users study
 and memorize information effectively. Whether you're learning a new language, studying for exams,

 organizing, and reviewing flashcards.

 Works out of the box

 Image and FSRS support

flathub:dk.pracedru.Symbolical.name: Symbolical
flathub:dk.pracedru.Symbolical.description:
Make math documents with perfectly formatted equations and evaluations. Include text,
 image and graph fields to document your calculations. The math fields include the ability to make
 units and functions. Various solvers are included. Various tranformation functions are included.
 AI disclaimer:
 The code in this application has been made almost entirely by real people. A very small part of the code has been
 made with generative ai. The automated testing and language translations have in large parts been made with
 generative ai. We have also used AI to do code analysis and to debate architectural design.

flathub:org.deluge_torrent.deluge.name: Deluge
flathub:org.deluge_torrent.deluge.description:
Deluge is a Free Software, cross-platform BitTorrent client on Python and Gtk3 with multiple user interfaces in client/server model.
 Deluge includes the following features:
 Protocol Encryption
 DHT
 Local Peer Discovery (LSD)
 Peer Exchange (PEX)
 UPnP
 NAT-PMP
 Proxy Support
 Web seeds
 Global and per-torrent speed limits
 Stream Torrent - sequential download
 GTK interface
 Changelog at deluge.readthedocs.io/en/latest/changelog.html

flathub:org.ecosia.Browser.description:

 We dedicate 100% of our profits to the planet. That means you can plant trees, protect endangered animals,
 and uplift communities around the world simply by browsing.

flathub:org.freedesktop.Piper.name: Piper
flathub:org.freedesktop.Piper.description:
Piper is a graphical user interface to configure gaming mice.
 Configuration options include changing the resolution (DPI) of the
 mouse, adding and removing profiles, setting LED colors and changing
 button behaviors.
 Piper requires libratbag’s ratbagd, the daemon to actually communicate with the
 mice. Piper is merely a front end to ratbagd, ratbagd must be
 installed and running when Piper is launched.

flathub:org.sil.reading-app-builder.name: Reading App Builder
flathub:org.sil.reading-app-builder.summary: Build apps with synced text and audio
flathub:org.sil.reading-app-builder.description: Reading App Builder helps you build customized apps for smartphones and tablets. You can use it to make apps containing picture books, health and community development materials, song books, illustrated stories and libraries of easy-to-read books for new readers – each with the option of synchronizing text and audio, highlighting each phrase as it is read. The app menus, icon, splash screen and colors can all be customized for your language and culture. To build an app, you specify the text and audio files, the app name, the fonts, the colors, the about box information and the icons. Reading App Builder will package everything together and compile the customized app for you. You can then install it on your mobile device, send it to others by Bluetooth, share it on microSD memory cards and publish it to app stores on the Internet.

flathub:page.codeberg.petsoi.coronet.name: Coronet
flathub:page.codeberg.petsoi.coronet.summary: Place crowns in a logic puzzle
flathub:page.codeberg.petsoi.coronet.description:
Coronet is a logic puzzle game. The grid is divided into colored regions; place exactly one crown in every row, every column, and every colored region, with no two crowns touching, not even diagonally.
 Left-click a cell to place or remove a crown, drag a crown to move it, right-click (or long-press on touch) to mark a cell you've deduced can't hold one. Crowns that break a rule are outlined in red.

fedora-packages:dogtag-pki/dogtag-pki-kr.name: dogtag-pki-kra
fedora-packages:dogtag-pki/dogtag-pki-kr.description: Dogtag PKI Key Recovery Authority (KRA) is an optional subsystem that can act as a key archival facility. When configured in conjunction with the Certificate Authority (CA), the KRA stores private encryption keys as part of the certificate enrollment process. The key archival mechanism is triggered when a user enrolls in the PKI and creates the certificate request. Using the Certificate Request Message Format (CRMF) request format, a request is generated for the user's private encryption key. This key is then stored in the KRA which is configured to store keys in an encrypted format that can only be decrypted by several agents requesting the key at one time, providing for protection of the public encryption keys for the users in the PKI deployment. Note that the KRA archives encryption keys; it does NOT archive signing keys, since such archival would undermine non-repudiation properties of signing keys.

firefox-addons:2624383.name: Web Security Audit
firefox-addons:2624383.summary: Passively audits the security posture on current page
firefox-addons:2624383.description:
The goal of this project is to build an add-on for browser that passively audits the security posture of the websites that the user is visiting. Assume that the tool is to be used on non-malicious websites, currently not under attack or compromised. Add-on wants to report security misconfigurations, or failure to use best security practices.
- Add-on tries to analysis the commonly vulnerable setting of servers: lack of use of security-relevant headers, including:
 - strict-transport-security
 - x-xss-protection
 - content-security-policy
 - x-frame-options
 - x-content-type-options
- It doesn't to interfere with the functioning of the visited website.
- It doesn't tamper with request parameters, or issue requests that were not initiated by the user (it is not active scanning).
- Incrementally generate a report in a separate window.
- Each report entry have a numeric score to indicate approximately its severity, as a way to prioritise further investigation by a human analyst [Common Vulnerability Scoring System]( https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_Vulnerability_Scoring_System ).
### Limitations
- Add-on only works on sites that allow content scripts.

firefox-addons:3038658.name: Duo Translator - Translation & writing assistant
firefox-addons:3038658.summary: Supports webpage translation, selected text translation, writing enhancement, and more.
firefox-addons:3038658.description:
An AI-powered translation and writing assistant. Supports webpage translation, selected text translation, writing enhancement, and more. Helps you access information more easily and break down language barriers.
💡 How to Start:
Click the extension icon to open the popup. You can pin the extension for quick access.
💻 Features:
🎯 Webpage Translation:
 Bilingual layout by default, helping you better understand the original content and improve your reading experience.
 Quickly translate and restore pages with the floating ball, keyboard shortcuts, or context menu.
 Detects the page language and translates it automatically.
 Customize the translation style, including background color, text color, border style, and border color.
🌟 Bilingual Highlighting:
 Highlights the original and translation sentence by sentence, helping you better understand long-form content and quickly identify complex, difficult, or mistranslated sentences.
 Simply hover over the original text or translation to trigger it.
 Customize the highlight style, including border style, border color, background color, and text color.
📌 Paragraph and Selection Translation:
 Quickly translate any paragraph without manually selecting the entire text.
 Selected Text Translation lets you listen to and quickly copy both the original text and the translation.
 Trigger it with a double-tap of Ctrl or Alt, a keyboard shortcut, or the context menu.
📝 AI Writing:
 Correct grammar, polish, translate, and more directly in input box.
 Enable whitelist mode to run it only on the websites you need.
 Open the dedicated AI workbench to edit long-form text and review the output more easily.
📹 Video Subtitles
1. YouTube bilingual subtitles.
2. Customize subtitle style.
📦 Multiple Translation and AI Service Integrations:
 Built-in translation services include Microsoft, Google, and DeepL.
 Supports OpenAI, DeepSeek, Gemini, OpenRouter, Claude, Ollama, and custom AI providers.
🔍 Others:
 Sync your settings with WebDAV, or import and export them as local files.
 Privacy first. Duo Translator is free, open-source, and never collects your personal data.
 Website translation rules: Per-site translate areas, no-translate areas and custom CSS.
🏅 Future Development:
More features are under development. If you have a good idea, please contact me. If you're interested in this project, feel free to become a contributor.
🚀 Support:
If you encounter any issues during use, please submit an issue on GitHub ( https://github.com/linuxscreen/duo-translator ) or contact us by email ( support@duotranslator.com ).

firefox-addons:2713030.name: Bestshopping Cashback & Rabattcodes
firefox-addons:2713030.summary: Eine Browser-Erweiterung, die Sie benachrichtigt, wenn Sie eine Website mit Bestshopping.com Cashback durchsuchen
firefox-addons:2713030.description:
MEMO ist ein praktischer Cashback-Assistent, eine kostenlose Browser-Erweiterung, die dich in Echtzeit über Cashback informiert, sobald du einen Partner-Shop besuchst. Cashback bedeutet, Bestshopping gibt dir einen Teil der Ausgaben für deine Einkäufe bei über 2.000 Partner-Shops zurück. Wenn du beim Online-Shoppen MEMO verwendest, erscheint oben rechts im Fenster eine kleines grünes Feld mit dem verfügbaren Cashback-Anteil für die Bestellung im jeweiligen Shop. Dann klickst du einfach auf 'Cashback aktivieren' und kaufst wie gewohnt ein. Damit wird dein Cashback erfasst und gutgeschrieben.
Über die Cashback-Aktivierung hinaus, hat MEMO noch weitere Vorteile:
- Du kannst nach einem bestimmten Shop suchen und prüfen, ob und wieviel dort Cashback verfügbar ist.
- Du kannst deine Lieblingsshops in einer Liste speichern, um schneller darauf zuzugreifen. 
- Es gibt außerdem eine Liste mit Super-Cashback Aktionen in ausgewählten Shops, die für eine kurze Zeit die Cashback-Rate erhöhen.
- Du kannst direkt auf dein Profil zugreifen und/oder direkt das bisher gesammelte Cashback abrufen.
- Du siehst jederzeit dein bisher erreichtes Level (vom Kätzchen bis hin zum Löwen) im MEMO-Fenster und auch das Symbol der Browser-Erweiterung zeigt das erreichte Level an.
- Bei der Google-Suche erscheint beim jeweiligen Suchtreffer ein Hinweis, dass in dem Shop Cashback verfügbar ist.
Diese Browser-Erweiterung hilft dir bei der Registrierung, beim Shoppen und Sammeln von Cashback-Guthaben. Kurz gesagt: Mit MEMO kannst du sicher sein, dass du keine Cashbacks mehr verpasst, denn mit nur einem Klick kannst du dein Cashback aktivieren und den Einkauf abschließen!
Die Datenschutzerklärung für MEMO findest du hier: https://de.bestshopping.com/cashback-alert-extension.html#privacy 
Die Datenschutzerklärung für die Registrierung bei Bestshopping gibt es hier: https://de.bestshopping.com/privacy.html 
Changelog:
Wir präsentieren die Version 2.2.0 von MEMO, den praktischen Cashback-Assistenten und der kostenlosen Browser-Erweiterung von Bestshopping. Diese Version bietet die gleichen Funktionen - mit einigen Verbesserungen. Keine Sorge, du wirst wie bisher beim Besuch eines Shops mit Cashback informiert, damit du dein Cashback aktivieren und sammeln kannst.
Neue Features dieser Version:
- Neuer Look, - diskreter und weniger aufdringlich bei der Navigation.
- Das Aktivierungsfenster wurde grafisch verbessert.
- Technische Optimierungen und verbesserte Kompatibilität.

firefox-addons:3007885.name: TikTok Pro Tools
firefox-addons:3007885.summary: Background play, auto-pause, speed control, EQ, shop unlocker, product viewer & video download for TikTok
firefox-addons:3007885.description:
TikTok Pro Tools transforms tiktok.com into a complete power-user experience. Every feature runs 100% locally in your browser — no account, no tracking, no data collection.
━━━ PLAYBACK CONTROL ━━━
- Background Play — videos keep playing when you switch tabs or minimize the browser.
- Smart Auto-Pause — automatically pauses TikTok when another tab starts audio, resumes when it stops.
- Auto Picture-in-Picture — pops a mini-player when you leave the tab so you never miss a moment.
- Speed Controller — fine-tune playback from 0.25× up to 4×.
- Autoplay Recovery — silently re-attempts play() when a background tab is throttled by the browser.
━━━ AUDIO ENHANCEMENT ━━━
- 8-band Graphic Equalizer with 11 presets: Bass Boost, Treble Boost, Vocal Boost, Pop, Rock, Classical, Electronic, Dance, Jazz, Movie, Flat — plus a savable Custom preset.
- 360° Audio (8D) — immersive rotating spatial mode.
- Volume Normalizer — balances loud and quiet videos so sudden volume spikes never startle you.
━━━ UI & CONTENT CONTROL ━━━
- Clean Mode — hide overlays, descriptions, and chrome for a distraction-free feed.
- Auto-Skip by Keywords — skip videos whose captions match your blocklist.
- Comment Blur by Keywords — softly hide comments matching your rules.
- Floating Clock & Watch-Time Stats — keep track of time spent on TikTok.
━━━ SHOP & PRODUCT ━━━
- Unlock Regional Shop Videos — watch shop content normally blocked in your region.
- In-Video Product Viewer — name, image, price, seller, description and a direct link, fetched on demand from the public TikTok product page.
━━━ DOWNLOADS ━━━
- One-click download of TikTok videos (HD, watermark-free or watermarked).
- Extract MP3 audio track.
- Download photo carousels (each image as a separate file).
- URL box in the popup — paste any TikTok link to grab the media.
All downloads are resolved through the public tikwm.com API.
━━━ PRIVACY ━━━
This extension does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All settings are saved locally via browser.storage. The only outbound network requests are:
 1. tikwm.com — only when you click download, to resolve the media URL.
 2. tiktok.com product/video pages — only when the product viewer is enabled, to extract public product metadata.
No analytics, no telemetry, no third-party tracking.
━━━ PERMISSIONS EXPLAINED ━━━
- storage — remember your settings and custom EQ bands.
- tabs — detect when other tabs start audio (for auto-pause).
- alarms — keep the background script responsive.
- downloads — save videos/MP3s/images to your Downloads folder.
- declarativeNetRequest — rewrite User-Agent to mobile for TikTok Shop product pages so product metadata can be parsed (same approach Chrome devtools would use).
- host_permissions for tiktok.com and tikwm.com — required for every feature above.
Open source and free for personal use. Source code: https://github.com/diepvantien/Tiktok-Pro-Tools

bluejetty:00077387:ios.description:

bluejetty:00091993:ios.summary:
OVERVIEW

Focus on the most important aspects of your business while your dedicated Posh Live Virtual Receptionist professionally answers your incoming phone calls, transfers callers yo
bluejetty:00091993:ios.description:
OVERVIEW
We answer your calls, so you can answer what calls you.
Focus on the most important aspects of your business while your dedicated Posh Live Virtual Receptionist professionally answers your incoming phone calls, transfers callers you want to speak with, takes messages, schedules appointments, and more. It’s all controlled by you with the Posh app! Have us step in as much or as little as you like – we’re always waiting on the sidelines, at the ready 24/7/365.
HOW IT WORKS
Here is how Posh can handle your incoming phone calls:
1. We professionally answer the call.
“Thanks for calling XYZ Company. How can I help you?”
2. We dial your phone.
“Yes, we can help you with that. I’m happy to try to connect you with Mr. Smith. Can you please hold for a moment?”
3. If you want to take the call, we connect you and the caller.
“Hi, Mr. Smith! A potential new client is calling. Her name is Lisa. Would you like to speak with her?”
4. If you’re not available, we can take a message or direct the caller to your voicemail.
“Thanks for holding, Lisa. Mr. Smith is currently in a meeting. May I get your number so he can return your call?”
5. We send you a message with the caller’s info.
“Lisa Robinson is interested in your service. Her number is…”
FEATURES
- 24/7 Availability: Have a Posh receptionist answer calls whenever you want, including after hours with custom call routing.
- Call Handling: Set your status with the tap of a button to control when you would like calls transferred to you or when you prefer we take a message.
- Message Management: Choose if you want to receive messages via text, email, or through the app where all messages are logged (includes filtering and archiving abilities).
- Integrations: We can integrate with your software to provide appointment scheduling and lead intake service.
- Bilingual: English and Spanish available.
- Texting and Calling: Text or call any number from the Posh app to keep your personal cell number private.
- Voicemail: Each Posh account includes voicemail that has transcription capabilities.
- Task Assistant: Your Posh receptionist can make outbound calls for you to provide or gather additional info.
- Security: All your data is protected – the Posh app requires a unique login and password to access messages and manage your account.
GET STARTED
Visit posh.com or call us at 833-GET-POSH to speak to a representative about our affordable service plans.
Once your service is setup, download the Posh app, and have Posh answer your calls whenever you like!

bluejetty:00087566:ios.description:
Travel data should not disappear after each trip.
You know the feeling: you buy a travel eSIM, land overseas, use part of the data, then watch the rest expire when the trip ends.
That is wasted money. Wasted data. Wasted value.
Eskimo was built to change that.
With Eskimo, your travel data has no expiry. Buy data once, use it whenever you travel, and keep every unused GB for your next trip. Whether you are flying next week, next month, or next year, your data stays ready.
No expiry. No wasted data. No roaming surprises.
THE NO-EXPIRY TRAVEL eSIM + DATA
Eskimo gives you one universal eSIM for travel across 175 countries and regions. Install it once, choose a local, regional, or global data plan, and connect when you arrive.
Use it for maps, messaging, rides, hotel bookings, social apps, emails, work, and everything else you need while traveling.
WHY ESKIMO IS DIFFERENT
● No Expiry Data
Most travel eSIM plans come with a countdown. Eskimo does not. Your purchased data stays with you until you use it.
● Keep Every Unused GB
Used only half your data on this trip? Keep the rest for the next one. Stop rebuying travel data you already paid for.
● One Universal eSIM
Install once and use Eskimo across supported destinations. No plastic SIM cards. No swapping SIMs. No complicated eSIM marketplace.
● Transfer Data to Anyone
Send data instantly to friends, family, colleagues, or travel companions using a mobile number. Perfect for family holidays, group trips, business travel, and helping someone get online fast.
● Cashback Loyalty
Earn instant cashback rewards on every eligible purchase and unlock higher reward tiers as you travel more.
● Personal Hotspot
Share your mobile data connection with your phone, tablet, laptop, or travel companions.
● Easy Top-Up
Need more data? Top up in the app without reinstalling your eSIM. Your next plan is ready when you need it.
EXCLUSIVE PERKS
● Invite Friends
Refer friends and you both earn free travel data for every successful referral. No purchase required.
● Travel Cashback
Book trips through Eskimo with selected travel partners and receive cashback on eligible bookings.
● Eskimo Guarantee
Enjoy hassle-free support for unused plans, device incompatibility, or a change of mind, subject to eligibility.
BUILT FOR REAL TRAVELERS
Eskimo is made for the way people actually travel.
For the family that buys too much data “just in case.”
For the business traveler who jumps between countries.
For the student going abroad.
For the digital nomad who wants one eSIM that keeps working.
For the holidaymaker who is tired of losing unused GB after every trip.
Eskimo turns travel data into something you keep, reuse, share, and earn value from.
USE ESKIMO FOR
International travel, business trips, family holidays, backpacking, digital nomad travel, study abroad, multi-country trips, layovers, transit, and remote work abroad.
POPULAR DESTINATIONS
Use Eskimo in supported destinations including the United States, United Kingdom, Japan, Australia, Thailand, France, Spain, Germany, Italy, Canada, China, India, South Korea, Indonesia, Vietnam, Mexico, South Africa, and more.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Download Eskimo
2. Choose your destination or global eSIM data plan
3. Install your eSIM once
4. Connect when you arrive
5. Keep unused data for future trips
Travel data should work for you, not expire against you.
Download Eskimo and start traveling with no-expiry eSIM data.

bluejetty:00184620:ios.description:
Master and manage the chaos of international railway traffic as the ultimate railroad tycoon. Build the rail network of your dreams; lay rails to solve the railroad puzzle with branching and forking roads at every turn. Pick your path and become the richest rail manager!
Get in the driver's seat and take passengers to their destinations, dropping them at stations, and haul goods to ports and factories. Control and conduct the trains, marshalling them through tunnels, around obstacles and over mountains in this thrilling, fast-paced action arcade videogame. Connect your express trains across the railyard at breakneck speed. Try to avoid crashing, but I bet you can't. You'll need snappy strategy to master the chaos! Be on high-alert for explosive crashes, near-misses and split-second situations.
Ring the bell and toot your horn while playing in all types of weather conditions. Find bullet trains, diesel trains, modern electric trains and trams. Customise your trains and pick your favourite train carriage style.
It all counts when you're growing the biggest railway in the world.
Let the locomotives loose!
"Incredibly good looking. Supremely satisfying." 
- Touch Arcade
"A brilliant mashup of genres that's wonderfully addictive."
- Pocket Gamer
"So tactile and satisfying" 
- Penny Arcade
"A really well thought out puzzle game." 
- SlideToPlay
"Train Conductor is a work of art." 
- Hittin Crits

Enjoy improved online systems that make managing your account easier than ever on our new mobile app.

bluejetty:00062667:ios.name: Seek by iNaturalist
bluejetty:00062667:ios.summary:

• Get outside and point the Seek Camera at living things

bluejetty:00062667:ios.description:
Use the power of image recognition technology to identify the plants and animals all around you. Earn badges for seeing different types of plants, birds, fungi and more!
• Get outside and point the Seek Camera at living things
• Identify wildlife, plants, and fungi and learn about the organisms all around you
• Earn badges for observing different types of species and participating in challenges
OPEN THE CAMERA AND START SEEKING!
Found a mushroom, flower, or bug, and not sure what it is? Open up the Seek Camera to see if it knows!
Drawing from millions of wildlife observations on iNaturalist, Seek shows you lists of commonly recorded insects, birds, plants, amphibians, and more in your area. Scan the environment with the Seek Camera to identify organisms using the tree of life. Add different species to your observations and learn all about them in the process! The more observations you make, the more badges you’ll earn!
This is a great app for families who want to spend more time exploring nature together, and for anyone who wants to learn more about the life all around them.
KID-SAFE
Seek does not require registration and does not collect any user data by default. Some user data will be collected if you choose to sign in with an iNaturalist account, but you must be over 13 or have your parents permission to do so.
Seek will ask permission to turn on location services, but your location is obscured to respect your privacy while still allowing species suggestions from your general area. Your precise location is never stored in the app or sent to iNaturalist unless you sign in to your iNaturalist account and submit your observations.
Our image recognition technology is based on observations submitted to iNaturalist.org and partner sites, and identified by the iNaturalist community.
Seek is part of iNaturalist, a not-for-profit organization. Seek was made by the iNaturalist team with support from the California Academy of Sciences, the National Geographic Society, Our Planet on Netflix, WWF, HHMI Tangled Bank Studios, and Visipedia.

bluejetty:00193625:android.name: The Fun Way to Learn Algebra
bluejetty:00193625:android.summary: If you’re looking for fun math apps for kids or adults, Hands-On Equations turns tricky math equations into an engaging, hands-on experience. Say goodbye to algebra anxiety and hello to confidence as you solve math equations in a fun way th
bluejetty:00193625:android.description:
If you’re looking for fun math apps for kids or adults, Hands-On Equations turns tricky math equations into an engaging, hands-on experience. Say goodbye to algebra anxiety and hello to confidence as you solve math equations in a fun way that feels like play. 🎉
This free app is a must-have for anyone seeking a math-helping app that makes learning enjoyable and effective. 📱
Why Choose Hands-On Equations?
- Expert-Led Lessons: Start with a short, encouraging video by Dr. Henry Borenson, the inventor of Hands-On Equations, and follow step-by-step lessons designed to build your skills.
- Practice and Exercises: Master each concept with practice problems and interactive exercises that let you manipulate digital game pieces, like a pawn for the unknown and number cubes for constants, to solve algebra problems visually. 🧩
- Offline Learning: Enjoy offline access to all lessons and exercises, making it easy to practice anytime, anywhere, perfect for school, home, or on the go. 🌍
- Montessori Inspired: Aligned with Montessori learning apps, this app encourages self-directed study and deep understanding, ideal for children in grade school or adults revisiting algebra. 🌟
Perfect for All Ages and Stages
- For Kids: Whether your child is a 3rd grader, 4th grader, 5th grader, or is in grade 6 and beyond, this app makes math learning fun and accessible. It’s a great way to practice algebra even before they hit middle school, boosting confidence for future classes. The app is very beneficial for middle school students as part of a pre-algebra program.👦
- For Adults: If algebra has always been a struggle, this app is your second chance. With a game-based approach, you can finally learn basic mathematics and master math equations at your own pace. 🧑🎓
- For Educators and Parents: Use this app as a tutor to support your child’s study or as a Montessori tool to enhance your class curriculum. It’s a versatile resource for school and homeschooling alike.
Features That Make Learning Fun
- Interactive Gameplay: Move digital pawns and number cubes on a virtual balance scale to solve math equations, it’s like a game that teaches algebra! 
- Progress at Your Pace: Complete practice problems to unlock lesson exercises, ensuring you’re ready for each new challenge. 🚀
- Check Your Work: Use the "check" feature to verify solutions and learn from mistakes, building confidence with every exercise. ✅
- Free and Offline: This free math learning app works offline, so you can study without interruptions, whether you’re at home or on the move. 
Why It Works
Over a million students have gained math confidence through the Hands-On Equations method, and now it’s available in this free educational app for kids. Inspired by the original game pieces used in schools, this app brings the same proven approach to your device, making it one of the best math teaching apps available. 🏆
Whether used by a 7th grader looking to ace an equations test, an adult seeking math practice, or a parent looking for fun math games for kids, this app is your go-to math teaching app. It’s also a fantastic resource for learning math for kids and adults, offering a fresh, engaging way to learn basic mathematics and beyond.
Start Your Math Adventure Today!
Download this free math teaching app now and join the millions who’ve made algebra fun. Perfect for kids, adults, and anyone in between, it’s time to solve algebra problems with ease. 🎈
For more information on Hands-On Equations, visit https://www.borenson.com.
For app support, send an email to info@borenson.com.

bluejetty:00019277:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00019277:ios.description:
Welcome to New Star Manager: The critically acclaimed game from Simon Read, creator of the BAFTA Award-winning New Star Soccer series.
Take control of New Star FC – a beleaguered soccer club which needs your management skills and instincts to unlock the team's potential and make it to the top of the game.
 ⋆⋆⋆The No.1 iPhone and iPad game of 2018 - AppSpy.com⋆⋆⋆
This is soccer management like you've never experienced it - Be more than just a player, be the head, the heart, and backbone of New Star FC. Be the Manager.
 “New Star Manager takes the frame of the original game, and builds something utterly wonderful on top of it”  10/10 - Pocket Gamer
 “If you love football…you’d be mad not to download it” The Guardian
TOTAL CLUB CONTROL
Take ownership of every aspect of New Star FC, from constructing vital club facilities and managing the players' training regimes to choosing the perfect sponsor and hiring or firing the backroom staff!
FULL SQUAD GAMEPLAY
Use every member of your team to set up and score pivotal goals with on-pitch gameplay, using innovative controls designed specifically for phones and tablets!
REAL SOCCER TACTICS
Build your dream squad, choose your winning formation, make tactical substitutions, and even step into the locker room for some half-time motivation!
OFF-PITCH DRAMA
Handle volatile players and get their mind back in the game by monitoring their concerns, outbursts, and quirks. Keep the board off your back, navigate the hostile waters of the sporting press, and make sure the fans keep believing... while keeping a careful eye on the club's finances!
GLOBAL FOOTBALL
Dive into realistic simulations of the world’s biggest leagues and cup competitions!
THE NEW STAR SOCCER EVOLUTION
Experience the newest instalment of the New Star series, whose pick-up-and-play sports titles have already been enjoyed by over 30 million players!

bluejetty:00012036:android.description:
RADDX - Racing Metaverse game is a free to play epic online futuristic Multiplayer Racing game with stunning new game locations, attractive EV cars, take down the chasing cops, power-ups, Mystery Box, rewards for Premium Tournaments & much more!
Features:
• Multiplayer - Clash against crew of your rivals in Real-Time Multiplayer extreme racing.
• Gameplay - Burn the asphalt & wreck the props and Drift through the street racing tracks without crashing. Experience the intense racing, where crazy adventure with no limits. Dodge through traffic (cars, bikes, trucks, etc,.) & experience the fun of arcade racing.
• Power-Ups - Utilize various futuristic Power-Ups (Turbo boosters, Ramps [to get Airborne], Teleport, Mystery box and etc.,)
• Leagues - Stack up your victories and hill climb the Rank to become a Legend on the race track with pumped up racing adrenaline.
• Leaderboard - TOP the leaderboard by playing against global players.
• Garage - Unlock 16+ high end Hyper-cars were inspired from real world dream cars, choose a best one for your play-style to become Master Car Builder, customize your nameplate and share the best angle of cars to your friends.
• Level-Up - Reach higher levels of your car and unlock stunning VFX (Visual effects) on the car.
• Upgrades - Tune-Up your high speed motor machine's Body, Tyre durability, Good Charm (chance of getting rare Power-Ups) & RX-1 Learning Ability.
• Sharing is caring - Refer this racing sensation to your friends and earn In-Game currency.
• Lucky draw - Use spin wheel everyday to earn In-Game rewards.
• Missions - Complete engaging challenges daily and earn insane rewards in this arcade gameplay.
• Realistic Engine sound - Toggle between EV and Combustion engine sounds 
• 3D sound effects - Experience the 3D surround sound effects.
• Mr. 360 - View 360 degree view of your car in Gameplay.
• Camera angles - Change camera angles of the car to give real racing experience in Gameplay.
• Private Race – Invite your friends and online players for a private race.
• Nitrous – Get to high speed with Nitro in Singleplayer & Multiplayer modes, which makes RADDX a exciting racing game.
More about the game:
• Race online with global players and leave them stunned with your victory.
• Collect Common, Rare, Epic and Legendary customized unique

bluejetty:00073718:ios.description:
Enjoy Slate, the award-winning daily online magazine, on your iPhone. 
Slate is a general-interest publication offering analysis and commentary about politics, news, business, technology, culture, and advice. Slate’s strong editorial voice and witty take on current events have been recognized with numerous awards, including the National Magazine Award for General Excellence Online.
Features include:
- Our Editorially curated stories of the day 
- Access to all of our written work, including Slate’s popular political and legal commentary, movie and television reviews, and Dear Prudence.
- Our award winning podcasts, including the Political Gabfest, the Culture Gabfest, Decoder Ring, and Slow Burn.
- Push notifications to keep you informed throughout your day.
- The ability to choose to read using Light or Dark mode.
- Access to purchase or sign in to our membership program, Slate Plus. Please see the benefits below.
The app is free to download, however we do display advertisements within the app. Additionally we offer the ability to log in to your existing Slate Plus account or purchase a new Slate Plus account through the in app purchases. Your Slate Plus account can be used on your iOS devices as well as our website. To use your Slate Plus subscription on other devices you must create an account after completing your purchase. You can always create an account at a later time if you choose not to do so initially after your purchase.
With your Slate Plus subscription, you'll receive:
- Unlimited articles in the Slate app.
- An ad-free reading experience in the Slate app.
By creating an optional account you’ll also receive:
- Unlimited articles on slate.com.
- Our exclusive subscriber only weekly newsletter.
- Access to all of our podcasts completely ad-free.
- Bonus episodes and segments on your favorite shows!
Slate Plus Subscription details:
Your account will automatically renew at the end of each month or year depending on your subscription. Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to user account settings after purchase. 7000+ Match3 Project Makeover Puzzle Levels for you
CHOOSE from a vast wardrobe of fashionable clothes and accessories to create the perfect look!
MAKEOVER clients in need, giving them the confidence to pursue their dreams and reach new heights!

BLAST through Dream Match3 puzzle levels with powerful boosters and amazing effects, unlocking new fun stories, help them with tile mini makeover game & earning coins along the way free games for girls

Why You'll Love Tile Match - Match 3 Tiles Mini games :
- Addictive and Relaxing. Tile Match - Match 3 Tiles with candy match3 strikes the perfect balance between challenge and relaxation. It's a game you can play to unwind after a long day or engage in intense tile-matching sessions during your free time.
- Innovative Gameplay. Tile Match - Match 3 Tiles takes the classic match 3 puzzle concept to new heights. With innovative mechanics and clever twists, we offer a refreshing take on a beloved genre, providing an experience like no other.

1) Wedding Betrayal Girl: Grace From San Diego, USA
Heartbroken by Luke's betrayal, Grace is shattered when he slams the door on her. She vows to become a stunning dream bride makeover and marry someone who will make Luke regret it.

She watches in sorrow as her Halloween party area catches fire, ruining the event.

Play free Match-3 puzzles, decorate fabulous rooms, and dive into the world of fashion and makeovers in this fun and exciting puzzle game for all players!
Download now and start swapping for endless fun.

ByPet is a relaxing and entertaining virtual pet raising application. Adopt your favorite digital pet, nurture them with care, witness their growth, and enjoy warm and healing pet-raising moments.
Core Features
Diverse Pet Selection Choos
bluejetty:00096805:ios.description:
ByPet is a relaxing and entertaining virtual pet raising application. Adopt your favorite digital pet, nurture them with care, witness their growth, and enjoy warm and healing pet-raising moments.
Core Features
Diverse Pet Selection Choose your exclusive companion from all pets:
•Amphibian Cutie: Horned Frog
•Small Pets: Hamster, Budgerigar, Dutch Rabbit,Gray Squirrel
•Cats: Ginger Cat,Persian Cat,Ragdoll Cat
•Dogs: Pomeranian,Corgi,Toy Poodle,Border Collie,Golden Retriever,Siberian Husky
•Run Your Farm, Play with Friends & Raise More Pets
Start for Free
•New users can claim a Horned Frog as their first pet for free
•Experience the complete pet-raising fun without any initial investment
•Gradually unlock more pets through gameplay interactions
•From One Seed, Grow Endless Food
Simple and Fun Gameplay
•Feeding & Care: Regularly provide food for your pet to maintain their health
•Interactive Bonding: Interact with your pet to increase intimacy
•Task System: Complete daily tasks to earn in-game points and items
•Check-in Rewards: Log in daily to claim benefits
•Friend Referral: Invite friends to raise pets together and earn extra rewards
Game Rewards
•Earn virtual points within the game through active participation
•Unlock rare pets and items by completing specific tasks
•Win generous rewards by participating in limited-time events
Polished Gaming Experience
•Exquisite pet character designs
•Smooth animation performance
•Clean and intuitive user interface
•Regular content updates
Your Own Little Farm
Grow crops, harvest gold coins, and boost your pets' output. Start with 3 plots and expand up to 24 as your farm grows. Plant a variety of crops, water and fertilize them to speed up growth, then sell your harvest for coins to keep your pets fed and producing around the clock. Watch out for weeds — clear them before they cut into your yield. Add more friends to multiply the fun — water their crops for bonus rewards, or sneak in to swipe a share of their harvest. The more friends you have, the more you earn.
Important Notice
ByPet is a purely entertainment-based virtual pet raising game. All pets, items, points, and rewards in the game are virtual items intended solely for gaming entertainment experience, and do not possess monetary attributes or investment value.
Terms of Use:
•Suitable for users aged 18 and above
•Game content and mechanics may be adjusted based on operational needs
•Virtual item values may change
•Some features may require identity verification
•Please allocate your gaming time reasonably and enjoy responsibly
About Us
We are committed to providing users with a relaxing and enjoyable virtual pet raising experience, bringing you moments of warmth and healing in your busy life.
Download ByPet now, claim your first virtual pet for free, and begin your raising journey!
By using this application, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. Please review the detailed terms within the app.
Privacy Policy: http://www.bitpet.cloud/privacy

bluejetty:00022422:ios.description:
Ana Muhtarif Al Khat lets you create beautiful Arabic-style calligraphy with ease! Customize styles, colors, and curves to design stunning calligraphic art—no experience needed. - Use multi-level undo and redo.

- Make the background transparent.
- Save the design as an image that can be used with other applications.
- Save the design as a high-resolution PDF.
- Create designs with different sizes.
- Save designs and open them at any time.
- Export or Import designs.
- Merge two designs to create one design.
- Zoom in or out.
- Add a background image.
- Use a grid for easier positioning of text.
- Rotate the text.
- Flip the text horizontally and vertically.
- Insert multi-line text.
- Select font size, alignment, and line spacing before inserting the text.

bluejetty:00033130:ios.description:
Sun Life Dental (U.S.) is an easy and convenient way to access your Sun Life dental benefits. Everything you need to manage your dental benefits can be found right on your phone and we even offer biometrics or social login so it is fast. It’s just one more way we make health and benefits easier.
With the app you can:
View your plan overview.
Learn more about plan benefits with easy access to your deductible and maximum.
Download your ID card.
No need to keep track of a printed version of your card. You can view and share an electronic ID card right from your phone, send it to your dentist’s office via text or email and save it to your phone’s digital wallet.
Understand what your plan covers
This overview of what is covered by your plan includes coinsurance amounts and frequencies. It will help you be more prepared for your next dental appointment.
Get your claims status.
Quickly check the status of your claims to see how they have been paid. You can even view, save, or send your Explanation of Benefits.
Find a dentist near you.
Locate an in-network provider near you with the click of a button. You can search by location, name, gender or more.

bluejetty:00018682:ios.description:
Descubre la forma más conveniente de disfrutar tu café premium. La App Juan Valdez es el canal principal para unirte a nuestros Amigos Juan Valdez y la herramienta oficial para gestionar tus beneficios, realizar tus pedidos con anticipación y evitar las filas.
Regístrate fácilmente y empieza a disfrutar de todos nuestros productos con la mayor comodidad desde tu iPhone.
Características principales:
• Tu cuenta Amigos Juan Valdez:
Gestiona tus beneficios desde la palma de tu mano. Revisa tu historial de compras, consulta tus visitas, actualiza tus datos y entérate de todas las novedades del programa.
• Paga con Puntos o recarga tu Saldo Prepago:
¡Tú eliges cómo pagar! Utiliza tus Puntos acumulados como medio de pago (parcial o total) para tus pedidos en la App, o recarga tu propia bolsa de Saldo Prepago para realizar tus compras de forma mucho más rápida. También aceptamos tarjetas de crédito y billeteras virtuales.
• Acumula y crece en nuestros niveles:
Por cada $100 COP en compras, acumulas 1 Punto. Según tus visitas, podrás escalar entre nuestros segmentos de lealtad (Amigo, Buen Amigo y Mejor Amigo) para desbloquear promociones exclusivas, puntaje extra, invitaciones a eventos y beneficios de cumpleaños.
• Pedido móvil (Recoger en tienda):
Personaliza tu pedido desde donde estés y llega directo a recogerlo en la zona de entrega de tu tienda más cercana, optimizando tu tiempo y saltándote la fila.
• Encuentra una tienda:
Observa las tiendas cercanas a ti, revisa sus direcciones y horarios de atención antes de hacer tu viaje.

bluejetty:00150339:ios.name: Paparazzi Premiere
bluejetty:00150339:ios.summary: Paparazzi Premiere, powered by Wayroo, is the app that empowers Paparazzi Accessories Consultants to sell to anyone from anywhere. This all-in-one selling solution helps consultants reach customers and make sales through multiple channels,
bluejetty:00150339:ios.description:
Paparazzi Premiere, powered by Wayroo, is the app that empowers Paparazzi Accessories Consultants to sell to anyone from anywhere. This all-in-one selling solution helps consultants reach customers and make sales through multiple channels, either online or in person. In addition, consultants can track inventory, customer data and retail receipts, all from one easy-to-manage app.
From friction-free set up through omnichannel ease, Paparazzi Premiere keeps it simple, giving
consultants the tools they need to boost sales and manage their business.
Paparazzi Premiere App Features
Mobile point-of-sale and invoicing
Once an order is created, Paparazzi Accessories Consultants have the option to accept in-person payment or generate an invoice on demand to send to the customer to pay at their leisure or by the consultant’s chosen due date. Premiere securely processes payments using the highest PCI standards and data encryption available.
Selling inventory has never been simpler. With real-time inventory management connected to back office software, easily add items from wholesale orders to automatically update inventory count, including corporate product images, descriptions, weights, and pricing. Inventory counts update as sales happen, keeping your business running smoothly and customers happy.
Secure payment processing
As a small business owner, collecting payments from customers can be a hassle. That’s where the Paparazzi Premiere app comes in. By leveraging our partnership with ProPay, consultants can accept credit and debit card payments anytime and anywhere. In addition, we help to minimize the security risks associated with credit and debit card payments.
Next-day funding
Once a customer makes a purchase and the payment is cleared, those funds become available to consultants shortly after midnight Mountain Time the very next day (even on the weekends!) The Paparazzi-branded Propay payout cards, also known as the “Pink Card” can be used wherever Mastercard is accepted. Transfers to bank accounts are also available with a small fee.
Reporting
We help keep your business on track. The Paparazzi Premiere app gives insights into customer transactions, so reporting is painless for consultants. 
The Paparazzi Accessories Story 
Paparazzi Accessories was founded in 2011 by sisters Misty and Chani. Their love for jewelry quickly turned into a place where people flocked to buy trendy, classic, and fun accessories without breaking the bank. 
Paparazzi’s affordable price tag gives shoppers the opportunity to experiment with different
styles and colors, and their product diversity means there’s something for every lifestyle, outfit,
and age group.
While Paparazzi Accessories focuses on fun, we believe that our mission to inspire dreams,
empower talents, and encourage others to reach their goals starts with something as simple as
feeling confident in your appearance.
Learn more:
https://twitter.com/paparazziaccess
https://www.facebook.com/PaparazziAccessories
https://www.instagram.com/paparazziaccessories
https://www.youtube.com/@PaparazziAccessories

Fitness is a personal coach to help you reach your goals anytime and anywhere, no matter your level or having equipment. Get fitness motivation and enjoy the variety of workout programs. Get fit, stay in shape, or choose targeted exercises for different body parts by browsing through the vast library with descriptions and videos to avoid injuries.
ANYWHERE AND ANYTIME
Different programs keep it fun: you can choose to do strength training at the gym, bodyweight training at home, or HIIT workouts to burn those calories. Mix it up to achieve your goal faster.
 • Workout collection to train at home with no equipment using your bodyweight.
 • Workouts to train various muscle groups at the gym.
 • High-intensity interval training (HIIT)
COMPLEMENT YOUR ROUTINE
The app has a useful set of features to make your Fitness journey easy and fun:
 • Personal coaching: voice guidance in HIIT workouts lets you stay focused to ensure that you perform exercises correctly.
 • Create your own exercises and add descriptions, notes, and images.
 • Create a personal training plan using the large library of exercises for different muscle groups.
 • Enter weights, sets, and reps in strength workouts to keep the statistics updated.
EXPERT GUIDANCE
Our team is made up of world-class sports professionals in fitness. The female experts with a training experience of over 10 years designed all exercises and programs for all levels to take the guesswork out of your fitness routine and lead you through to the specific results:
 • Workouts to achieve a firm butt, toned legs, abs, and smaller waist, beautiful back, and more. 
 • Library of exercises for women for different muscle groups.
Fitness is integrated with the Health app so you can track your progress and fill in activity rings with Fitness. (additional permissions required).

bluejetty:00023630:ios.name: Theodolite HD
bluejetty:00023630:ios.summary: Theodolite HD is a multi-function viewfinder that combines a compass, two-axis inclinometer, rangefinder, GPS, map, nav calculator, and geo-overlay photo/movie camera into one indispensable app. Theodolite was one of the very first augmente
bluejetty:00023630:ios.description:
Theodolite HD is a multi-function viewfinder that combines a compass, two-axis inclinometer, rangefinder, GPS, map, nav calculator, and geo-overlay photo/movie camera into one indispensable app. Theodolite was one of the very first augmented reality (AR) apps when it was released in 2009, and it’s been downloaded and used by millions of customers since then. Uses are endless, and the app is great for land measurements, outdoor sports, sightseeing, navigation, and finding your way around. Theodolite is a pro grade app and is used extensively by surveyors, geologists, architects, engineers, competitive sportsmen, first responders, military personnel, and search and rescue workers around the world. 
Theodolite lets you take data-overlay photos and movies with 2X-8X zoom. Overlay geographical data, angle markings, date/time, author/company info, and project notes directly on photos and movies for later reference. The same data is written into the metadata record of images, making image files self-contained data records. Third-party apps can tap into Theodolite's advanced camera functions with a camera sharing feature.
View current position on the built-in map with optional offline Outdoors maps that include topo contours, roads, trails, landmarks, campgrounds, ski lifts, and more. Live map markers continually update distance/heading relative to the current location and also show wayfinding info in the main viewfinder. Draw polygons on the map to mark things like property boundaries and trails, and import/export polygon data via KML.
Share map markers and nav calculator points with other users of Theodolite via text messages or e-mail. This powerful capability opens up a wide range of collaborative uses including team land surveying, accident investigations, spotting wild fires, triangulation of landmarks, and advanced tactical observation and targeting. With an optional in-app purchase to enable team tracking, you can share location with up to 20 people on Theodolite's map.
Theodolite includes features for serious users like a reference angle mode, nav calculator, map marker import/export, manual and automatic data logging with CSV and KML export, clipboard integration, %grade display, mil compass readout, optical rangefinders (including a mil-based reticle, sniper-style stadiametric graphs, and a variable 4X-24X scope), and night filters to improve use in dark conditions.
Theodolite can provide location in military grid reference system (MGRS) coordinates, Universal Transverse Mercator (UTM) coordinates, British/Irish National Grids, US National Grid, Maidenhead locator system, Map Grid of Australia, and six latitude/longitude formats. Optional US State Plane coordinates include SPCS27 and SPCS83 zones covering all US States. The optional Datum Pack adds over 230 geodetic datums to the app to improve position computation from GPS data, covering regions and countries on all continents around the world.
AR Layers include navigational aids like the sun, moon, planets, and Polaris (North star), and the optional US Mountain Summits layer that shows over 70,000 US mountain summits in the viewfinder.
Theodolite has been shown in Apple Keynotes, featured on the App Store, and has been a #1 selling Navigation app in App Stores around the world. Since its introduction in 2009, Theodolite has defined augmented reality navigation. The app continually introduces new technologies, pushing the limits of iOS app development and taking advantage of new hardware capabilities.
Find out why Apple named Theodolite one of the most amazing apps available and showed it being used to explore the Great Wall of China. Where will you take it on your next adventure?
Note: Theodolite HD is an iPad app -- see the regular “Theodolite” app for use on an iPhone or iPod Touch. And be sure to check out the all-new "Theodolite for Watch" and put Theodolite on your wrist!

bluejetty:00029976:android.description:
Join in a culinary adventure as you explore new cuisines, locations, and romance in this FREE time-management game! 
Things are finally looking up for you when you get chosen by the famed Chef Alex Reese in a Blind Taste Test Challenge. You can’t help but notice that Alex’s food is as delicious as he is, but Alex has sworn off romance. And what more, you’ve attracted the wrath of Regina Wilton - an unbearably cocky opponent who goes out of her way to make your life miserable. Will she let you fulfill your dreams of becoming a Masterchef? 
Cook delicious food, serve hungry customers and learn new recipes as you unlock unique cuisines. Test your passion for cooking by surviving the kitchen frenzy. Upgrade the kitchen equipment, and renovate the restaurants to gain popularity. Participate in exciting events, and daily challenges to become the Chef Extraordinaire! 
Features: 
- COOK recipes from around the world!
- ENJOY an engaging, heart-warming love story! 
- APPRECIATE the unique art style!
- UNLOCK restaurants, cafes, and bistros as you go along!
- LEARN about new cuisines from dough to desserts!
- UPGRADE the kitchen and equipment! 
- RENOVATE the restaurants to earn fame points! 
- DRESS to impress and stand out amongst the crowd!
- TRYOUT the exciting power-ups! 
- PARTICIPATE in events and challenges!
- INTERACT and SERVE different customers!
Recipes, Rivalry, Romance, and an occasional side of food wars! Dive in and fulfill your dream of starting your cafe. Will you conquer the culinary world? Will Chef Alex and you ever get together? Download Chef Diary - Cooking & Romance and find out.
