bluejetty:00073137:ios.description:
Are you hooked on makeover and dress up games? Do you dream of becoming a makeup artist for princesses? Look no further! Download Lucy: Makeup and Dress up for free and indulge in the most addictive fashion game ever created!
Lucy: Makeup and Dress up is the ultimate beauty salon game for girls. Step into the world of makeovers and unleash your creativity as you transform Lucy into a stunning princess. This girls' makeover game is perfect for those seeking exciting dress up makeup challenges and princess dress up makeover games
Become a stylist and designer as you experiment with various makeup styles and assemble cool outfits for different princesses. With a wide selection of princesses, hairstyles, and fashion dresse, the fun never ends. The makeup salon game offers a plethora of options, from makeup kits to hair types, making it a delightful experience for aspiring fashionistas.
As you dress up and apply makeup in this princess beauty salon game, you'll not only have fun but also learn valuable skills. Improve your color and shape recognition, stimulate creative curiosity, and enhance your aesthetic awareness.
Visit Lucy's Makeup and Dress up to discover a world of beauty and unleash your creativity with mesmerizing makeup styles. The game features multiple princesses to keep you engaged in this never-ending makeover and dress up journey. Create stunning looks by selecting from various hairstyles, makeup kits, and fashion dresses. Let's dress up the princess doll!
So, don't wait any longer! Download Lucy: Makeup and Dress up now and embark on an enchanting adventure filled with fashion and fun!
The game's user interface is designed to be simple, making it accessible to little girls without requiring reading skills. Wolfoo and Lucy are eagerly waiting for you in the makeup salon!
How to Play Lucy: Makeup and Dress up 
Beauty Spa & Face Makeup: Start with a relaxing facial treatment and apply skin care masks. Then, add eye shadow to make the princess's eyes twinkle and apply lipstick for plump lips.
Hair Salon: Choose the desired hairstyle, blow-dry it, change the hair color, and adorn it with lovely accessories.
Nails Design: Select your favorite nail design and nail polish color, then proceed to apply nail polish, add textures, and attach nail accessories.
Hand Decoration: Get creative and choose from various designs like flowers, animals, or even Christmas themes for the back of the princess's hands.
Fashion Dress up: Select a stylish and fashionable outfit, mix and match dresses and clothes, and accessorize with shoes, jewelry, and brilliant crowns to complete the perfect look!
Party maker: Prepare costumes and the party hall is brilliant with gorgeous flowers for princess party
Features of Makeup and Dress up 
Explore 10+ exciting makeup and dress-up games for girls
Access over 100 makeup items, including masks, lipsticks, eye shadows, and more
Dress up and apply makeup to 3 beautiful princesses
Encourage creativity with countless makeup layouts, hairstyles, and fashion outfits
Embark on this marvelous makeover adventure and let your imagination run wild in Lucy: Makeup and Dress up! Download now and join Wolfoo and Lucy on this glamorous journey games for girls!
ABOUT Wolfoo LLC 
All games of Wolfoo LLC stimulate players' curiosity and creativity, bringing engaging educational experiences through the method of “playing while studying, studying while playing”. The online game of Wolfoo LLC is not only educational and humanistic, but it also enables users, especially fans of the Wolfoo animation, to become their favorite characters and come closer to the Wolfoo world. Building on the trust and support from millions of families for Wolfoo, Wolfoo games aim to further spread the love for the Wolfoo brand across the world.

bluejetty:00029749:ios.description:
Baritastic is the # 1 app for bariatric surgery! We also support medically managed (non-surgical) weight loss patients and practitioners. 
You can use the app on your own or connect to your clinic or hospital if they offer you a code. 
Baritatric surgery patients have specific goals, requirements and guidelines before and after surgery. 
And now there is a free app specifically built for bariatric surgery patients.
* Nutrition and Water Tracking
* Reminders - Vitamins, Water, Protein Shakes, Meals, Other
* Bariatric Food, Water, and Bite Timer
* Create a Photo Timeline to Track Your Journey
* Patient Journal - Log thoughts, take pics, rate your hunger and happiness.
* Pre and Post-op Checklists - Stay on task and get to surgery.
* Bariatric Surgery Specific Recipes
* Bariatric Surgery Specific Resources
* Baritastic Social Support Group
* Connect to YOUR Bariatric Program Through the Baritastic App
* Body Mass Index Chart
* and more! 
Whether you are considering weight loss surgery or are already losing weight, this app is for you. Lap Band, gastric bypass, gastric sleeve, gastric balloon, duodenal switch - it's all here. 
* Notes * 
We are always improving the app and appreciate your feedback. 
If your bariatric program hasn't given you a code, ask them for one or tell them about Baritastic and we'll get them set-up.
- Connect with Apple Health Kit to keep track of your steps. Go to Settings Screen >Device and Apps > Connect an App> Apple HealthKit.

bluejetty:00161862:ios.description:
Lumin for iOS allows you to edit and sync to your Google documents in seconds. Collaborate with colleagues in real-time with a diverse set of editing tools.
Lumin auto-saves your changes and syncs them to all your devices. Connect your Google account and stay on top of your documents. You can effortlessly view and share files with anybody via email or shareable links.
TRUSTED BY MILLIONS
Join over 100 million Lumin users worldwide who use our app to edit, share, and collaborate in the cloud. From note-taking and project management to client onboarding and legal document review, Lumin empowers you across industries.
KEY FEATURES
- Seamless document management: Import from your favorite storage (Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive), edit, and share PDFs effortlessly.
- Cloud integration: Automatically save changes and sync across devices.
- Versatile editing tools: Highlight, annotate, draw on PDFs and more.
- Document organization: Organize, extract pages, merge files, convert to/from PDF,...
- Pre-designed templates: Choose from various templates for various purposes and industries, such as real estate, education, job application, etc.
- Collaboration: Share files and receive real-time notifications.
- eSignatures: Sign and fill out forms with ease.
- Scanning: Convert paper documents into portable PDFs.
LUMIN IN THE REVIEWS
“I use Lumin to mark up PDF drawings and send them to my subcontractors. In my role, time is of the essence. Lumin provides me with a tool to make collaboration and feedback easy.” – Construction site manager, US
“We have been using Lumin for a little over two years, and it's been amazing. Using Lumin on-the-go and in-office allows us better turnaround time for our patients' care.” – Director of Services and Operations, US
“It s very useful and handful for studying and I feel like they make good improvements with each upgrade. I use it for studying, it's cool that I can connect my university Google Drive to the Lumin account and I can edit, draw, write, highlight and add comments and they always get saved.” – Individual user
“Too loud. You can open and edit texts from any device, everything is saved automatically, quickly. Access is very fast. The options for editing documents are diverse.” – Individual user
Terms & conditions: https://www.luminpdf.com/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00143623:ios.description:
Siamo un gestore telefonico semplice e trasparente, con un prezzo very piccolo e una grande attenzione alla sostenibilità. Non ci basta essere una low cost: siamo una “love cost”, perché ci impegniamo ogni giorno per darti molto di più. È questo il Very amore.
Scarica subito l’app Very per avere la tua offerta sempre a portata di smartphone.
Con l’app Very puoi:
• attivare la tua SIM in pochi minuti
• sapere quanti Giga hai a disposizione, qual è il tuo credito residuo e quando si rinnova la tua offerta
• ricaricare in pochi tap, utilizzando la tua carta o il tuo conto PayPal, o attivare la ricarica automatica, che ogni mese ti addebita solo il costo di rinnovo della tua offerta e delle eventuali opzioni attive e non un centesimo in più
• verificare addebiti e accrediti e il dettaglio del traffico effettuato
• anticipare il rinnovo della tua offerta se hai già finito i Giga, ricominciando subito a utilizzarla per un nuovo mese al costo di sempre
• gestire con un solo accesso tutte le SIM a te intestate
• passare a un’offerta con più Giga senza alcun costo aggiuntivo per il cambio
• portare il tuo numero di un altro gestore su una SIM Very che hai già attivato
• navigare in 5G full speed con una velocità massima di 2 Gbps e avere ogni mese sconti su cinema e ristoranti, un concorso instant win e tanti altri vantaggi attivando l’opzione Very Plus
• proteggere la tua navigazione dai rischi del web attivando l’opzione Very Protetti
• partecipare al programma Giga Green che trasforma i Giga che usi ogni mese in tanti vantaggi per te e per l'ambiente
Come accedere all’app Very
• Se effettui il primo accesso sotto rete dati non hai bisogno di inserire credenziali, e dalla volta successiva accedi in automatico anche in Wi-Fi sullo stesso dispositivo
• Se il tuo primo accesso è in Wi-Fi ti basta registrarti e selezionare “Ricordami” per non dover più inserire le credenziali a ogni nuovo accesso. La registrazione ti permette anche di accedere da altri dispositivi e di associare all'app più SIM Very a te eventualmente intestate 
Dichiarazione di accessibilità: https://verymobile.it/dichiarazione-di-accessibilita/

bluejetty:00096481:ios.description:
Create a Stunning Aquarium in Merge Aquarium!
Merge Aquarium is a delightful merge puzzle game where you build and decorate your very own massive aquarium. Combine various marine items and decorations to craft a unique underwater space and transform your aquarium into a breathtaking attraction!
- Merge to Decorate and Expand Your Aquarium -
Merge basic marine items to create vibrant fish, beautiful corals, and unique decorations. The more you combine, the more stunning and diverse your aquarium becomes! Show off your creativity as you build a one-of-a-kind underwater world.
- Restore and Expand a Giant Aquarium -
Start with a rundown aquarium and gradually restore each section by adding new species and decorations. Beautify and expand your aquarium, turning it into a popular destination for visitors to admire.
- Participate in Regular Events and Challenges -
Join exciting events and complete special challenges to collect exclusive decorations and rare species. Each event features unique themes and rewards that allow you to make your aquarium even more extraordinary!
- Try the Fish Sorting Mini-Game! -
Take a break from decorating and dive into a unique gameplay experience with the fish sorting puzzle! Sort and organize colorful fish in a fun and relaxing mini-game that challenges your logic and attention to detail. It’s a charming way to enjoy your aquarium in a whole new light!
- Express Your Style with Unique Decorations -
Design your aquarium with a variety of corals, fish, and decorative items to create a masterpiece that reflects your personal style. From vibrant plants to whimsical sculptures, you have endless options to customize your aquarium just the way you like it!
- Become a World-Class Aquarium -
Attract more visitors by designing an aquarium that delights and surprises. Use various decorations and marine species to boost visitor satisfaction, unlock new sections, and watch your aquarium grow into a world-renowned marine paradise!
Build, merge, and create the aquarium of your dreams with Merge Aquarium!
Need assistance? Email us at pivotgameshelp@gmail.com, and we'll be happy to help!

Terms of Service: https://www.pivotgames.net/conf/Terms_of_Service-En.html

bluejetty:00022749:ios.description:
Friendly Social is an elegant companion for posting and browsing across your favorite social media networks! Access your Facebook, Messenger, Instagram, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Reddit, Snap, TikTok and other social accounts all through one powerful browser app. Friendly Social, by Sensor Tower, unlocks the potential of your social media.

- Block ads and trackers on your feed
- Save space on your device
- Preserve your battery

- Easily switch between multiple accounts and networks

- Colorful themes

- Adjustable font size

And don't hesitate to reach out if you need anything

bluejetty:00131388:ios.description:
ReelTrends Analytics is the #1 app for Social Trends.
Join the top influencers using our platform to track, discover and predict Social Trends. With this Analyzer you can find trends first and use these to grow your account and create viral videos. 
Here are some of the awesome features you’ll find that will help you get more views and more followers with your next video:
***Discover Trends***
Find trends that are going viral near you, in your category, with your favorite creators and more! And want to discover new trending sounds to use in your videos? Scroll through our soundboard and find them today!
***Find Personalized Trends For You***
Too many sounds and trends to sort through? We will curate a list of trends just for you to quickly find and use for your next videos.
***Analyze and Predict New Trends***
Use our artificial intelligence algorithms to track, analyze and predict if a trend is going to keep rising, fall soon or if it’s emerging as a new trend you should hop on. We provide you with the stats you need to predict and find new trends.
***Save Sounds and Trends***
Annoyed that you have to try and search for the trending sounds or scroll through all of your favorite sounds when you’re making a video? We have you covered. Easily save the trending sounds and music you like and quickly open them on your social platforms when you’re ready to use them.
***Discover What Trends People in Your Category are Using***
Curious about what trends other beauty gurus, chefs, travel accounts, pets, etc are using to get more views on their videos? We’ll get you the information you need!
***See what trends the top Creators are using***
Want to know what trends Charlie D’Amelio, Addison Rae or even the Sway House are using? We’ll show you the trending songs, sounds and predictions you need to know.
Download for free today and start getting more views on your videos, get more followers and create more viral posts to grow your account!
-----------------------
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by Instagram or Meta

bluejetty:00158371:ios.description:
12 STOREEZ — лаконичные коллекции одежды, обуви и аксессуаров для мужчин и женщин. В приложении — готовые образы от стилистов и комфортная навигация. Вдохновляйтесь и собирайте гардероб, который будет приносить вам удовольствие много лет.
ГЛАВНОЕ — ПОД РУКОЙ
- В приложении удобно следить за заказом и смотреть историю покупок
- Пользователи раньше других узнают о новинках и старте SALE
- С приложением можно быстро авторизоваться на кассе, чтобы списать или накопить бонусы
- А еще здесь можно оформить подарочный сертификат за несколько минут
ПРОСТАЯ НАВИГАЦИЯ
- Переключайтесь между коллекциями для женщин и мужчин в один клик
- «Скоро в продаже» — это модели, которые появятся в магазине в ближайшие дни — подписывайтесь на них, чтобы сразу узнать о поступлении
- В разделе «Подборки» изделия рассортированы по материалам, поводам и погоде — легко сузить поиск и найти то, что нужно прямо сейчас
- «Капсула GI» — это любимые модели креативного директора Ирины Голомаздиной в коллекции 12 STOREEZ 
ВСЕ ОБ ИЗДЕЛИЯХ
- Одним движением увеличьте изображение в карточке и рассмотрите детали 
- Мы указываем обмеры изделий, чтобы вам было проще подобрать свой размер
- А во вкладке «Состав и уход» рассказываем о материале и собираем рекомендации по его стирке или чистке
- Кнопка «Наличие в магазинах» поможет узнать, где можно примерить изделие
- А идеи от стилиста — собрать гармоничный образ с ним
КАК УДОБНО ВАМ
- Вы можете выбрать удобный формат доставки: стандартная курьерская, экспресс-доставка, самовывоз из магазина или из пункта Boxberry
- И подходящий вам способы оплаты: картой онлайн или при получении, или в четыре этапа с помощью сервиса «Долями»
*Цены в приложении 12 STOREEZ отображаются в рублях. Оплата покупки возможна только российской картой.

bluejetty:00118950:ios.description:
Collect field data, submit forms, instantly streamline your workflow with Device Magic - and do it all remotely.
We know how frustrating and time-consuming it can be to fill out form after form when you’re out in the field. It’s messy, it’s unproductive, forms can get lost, and even filled out incorrectly. So we created Device Magic to help you work the way you want to work - quickly, efficiently, and all through your mobile device. 
It’s paperless, it’s stress-free - you can even add pictures to the form you’re filling in and submit it all instantly.
Device Magic is on your side to help you work smarter and save time, so you’re ready for the next job - faster. Now let’s see how Device Magic takes the stress out of forms:
• Reduce admin work - Fill in easy-to-use fields and you can add as much detail as you need 
• Everything you need in one place - Draft forms and outstanding dispatches are saved automatically, so you can keep track of everything
• Work offline - Manage all your forms in your submissions folder (even when you’re offline) 
And you can upload timesheets, input data and even your location to get all the accurate information you and your team need. Do it all on your mobile, wherever you are, at the touch of a button. 
Go paperless, go mobile, go get Device Magic now!
• Downloading the Device Magic app creates a free account which allows you to build and submit forms from your original device
• If you upgrade to a paid account within app, you will be enrolled in a $49.99 US dollars auto-renewed monthly subscription
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• An account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.
To view our Terms & Conditions, please visit: https://www.devicemagic.com/terms-conditions/

bluejetty:00140010:ios.description:
نقدم لكم تطبيق PrestoMan لإدارة طلبات التوصيل بسلاسة وكفاءة!
هل أنت سائق توصيل تتطلع إلى تبسيط عملياتك وتعزيز تجربة التوصيل الخاصة بك؟ لا تبحث أكثر! تم تصميم تطبيق السائق الخاص بنا لتزويدك بالأدوات التي تحتاجها لجعل كل عملية توصيل سهلة.
الميزات الرئيسية:
1. إدارة الطلبات: استلم واعرض وأدر طلبات التوصيل الخاصة بك بسهولة في مكان واحد مريح.
2. تحسين المسار: ودّع التوتر من البحث عن أسرع طريق. يحسب تطبيقنا المسار الأكثر كفاءة لكل عملية توصيل، مما يوفر لك الوقت وتكاليف الوقود.
3. التتبع في الوقت الفعلي: احتفظ بعملائك على اطلاع وسعداء مع تتبع الطلبات في الوقت الفعلي. سيعرفون بالضبط متى يتوقعون استلام طلبهم، مما يحسن تجربتهم العامة.
4. التوصيل بدون تلامس: في عالم اليوم، السلامة هي الأولوية القصوى. يتيح تطبيقنا خيارات التوصيل بدون تلامس، مما يضمن تسليمًا آمنًا وصحيًا.
5. الملاحة داخل التطبيق: تجعل الملاحة المدمجة من السهل اتباع المسار دون التبديل بين التطبيقات. ركز على القيادة بأمان بينما يرشدك تطبيقنا.
6. دعم على مدار الساعة: نحن هنا لمساعدتك عندما تحتاج إلى المساعدة. فريق الدعم المخصص لدينا متاح على مدار الساعة طوال أيام الأسبوع لمعالجة أي مخاوف.
انضم إلى آلاف السائقين الذين اختاروا بالفعل تطبيق السائق الخاص بنا لتبسيط عملية التوصيل الخاصة بهم ورفع جودة خدمتهم. سواء كنت توصل الطعام أو الطرود أو أي شيء بينهما، فإن تطبيقنا هو شريكك الموثوق به على الطريق.
قم بتنزيل التطبيق الآن وابدأ التوصيل بسهولة اليوم!

bluejetty:00123192:ios.description:
Stay productive anytime, anywhere. Don’t wait for your receipts to pile up to treat them. Do it in real-time with Mobilexpense’s mobile App. Designed for large and small companies, the compliance with VAT rates, legal and fiscal regulations in each of our clients’ operating countries enables the users to manage their expenses with no fuss.
*This app is an add-on to Mobilexpense’s existing solutions. It will only be accessible for existing users who activated the mobile functionality*
Once activated, just download the App on your Iphone device to benefit from all the functionalities that you are already using on your computer.
This App enables users of Mobilexpense to:
- Enter and edit expenses, manage attendees
- Enter mileages (**use Google Maps to automatically calculate your mileage)
- Enter and edit allowances
- Upload receipts (**take pictures of your receipts)
- Create, submit or cancel reports
- View the pending expenses
- Approve or reject expense reports and travel requests from other users
** Only for our customers who asked us to activate this functionality

bluejetty:00093144:ios.description:
Scoreo makes keeping score the easiest part of game night. Start any board, card, dice, or party game in seconds, add everyone at the table, enter each round, and always know who is ahead.
More than a basic score counter, Scoreo remembers the game. Save your history, celebrate the winner, and share the story of every comeback after the final round.
PLAY YOUR WAY
• Create custom games and reuse player lists
• Track any points-based scoring system
• Start rounds at any number and count up or down
• Edit a score or remove the last round when needed
• Choose a fast number pad, stepper, or calculator for score entry
KEEP THE TABLE MOVING
• See live standings at a glance
• Track the current dealer
• Use Scoreo on iPhone, iPad, and Mac
• Put scores and graphs on the big screen with AirPlay
• Return to an active game from a Live Activity
REMEMBER EVERY GAME NIGHT
• Search your past games
• Explore interactive graphs and winner trophies
• Share final results with friends and family
SCOREO PLAY
Scoreo Play removes the player limit and unlocks dealer tracking, trophies, additional graphs, stats, and streaks. Choose a monthly, yearly, or lifetime plan.
Scoreo is proudly made by a solo indie developer. I hope it makes your game nights even better!
- Erik

bluejetty:00159504:ios.summary:
YUR makes fitness a game no matter how you like to stay fit. Whether you're playing a VR title or doing an outdoor workout, YUR is designed to keep you motivated by tracking your progress and automatically analyzing activity for you.
You h
bluejetty:00159504:ios.description:
YUR makes fitness a game no matter how you like to stay fit. Whether you're playing a VR title or doing an outdoor workout, YUR is designed to keep you motivated by tracking your progress and automatically analyzing activity for you.
You have 2 ways to get started with YUR:
1) Connect to Apple Health, Google Fit or to your favorite wearable/fitness tracking app to start earning XP, tracking calories burned, heart rate, workout duration, and more. YUR also tracks your steps and rewards you XP for them!
- We are compatible with Apple Watch, Garmin, Fitbit, Strava, and more! (You can check the full list on our support page, http://yur.wiki)
2) If you have a VR headset, download YUR on Steam and then log into our mobile app for the most convenient way to track your progress across all VR activity. 
- Download YUR on Steam Here: https://bit.ly/yursteam (requires a PC)
- Compatible across all VR headsets (Oculus Quest via Air Link)
PLAY GAMES. BURN CALORIES. GET FIT.
Use YUR to track progress doing all sorts of activities such as:
- VR gaming
- Yoga
- Running 
- Walking
- Hiking
- Swimming
- Weightlifting
- Sports
and more!
CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS
Join Public Challenges and see how you stack up on the global stage, or invite your friends to a 1v1 fitness battle to keep each other motivated. 
GAMIFY YOUR FITNESS
Compete against yourself to reach Level 60 each month! We use your biometric data to help to create a goal for you that is both challenging and achievable. 
UNLOCK ACHIEVEMENTS
Unlock unique achievements designed to help you accomplish your activity goals.
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Stay on top of your goals and monitor all of your friends activity.
ANALYZE YOUR ACTIVITY
Get deep insights on your progress and see exactly what activities work best for you through visualizations and daily, weekly, and lifetime stats.

bluejetty:00082062:ios.description:
Looking for a new creative hobby? Play Vacation Home today - a relaxing, fun game that allows you to live the life of an interior decorator. Sharpen your decorating skills in funtastic level and style visually stunning three-dimensional spaces with access to real, high-end furniture and decor brands. Bring your dream homes to life! It’s quick, it’s fun and you can connect with a vibrant creative community while learning about diverse décor styles - thus improving your design skills and gaining inspiration that you can even apply in your real life.
* Unlock rewards as you polish your amazing abilities as an interior decorator. 
* Level up to access dream homes of your very own to design as you wish! 
* Share your creativity and borrow furnishings from your friends when you connect to Facebook. 
PLEASE NOTE: 
- This game is free to play, but you can choose to pay real money for some extra items, which will charge your iTunes account. You can disable in-app purchasing by adjusting your device settings. This game is not intended for children.
- Please buy carefully.
- Advertising appears in this game. This game may permit users to interact with one another (e.g., chat rooms, player to player chat, messaging) depending on the availability of these features. Linking to social networking sites are not intended for persons in violation of the applicable rules of such social networking sites.
- For information about how Protofun Studio collects and uses your data, please read our privacy policy at: https://protofunstudio.blogspot.com/2019/08/privacy-policy.html
- If you have a problem with this game, please use connect protofundev@gmail.com
Terms of Service: https://protofunstudio.blogspot.com/2019/08/terms-of-use-protofun-studio.html

bluejetty:00048203:android.name: QR Hacked? Hack Check
bluejetty:00048203:android.summary: "The ""Hack Check"" app is designed to enhance your QR code scanning experience by providing a layer of security and control that most standard QR readers lack. When you scan a QR code, instead of being automatically directed to the embedde
bluejetty:00048203:android.description:
"The ""Hack Check"" app is designed to enhance your QR code scanning experience by providing a layer of security and control that most standard QR readers lack. When you scan a QR code, instead of being automatically directed to the embedded website, Hack Check presents you with the URL first. This allows you to review and understand where the QR code is taking you before you visit the site, offering a crucial security check to prevent phishing and malicious attacks.
Key features of Hack Check include:
URL Visibility and Editing: Upon scanning a QR code, the app displays the embedded URL. You can then edit this URL, giving you the flexibility to modify the destination address before your browser launches. This is particularly useful in situations where a QR code might redirect to unintended or harmful websites.
Tracking Code Stripping: Hack Check can automatically detect and remove known marketing and tracking codes embedded in URLs. This not only ensures a cleaner browsing experience but also enhances your privacy by preventing marketers from capturing your tracking data.
Preliminary Site Research: Before you proceed to a website, Hack Check offers a feature to conduct quick research on the site’s origin and credibility. This includes looking up the site's location and other pertinent information that can help you decide whether or not to visit the site.
By integrating these features, Hack Check not only protects you from potential cyber threats hidden in QR codes but also gives you greater control over your digital interactions, ensuring a safer and more informed browsing experience."

Do you want to learn English with the help of the most complete and effective method? 
ABA English, the English digital academy, has a plan for you that includes everything you need to learn and speak English successfully: a complete course + live classes + guidance from native teachers. 
Download the app and start today. More than 30 million students around the world have already signed up.
HOW DO YOU LEARN ENGLISH WITH ABA ENGLISH?
Discover a unique and effective method based on immersion: you'll learn English just like you would if you were travelling to London or New York but without having to move a muscle and at your own pace.
LEARN WITH A COMPLETE ENGLISH COURSE
The ABA English course is video-based. It is comprised of 144 units in 6 official levels: from A1, Beginner, to C1 Business. What's more, it also includes live unit review classes.
> ABA FILM
Start each unit with a short video that recreates everyday scenes and conversations, with native English accents and subtitles in your own language. Practise your English pronunciation and listening comprehension.
> THOUSANDS OF EXERCISES
Whatever your level, find online English exercises with the answer keys in order to improve and correct your mistakes. You'll practise all linguistic skill areas: reading, writing, listening and pronunciation. For more advanced levels, there are more complex grammar exercises and other lessons to learn more specific vocabulary in English.
> GRAMMAR VIDEOS
Learn English grammar with the help of the videos our native teachers have prepared for you.
> CERTIFICATES
You'll get an Official ABA English Certificate every time you pass a level. You can share it on LinkedIn via the app.
> A1 TO C1 ENGLISH LEVEL TESTS
You can take a free A1 to C1 level test to make sure you start at the right level for you.
> LIVE GROUP CLASSES
You have access to unit review classes to go over everything you've learnt in the course as well as conversation classes so that you can practise speaking and learn advanced English vocabulary. There are live classes every day and for all levels. 
> PRACTISE WITH MICROLESSONS
Discover new content every day and learn something new in just a few minutes: videos, podcasts, articles, music… you'll love them!
> OUR PLANS
If you're a beginner, you can start for FREE with our Free plan and start seeing your first results. With this plan, you can take the first unit for your level so that you can get to know our method and you'll also get a free grammar video every day. Like this, we'll help you get into the habit of studying English. 
If you want to go a step further and enjoy a more advanced and complete plan, we recommend the Premium plan. With the Premium plan, you have everything included in one price: the complete course + certificates + live classes + microlessons. Unlimited access!
Subscription plans: 3 months, 6 months, 12 months, or 24 months.

bluejetty:00092792:ios.description:

bluejetty:00044992:ios.name: FB Skins
bluejetty:00044992:ios.summary:
FB Skins is a a great companion for Battle Royale enthusiasts, offering a wealth of in-game cosmetics information. The app lets you monitor the item shop updates, check past rotations, and explore the full range of available items.
Feature
bluejetty:00044992:ios.description:
FB Skins is a a great companion for Battle Royale enthusiasts, offering a wealth of in-game cosmetics information. The app lets you monitor the item shop updates, check past rotations, and explore the full range of available items.
Features of our app:
LIVE ITEM SHOP
Stay up to date with the in-game item shop updates in real-time! At 00:00 UTC, the store refreshes, ensuring you’re always in the loop about what’s available for purchase that day.
ITEM DETAILS
Click on any item to access detailed information, including rarity, price, release date, and the last time it appeared in the shop.
SHOP HISTORY
We store data on all item shops since October 2017. Easily browse through any previous store rotation directly within the app.
SET REMINDERS FOR ITEMS
Set reminders for items you're hoping to see again. As soon as they appear in the shop, you’ll get a notification!
UPCOMING ITEMS
Browse a regularly updated list of items soon to be released in the game. With notifications enabled, you’ll be the first to know when new items are added to the shop.
ALL COSMETICS
Want to see every item available in the game? We’ve compiled a complete list of skins, emotes, gliders, and more—over 3,000 items! You can search by item name or filter by rarity and type.
ITEM RANDOMIZER
Generate a random loadout of items to drop into your next game.
Optionally: Select from the items you own and create a random loadout from that selection.
QUIZ MINI GAME:
Test your knowledge with our fun quiz! Answer questions about cosmetics, skins, and in-game events to see how well you know Battle Royale.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION:
Free Trial: Enjoy a 3-day free trial to explore all app features.
Subscription Plan: Weekly subscription only.
Auto-renewal: The subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
Payment Terms: Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase. You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings.
Forfeiture of Trial: Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.
Subscription Includes: Full access to the Wordrush mini-game, quiz challenges, the randomizer, up-to-date skin and cosmetic information, and all additional exclusive features of the app.
Links:
Privacy Policy: https://docs.googl

Have fun and sharpen your brain with Word Magnets - Puzzle Words. It’s really simple, addictive and relaxing at the same time: you just need to pop word bubbles in the right order to put words back together and move on.
Word Magnets - Puzzle Words is a beautiful, immersive and educational word game, which offers unlimited grids, Quizzes, Daily Puzzles, Objectives to achieve, Daily Missions to complete.

Merge and connect syllables together in the right order to pop them all. This word search game is really easy to pick up but the challenge will increase as the levels go with new words to find!
WHY PLAY WORD MAGNETS - PUZZLE WORDS
Word Magnets - Puzzle Words helps develop vocabulary, master spelling, stimulate memory and concentrate. Plus, it's really fun and relaxing!

- POWER-UPS. Use the Fan, Magnifier or Magnet to get a little help when needed.
- FIND BONUS WORDS: Earn more stars by finding bonus words.
- IMPROVE YOUR LEXICAL IQ: Play to keep your brain sharp. Improve your observation, spelling and vocabulary skills.
- FREE TOURNAMENTS. Find every word to score a maximum of stars every weekend. Earn your spot on the highest places of the rankings and get rewards.
- FREE AND NO WIFI NEEDED.

bluejetty:00159351:ios.name: aptihealth
bluejetty:00159351:ios.summary:
aptihealth provides fast, easy access to high-quality mental healthcare to anyone aged 5+ anywhere in New York State. Sign up from your iPhone in minutes and start care within days.
With aptihealth, you'll be matched to a licensed therapis
bluejetty:00159351:ios.description:
aptihealth provides fast, easy access to high-quality mental healthcare to anyone aged 5+ anywhere in New York State. Sign up from your iPhone in minutes and start care within days.
With aptihealth, you'll be matched to a licensed therapist who truly cares about helping you feel better. If recommended, a prescriber may be added to your care team for medication management.
With the app, you're empowered to take control of your scheduling, rescheduling, and assessments on your own (though we're always here to help).
Getting started is easy:
• Sign up in just minutes - Download the app, click Join Now, answer questions about yourself, and schedule your first video session.
• Attend first meeting - An aptihealth behavioral specialist gets to know you and matches you with the right care team based on your goals.
• Start care. Start feeling better. - Meet with your therapist (and prescriber if needed) and progress on a care plan built just for you.
Everything you need to feel better:
• Personalized goal-oriented care - Your goals will be the focus of care to ensure the outcomes you want to achieve.
• Video therapy from a licensed therapist - Online video sessions with your therapist where and when it’s convenient for you.
• Medication management (if needed) - If recommended, a prescriber is added to your care team, and you’ll meet with them via video. Your therapist and prescriber will work together to support you.
• 24/7 support - We provide support anywhere, any time, including direct messaging with your therapist.
aptihealth accepts health insurance, copays may apply. Need help getting started? Call us at (888) 454-3827 or email us at support@aptihealth.com.

Introducing MusicVerse - the ultimate music app designed specifically for Adventist music lovers! With MusicVerse, you can enjoy a vast library of Adventist hymns, Christian songs, and uplifting music.
Our app is designed to make it easy for you to discover new music, with search filters that allow you to refine your results by genre, artist, album, or song title. Plus, you can create your own playlists, save your favorite tracks, and even share them with your friends and family.

Download Color Block: Puzzle Games now and join the block mania fun. Become a block master in the world of color block jam and wood block game challenges.

bluejetty:00171613:ios.name: Welcome to My Home
bluejetty:00171613:ios.summary:
** This game is available only in English. Other languages are not yet supported**
Welcome to My Home! Take a break from your everyday life by crafting and farming at your workshop. 
Welcome to My Home is a heartwarming and charming game
bluejetty:00171613:ios.description:
** This game is available only in English. Other languages are not yet supported**
Welcome to My Home! Take a break from your everyday life by crafting and farming at your workshop. 
Welcome to My Home is a heartwarming and charming game where players are immersed into a delightful world filled with endless opportunities for creativity. Dive into a tranquil and cozy world where you can craft, decorate, and socialize with other players while surrounded by your real-life friends and cute NPCs
Key Features
Relaxing Gameplay: Welcome to My Home offers a cozy and relaxed gaming experience. It's perfect for unwinding after a long day, providing a tranquil escape to a world of charm and coziness.
Crafting and Decorating: Unleash your inner designer and create your dream haven. Collect resources, craft various themed furniture and decorations, and customize not only your cozy corner of the world. Whether it's a cozy cottage, a magical forest retreat, or a beachside paradise, the possibilities are endless. Decorate your home and your avatar too! There are over 200 types of outfits and accessories to dress up in your personal style! 
Socialize with Friends: Connect and collaborate with other players in a friendly and inclusive environment. Visit each other's workshops and join societies and participate in events to foster a sense of community within the game. Meet new friends and society members at the square and timeline, and trade items through the market!
Adorable Animal NPCs: Welcome to My Home has a wide array of cute and endearing animal NPCs. These charming animals will become your virtual companions, showing affection and forming heartwarming bonds with you as you progress in the game.
Quests and Achievements: Embark on heartwarming quests, challenges, and achievements that help you grow within the game. Earn rewards and unlock special items by completing tasks and achieving milestones.
Seasonal Themes: Welcome to My Home regularly introduces seasonal themes and events, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting. From winter wonderlands to tropical escapes, each season brings new crafting recipes, decorations, and challenges.
Welcome to My Home is not just a game; it's a heartwarming and creative social experience. Join the community of like-minded players, craft your perfect haven, and bask in the affectionate company of charming animal NPCs. Immerse

bluejetty:00015237:ios.description:
Write, play and share music, anywhere!
Flat is the sheet music app trusted by 5M+ musicians worldwide. Compose, notate, and collaborate on scores for any instrument, from guitar tabs to full orchestras, across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and your web browser.
Free features include:
→ Quick notation input via touch piano, guitar fretboard, or drum pads
→ 90+ instruments including piano, guitar, violin, saxophone, drums, voice, and more
→ 100K+ original scores in the community
→ Edit music scores on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and in your web browser
→ Hundreds of notation symbols: articulations, dynamics, measures, text, and more
→ Autocompletion when adding chords
→ Transposition by key, interval, or tone
→ Import MusicXML and MIDI files
→ Import PDF sheet music and convert it into fully editable scores
→ Keyboard shortcuts for iPad keyboard and fretboard
→ Share scores publicly or privately
Collaborate in real-time:
→ Real-time collaboration for a dynamic experience
→ Inline comments for live feedback
→ Find collaborators in the Flat community
Share your music:
→ Join the monthly Flat community challenge and win prizes
→ Explore hundreds of thousands of original scores from composers worldwide
→ Get featured and connect with fellow musicians
Subscribe to Flat Power to unlock the full experience across all your devices. Flat Power, premium features:
→ Unlimited cloud storage
→ Automatic sync so your full library stays connected on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and web browser
→ 180+ instruments including high-quality audio
→ Advanced export: individual parts, multi-rest print, remove Flat branding
→ Layout and styles: page dimensions, spacing, chord style, Jazz and Handwritten fonts
→ Custom note heads: Boomwhackers colors, Note Names, Shape-Note (Aiken)
→ Version history: view and revert to any past version of your scores
→ Advanced audio: per-part volume and reverb controls
→ Input notes with MIDI devices (USB and Bluetooth)
→ Autosave with full version history
→ Customizable keyboard shortcuts
→ Priority support
→ PDF and photo import pages included with every plan:
- Monthly plan: 10 PDF import pages/month + full premium features
- Yearly plan: 20 PDF import pages/month + full premium features (best value)
- Lifetime plan: full premium features + 20 PDF import pages (one-time purchase, no renewal)
Terms for in-app payments: Payment will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage and cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited when a subscription is purchased.
Our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy: https://flat.io/help/en/policies
Questions or feedback: ios@flat.io

bluejetty:00063782:ios.description:
Wedding Planner by MyWed is an all-in-one wedding planning app. Download the app and you will be able to: make a guest list, keep track of important tasks, control expenses and manage vendors. Sync all data across devices and plan your wedding with future spouse and family. 
MyWed app is the top wedding planning tool trusted by over 3,000,000 couples all over the world. Try our Wedding Planner and you will be amazed by its possibilities!
SYNC & INVITE
The MyWed app automatically sync all data. Invite partner and organize your wedding together. You can also manage the wedding from different devices. We guarantee the safety and security of your data!
WEDDING GUESTLIST
The app will help you manage your guest list. Add guests and companions, make a seating plan, track meal selections and RSVPs for all your wedding events (bachelorette party, bachelor party, wedding, etc.).
WEDDING CHECKLIST
Our planner will create a personal list of wedding tasks based on your wedding date. You can customize everything for your unique celebration. The Wedding Planner will remind you of the upcoming task.
WEDDING BUDGET
The app will help you stay on budget and save your money. You can control all expenses and always understand when and what you have to pay for.
WEDDING VENDORS
The MyWed app will help you create a list of vendors. Add vendors, link them to expenses, control payments and contact directly with the app.
WEDDING COUNTDOWN
Track the time left until your wedding day. Customize and install stylish widgets to your device.
ONE MORE THING...
1. Wedding Planner is fully customizable: you can add, delete and edit anything you want. You can customize the app using settings and modes.
2. To make your wedding preparations easier, we have translated the app into 11 languages. Prepare for your wedding in your local language.
3. The app will notify you of an upcoming task, payment or event. There is no need to keep everything in mind.
Wedding planning is now easier than ever thanks to MyWed app. Download Wedding Planner and let’s organize your wedding!
If you liked our app, please rate it on App Store! If you have any difficulties or feedback, please contact us via email info@mywed.app.
Privacy Policy: https://mywed.app/legal/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://mywed.app/legal/terms_of_use/

bluejetty:00041736:ios.description:

Pick a letter and it reveals across all five words simultaneously. Work out the theme and you start guessing with intent instead of luck.

bluejetty:00139257:ios.description:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED.
It's a snake-eat-snake world: Slither around the screen to collect energy, grow bigger and devour your competition in this fast-paced arcade game.
You'll start out as a small snake in each round. Eat energy pellets to expand your size, and surround or cut in front of other snakes to explode them into (edible) segments. But watch out — because they'll be trying to do the same to you. In this reptilian battle royale, how long can you stay in one piece?
Netflix members can put their reflexes to the test with this mobile version of the classic .io arcade game played by hundreds of millions. Fine-tuned touch controls give you the precision you need to outmaneuver every other sneaky serpent on the field of battle.
SLITHER, EAT, SURVIVE
• Dart in front of other snakes and watch them explode when they hit you head on — then eat them as fast as you can to bulk up.
• Use the boost button to increase your speed at crucial moments. But deploy it wisely, since you'll lose mass each time you boost.
GET BIG, SCORE BIGGER
• Your score increases with your size; stay alive to thrive and try to set a new personal record with each round.
• Leaderboards let you see how your survival skills stack up with friends and other players.
NEW WAYS TO PLAY
• Complete achievements and daily challenges to add fun and colorful snake skins to your collection.
• Themed live events give you opportunities to take on big, bad boss snakes and unlock exclusive skins.
• Play offline or online; no internet connection required.
- Created by Kooapps.

bluejetty:00145175:ios.description:
World of Jacks is an online multiplayer board and card game for up to 2 players that you can enjoy with your friends and family.
Place chips, block your opponent, and be the first to build winning lines of five on the board.
The game is inspired by classic jack board and card games where you create lines of five chips on a grid of playing cards.
Your goal is to form a connected line of five chips of the same colour in a straight line – up, down, across, or diagonally on the playing board.
This game is also know as "The Crazy Jacks", "One Eyed Jacks" "Jack Foolery", "Wild Jacks" and many more.
The board uses a 100‑card layout with four corner spaces, and the first player to complete 2 winning lines wins the match.
* Play the way you like:
- Single Player – offline mode against an AI bot with Easy, Medium and Hard difficulty.
- Online Multiplayer – real‑time matches against random opponents or your friends.
* FEATURES
- HD graphics and smooth chip animations for a premium board‑game feel.
- Rich sound effects that bring every move to life.
- Challenge Mode with new levels and objectives for five‑in‑a‑row style puzzles.
- Random Player Mode to instantly find opponents online.
- Offline single‑player with three AI levels: Easy, Medium, Hard.
- Inventory shop with new chips, themes, and visual customizations.
- Detailed score cards for both single player and multiplayer to track your stats.
If you enjoy strategy board games, jack card games, or classic five‑in‑a‑row gameplay, this game is made for you.
More features and events are coming soon—share your feedback and suggestions in the review section so we can keep improving.
This game is developed by Gamiverse.

bluejetty:00085637:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00085637:ios.description:
Enable your active life with Suunto app. 
KEY HIGHLIGHTS 
View key training, activity and sleep summaries as well as overall trends to help keep your life in balance. 
Stay connected with notifications 
Customize what you want to see on your sports watch during training and adventures by creating your own sport modes 
Activity-specific heatmaps in Suunto app show you where the most popular routes are, all around the world.
For Suunto 3 Fitness, see your speed and distance as well as your track in the map by using the Suunto app to enable ‘connected’ GPS from your mobile phone. 
Suunto D5, Suunto EON Steel, Suunto EON Core: Transfer your dive logs easily over Bluetooth to your mobile phone after diving.
Connect to your favorite sports services, such as Strava, Endomondo, TrainingPeaks, Relive and more. 
GET THE BASICS 
Suunto app keeps you on top of life and your sports or dives. Keep track of key activity details in your workout summaries and trends in your activity, daily steps, calories and sleep. With Suunto D5, Suunto EON Steel, Suunto EON Core transfer your dive logs to your mobile phone after diving. 
Stay connected with notifications on your sports watch from your mobile phone. For Suunto 3 Fitness, see your speed and distance as well as your track in the map by using the Suunto app to enable ‘connected’ GPS from your mobile phone. 
Ambit3 and Traverse family watches can now sync activities optimize GPS and connect to partner services from the Suunto app. 
ADVENTURE ON THE GO 
When you are going for run or ride and want to change the data you see your sports watch during training, you can customize it directly on Suunto app and it will update automatically to your watch. 
Whether you be in a new city or just a new trail, you can plan your new favorite route with Suunto app, sync it to your watch, and Go! You can even import a .gpx for your next race or adventure (Suunto 9 and Suunto Spartan). 
SHARE AND CONNECT HOW YOU WANT 
The Suunto community is a vibrant and diverse group, sharing inspiring stories and experiences every day. Social sharing on Suunto app is personalizable - select whether you want to share distance, calories, speed, pace, duration, heart rate, ascent, even max speed! It’s up to you! 
You can get additional unique benefits by connecting to our partner sport services such as Strava, TrainingPeaks, Endomondo, and Relive. 
The Suunto app connects with Apple Health. Go to app settings to start sharing your data. 
Learn more about Suunto and our heritage deeply rooted in exploration and adventure since 1936. suunto.com/testedforadventure 
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life

bluejetty:00015185:ios.description:
You never know when an earthquake will strike. So, boys and girls, have you ever known what to do when earthquake strikes? 
Emergence! Earthquake strikes now in BabyBus Town! Animals are in danger now, trapped in home, school, supermarket, street! Hurry up, let’s use earthquake safety tips to keep animals safe. Preparing earthquake emergency backpack, looking for safe place to hide, feed hungry animals trapped in earthquake and more! Are you ready? BabyBus Town Hero.
Earthquake Safety Tips helping kids learn to be safe:
1.Stay calm and be brave when earthquake strikes!
2.Pack up an earthquake emergency backpack with necessities.
3.It happens that you may be on street when earthquake strikes. Don’t be panic! What you need to do is avoiding obstacles quickly, and looking for the open space to keep safe!
4.If you are at home, the best way of being safe is to hide under a strong table, under the bed, or in the bathroom!
5.Help! Earthquake strikes in supermarket, Help panda Kiki hide under the strong counter or the pillar to keep safe.
6.While you are at school, hiding under a strong table is a good choice.
7.Oops! The power is cutting out because of earthquake. Help Kiki turn on the flashlight and find out what you can use in earthquake.
8.Miumiu got injured in earthquake. Let’s help Miumiu! Smear the wound with disinfectant, put on gauze, and bandage it.
9.Miumiu is hungry now. Feed Miumiu some cookies!
10.When earthquake strikes, temperature will be getting cold. Give Miumiu a blanket to keep warm.
11.Whistle loudly. And rescue team will come to help and find you!
12.An emergency contact card that will help you find your mom and dad when you are separated from your family by earthquake. 
Features:
1. 4 similar real-life situations give kids an opportunity to experience a preview of keeping safe in earthquake!
2.Elaborated Earthquake nursery rhymes and cartoons for kids to learn Earthquake Safety Tips more easily!
3.Interesting tests make it more efficient for kids to master Earthquake safety tips.
4.The content of this game has been evaluated by earthquake specialists.
About BabyBus
—————
At BabyBus, we dedicate ourselves to sparking kids' creativity, imagination and curiosity,and designing our products through the kids' perspective to help them explore the world on their own. 
Now BabyBus offers a wide variety of products, videos and other educational content for over 250 million fans from ages 0-8 around the world! We have produced more than 150 children's educational games, 700 children's songs, and animations of various themes spanning the arts, health, and science. 
—————
Contact us: ser@babybus.com
Visit us: https://app.babybus.com

Play the classic and most addictive bubble pop game - Bubble Shooter Panda for FREE, match 3 colors and clear levels. Don’t miss out on this fun relaxing game! In this good old version, you need to aim & shoot, to drop & burst all bubbles. Train your brain with this original puzzle as you blast balls online or offline - anytime! Bubble Shooter Panda? is the most exciting FREE app available

Ready to start the action?
Aim, match and smash all the balls in this relaxing color-matching adventure. This is one of the best shooter games that are simple and easy to learn, perfect for families to enjoy!

Put your strategy skills to the test! Compete against friends and family and see who can reach the highest score and get 3 stars on every level. Earn coins while you play and use them to get cool boosters. Use your logic and puzzle-solving skills to complete the missions and clear the board, and make sure to collect special daily bonuses.

Play the Classic Game Mode - So Simple.
Match 3 balls to blast and clear the board, complete the missions and win coins & awesome rewards. Tap on the screen to drag the laser aim and lift it to take a shot. It’s important to form a strategy according to the different bubbles layout at each level. Shoot and pop all the colored balls in this fun free game, aim carefully and hit the target! Work your way through all the different challenges and puzzles, solve the brain teasers and win levels.

Enjoy the Arcade Game Mode – Never get bored!
Pop the balls in this cool retro mode, and rediscover the classic arcade experience straight on your Android device. Advance along thousands of fun puzzle levels as this addicting game gets even more challenging. Enjoy the retro gaming experience anywhere and whenever you want, no internet connection is required.

Try the Puzzle Game Mode and Discover the Ultimate Bubble Popping Fun!
This shooter is a thrilling balloon popper free app with thousands of challenging puzzles to master. Shoot the colorful balls to advance to the next amazing puzzle level, train your brain and test your matching skills while playing this addictive, casual game for free.
Hurry up and join the balloon crushing mania, but be careful - once you start popping bubbles you simply can’t stop!

Retro game, new features
We took the classic arcade game and added some new features that you’ll definitely love.

FUN FEATURES:
★ 3000 + Exciting levels, with more, added all the time.
★ New elements and great prizes.
★ Brand new effects and sounds.
★ Collect awesome daily rewards.
★ Connect to Facebook and share the fun with friends!
★ Stay in the loop: now you have the best option to send a direct message to support.
★ Leaderboard, challenging achievements.
★ Clear obstacles and beat the challenges.
★ Colorblind mode – so everyone can enjoy fun matching games for free.
★ Pop 7 bubbles in a row to unlock the fireball.
★ Drop 10+ bubbles at once to get a bomb.
★ Play anytime and anywhere, no WiFi connection is required!

What are you waiting for? Warm-up your fingers and start popping. Experience this fun casual shooter and explore thousands of amazing levels filled with puzzles and surprises. Get the online color-matching app and enjoy smooth and addicting gameplay. With so many exciting levels, powerful boosters and awesome features, you simply won’t put it down!

Get ready, take aim and shoot the balls!!

Download and play this fun arcade game for free. It’s the perfect app to play without wifi! Every 2-3 weeks, we add new features and new levels. Come and join the fun!

Bubble Shooter Panda is completely free to play, but some optional in-game items will require payment.

bluejetty:00172127:ios.summary:

• SNAP food benefits 
• TANF cash help 
• Health care benefits (including Medicare Savings Program and Medicaid) 
Manage and view your cases anytime you want – right
bluejetty:00172127:ios.description:
The Your Texas Benefits app is for Texans who have applied for or get: 
• SNAP food benefits 
• TANF cash help 
• Health care benefits (including Medicare Savings Program and Medicaid) 
Manage and view your cases anytime you want – right from your phone. 
Use the app to send us documents we need. 
Get alerts, like when it’s time to renew your benefits. 
Manage your Lone Star Card. 
You also can report changes to your cases and find an office near you. 
To get started, set up a Your Texas Benefits account (if you don’t already have one). 
Here are features you can access once you set up your account: 
View your cases: 
• Check the status of your benefits. 
• See your benefit amounts. 
• Find out if it’s time to renew your benefits. 
Manage account settings: 
• Change your password. 
• Sign up to go paperless and get notices and forms sent to you on the app. 
Send us documents: 
• Attach photos of the documents or forms we need from you and then send them to us. 
Get alerts and view case history: 
• Read messages about your cases. 
• View documents you’ve attached and sent us through the website or app. 
• View any changes you’ve reported. 
Report changes about your: 
• Phone numbers 
• Home and mailing addresses 
• People on your cases 
• Housing costs 
• Utility costs 
• Job information 
Manage your Lone Star Card: 
• View your balance. 
• Track your transaction history. 
• Check your upcoming deposits. 
• Change your PIN. 
• Freeze or replace your stolen or lost card. 
Find an office: 
• Find HHSC benefit offices. 
• Find community partner offices. 
• Search by your current location or ZIP code.

bluejetty:00124331:ios.name: Photo Scan App by Photomyne
bluejetty:00124331:ios.summary:
Bring your family memories back to life with the fastest and easiest way to scan printed photos, slides, negatives, and treasured keepsakes into a digital library spanning generations.
Powered by cutting-edge AI technology, Photomyne trans
bluejetty:00124331:ios.description:
Bring your family memories back to life with the fastest and easiest way to scan printed photos, slides, negatives, and treasured keepsakes into a digital library spanning generations.
Powered by cutting-edge AI technology, Photomyne transforms old photos into beautiful digital memories while making scanning, restoring, and organizing effortless.
Download for free and enjoy a free trial to experience the complete Photomyne Membership before deciding if it's right for you.
SCAN FASTER - PHOTOMYNE DOES THE REST
• Scan multiple printed photos in a single shot
• Digitize entire photo albums in minutes
• Scan photos, slides, negatives, scrapbook pages, kids' artwork, documents, and more
• Automatic edge detection, cropping, rotation, and color correction
• Capture scans with a tap or Voice Control
ORGANIZE YOUR MEMORIES
• Create beautiful digital albums
• Add names, dates, locations, and stories
• Add audio recording
• Scan the back of your photos and keep it attached
• Easily search for photos and rediscover your memories
RESTORE & BRING MEMORIES BACK TO LIFE
Preserve your original scan while creating beautifully enhanced versions using Photomyne's editing tools. For more advanced restorations, optional AI-powered tools are available.
• Sharpen blurry faces in photos
• Colorize black & white photos
• Auto restore faded colors
• Manually edit with color filters
• Remove scratches, tears, glare, shadows, and reflections using optional AI restoration tools (available with AI credits)
AI-POWERED MAGIC
In addition to its core features, Photomyne hosts handpicked external AI tools from trusted platforms to further restore and enhance your memories. These *optional* features include powerful AI enhancements like photo damage repair, subtle motion animations, and more. These advanced AI features use external AI technology and are available separately using AI credits, so you can enjoy even more photo-enhancing magic, all in one place.
SAVE, BACK UP & SHARE
Access your memories anytime, anywhere with a Photomyne Membership.
• Automatically back up your photos to the secure Photomyne Cloud
• Access your memories from your iPhone, iPad, computer, and the web
• Keep your entire library synced across your devices
• Save photos to your device or computer in high resolution and print quality
• Share individual photos, albums, or entire collections with family and friends using simple web links
OPTIONAL IN-APP UPGRADE
A Photomyne Membership includes all premium Photomyne features, including:
• Unlimited scanning
• Unlimited saving and sharing
• Automatic cloud backup to the secure Photomyne Cloud 
• Access your memories from all your devices and on the web
• Keep your library synced across all your devices
• Premium editing tools
• Access to optional AI-powered restoration tools (AI credits required)
Memberships are available as monthly, yearly, and one-time plans.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. If a free trial is offered, you can cancel *at least 24 hours before it ends to avoid being charged*. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings.

bluejetty:00158784:ios.description:
With our new Zedvance app, we've tailored our financial solutions just for you. 
Zedvance Finance Limited, Nigeria's leading non-bank retail lender, is dedicated to offering accessible and innovative money solutions to individuals and businesses. 
With 10 years in operation, we have gained the trust of millions of Nigerians. 
What to expect 
Quick loan – Get an instant loan to cover your unplanned expenses 
Salary Loan – Access a loan to finance your personal aspirations with repayment of up to 18 months. 
Bill Payments - Pay for Airtime, Electricity bill, Internet Data Subscription, with ease 
Mobile Wallet – Experience the convenience of managing your money on the go 
How to start: 
 Download the Zedvance app 
Sign up and open your account 
Update and complete your profile 
Upgrade to tier 2 or 3 by providing the required KYC. 
Start enjoying money solutions made for you. 
Here’s why you’ll love Zedvance: 
24/7 Access - We’ve made access to credit easy and simple. You deserve to experience that. All you have to do is reach out via any of our channels. 
No Hidden Fees! - What you see is what you pay. To go further, Zedvance provides you with a clear breakdown of your transactions- no matter how insignificant! 
Real-time alerts - If it took you less than 2 mins to complete a transaction on Zedvance, it takes less than 5 seconds to get a confirmation on your transaction. 
Security 
Zedvance is regulated by NDPR, and we take your security very seriously. We use highly bank-grade encryption to secure your personal data 
Regulatory 
Zedvance is owned and managed by Zedvance Finance Limited which is fully licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN). 
Privacy & Permissions 
Please read our privacy policy carefully to get a clear understanding of how we collect, use, protect or otherwise handle your Personally Identifiable Information in accordance with our website and app. 
We take privacy seriously - all data you choose to share with us is encrypted and your personal information will never be shared without your consent. Read more on our website: zedvance.com/privacy-policy 
Frequently Asked Questions

T&Cs: https://www.zedvance.com/terms-and-conditions 
For more information, visit our website: zedvance.com

bluejetty:00146912:ios.description:
** This app is a companion app for Spytec and Hapn hardware. 
The Hapn GPS App provides peace of mind through secure, accurate, and reliable GPS tracking software. Our user-friendly platform includes real-time alerts and in-depth insights to better monitor your vehicles, valuables, and loved ones, and anything you choose to track using our trackers.
LATEST FEATURES:
Access your Hapn GPS account using the same credentials used on the web platform or create a new Hapn GPS account for free, and add your devices later.
Track and zoom into all the devices on your account with an edge-to-edge map. 
Select any device to lock in the advanced aerial view of your tracker paired with a smart card that brings you weather info, nearby places, and satellite imagery of your tracker’s location. 
Quickly change between map styles according to your preferences, and toggle on and off smart map objects like boundaries and recent activities.
Scroll through your Activity Feed to know everything about any recent or past activity monitored by your tracker. 
Narrow down your activities by trips, stops, distance, duration, and even by specific tracker, within any date range.
Monitor all the important events with the Alert Feed.
From low battery, speeding, trip details, boundary events, and many more, you can narrow down and sort your alerts by tracker, alert type, and date range.
Receive push notifications based on your configurations and permissions.

bluejetty:00123989:ios.description:
Kakuro is one of the oldest logic grid puzzles. Kakuro is like a crossword puzzle with numbers. Each word must add up to the number provided in the clue above it or to the left. A given number can only be used once in a word. Every kakuro puzzle has one and only solution, and can be solved through logic alone.
Dot Kakuro is a new variant of Kakuro puzzle. No digit can be duplicated in a row or column. If difference between two numbers in neighboring cells equals 1, then they are separated by a dot. If a dot is absent between two white cells, the difference between the numbers in these cells is more than 1.
**** Kakuro Challenge features ****
# Content
- 5 difficulty levels for standard Kakuro puzzles
- 3 sizes for Dot Kakuro puzzles
# Features
- Cheat sheet helps you to solve the puzzle
- Pencil mode
- Hint feature
- Autosave the process of unfinished levels
- Record best completion time for each level

bluejetty:00062058:ios.description:
Cerego mobile is a convenient and easy way to stay on top of your courses and assignments. When you sign into your Cerego account the app will automatically sync all of your course content and display your progress with the material.
Studying on mobile is the most efficient, effective way to learn. Study on the go with the Cerego personalized learning app and see 2X better results!
Learning science shows that short, frequent interactions known as "microlearning" and timeliness are key predictors of better learning. Improve how you learn and retain what you learn with Cerego at your fingertips.

- Personalized to you, Cerego tells you what to study and when to review
- Smart notifications based on your study habits alert you when it’s time to review and ensure you stay on track
- Charts your progress across courses and assignments so that you always know where you stand 
- Provides insights and analytics to highlight your strengths and uncover concepts that need your attention
- Syncs your study progress automatically across all of your devices
- Offline study mode saves your progress when you are not connected to the internet
About Cerego:
Cerego is a learning technology company and the creator of a personalized learning platform that helps people learn faster, remember longer and quantify what they know. Our powerful adaptive learning engine is based on thousands of hours of research in the fields of neuroscience, learning theory, and cognitive science are built into the platform to ensure that every course is completely personalized to you based on your activity on the app.

* All-in-One Solution: Replace multiple tools with one powerful app.
* Efficiency Booster: Cut prep time from days to minutes.
* Personalized AI: No generic templates. We craft answers unique to your background.
* Privacy First: Your data and resume details are strictly protected.

* Professionals seeking career growth or salary jumps.
* Nervous Interviewers who need a confidence boost.
* Anyone looking to optimize their Resume/CV and win more offers.

Questions or feedback? Contact us inside the app.

bluejetty:00131347:ios.summary:
New Description: 
Avenza Maps is a powerful offline navigation app for professional field work. Use offline maps with GPS navigation to stay on track anywhere—no signal required, so you can navigate confidently with precise location awaren
bluejetty:00131347:ios.description:
New Description: 
Avenza Maps is a powerful offline navigation app for professional field work. Use offline maps with GPS navigation to stay on track anywhere—no signal required, so you can navigate confidently with precise location awareness.
Discover and download trail, topographic, land use, utility, nautical, and survey data from trusted publishers, or import your own maps. Avenza supports custom map import, letting you work with PDF maps, GeoPDF®, and GeoTIFF files for reliable navigation both on and off the grid.
Explore trusted outdoor & professional data
Access the largest mobile Map Stores featuring content from:
National Geographic
National Park Service
US Forest Service (USFS)
US Geological Survey (USGS)
NOAA, FAA, BLM, and more
Avenza is widely used by professionals worldwide for surveying, land management, environmental work, GIS field operations, and more. Make your own maps? Import your custom maps and never get lost off the grid.
Maps are available for free or purchase from the in-app Map Store. Plus subscription is available for unlimited custom map imports. Pro subscription is available for professional users with full access to all features and mapping tools.
ENHANCE YOUR MAPS WITH THESE FEATURES 
- Locate your realtime GPS position and find direction, even when offline
- Record GPS tracks during your activities
- Navigate to features using compass tools 
- Add photos and notes to any location
- Add placemarks to your map and style them with recreational symbols
- Measure distances and estimate times
- Supports KML, GPX, and CSV Formats
GET MORE WITH AVENZA MAPS PLUS
For users who need more
- Up to 20 custom PDF, GeoPDF®, and GeoTIFF imports
- Create geofences for up to 50 individual features and up to four geofence layers
GET EVEN MORE WITH AVENZA MAPS PRO
For professionals and organizations who require an offline mapping solution with location awareness with more features and tools
- Unlimited import of your own geospatial PDF, GeoPDF®, and GeoTIFF maps
- GPS averaging, additional coordinate display formats, custom symbol sets
- Connect high-accuracy GPS devices via Bluetooth
- Created unlimited geofences and get global geofence notifications
- Convert tracks to areas
- Map orientation lock
- Import and export Esri® Shapefiles
- Import and manage custom symbology sets
- Priority technical support
Avenza Maps Pro subscription required for commercial, academic, government, and professional use.
Avenza Maps Plus and Pro are available as annual subscriptions. You can subscribe and pay through your Apple ID. Subscriptions are 12 months in duration and will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of your selected plan. Auto-renewal can be turned off in your iTunes Account Settings. If you didn’t use iTunes to subscribe, you can manage your subscription through Avenza.
SUPPORT
We can help! Go to support.avenzamaps.com
LEGAL
Privacy Policy: avenzamaps.com/legal/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: avenzamaps.com/legal/terms.html
CONNECT WITH US

twitter.com/avenzamaps
instagram.com/avenzamaps

bluejetty:00170096:ios.description:
Welcome to Makeover Master, the ultimate home design game that will challenge your brain with addictive match 3 puzzles and give you the satisfaction of designing a wonderful home! 
Get ready to embark on an exciting journey with Elyta and her friends, where you'll match colorful blocks, earn coins, and use them to renovate different rooms in your house. With its engaging storyline and smooth gameplay, Makeover Master is perfect for teens and adults looking for fun and relaxing free puzzle offline games! Play now!
FEATURES
Creative Home Design Gameplay:
• Experience a unique combination of puzzle-solving and home decoration. Use your creativity to pick out furniture, wallpapers, and decorations that match your style and taste!
Various Hidden Areas:
• Design your own house starting from the swimming pool, bedroom, and living room, and discover more exciting areas along the way!
Challenging Match 3 Puzzles:
• Tons of matching puzzles will test your skills and keep you entertained all the time. With classic and trending match 3 gameplay, you'll have to strategize and think ahead to match blocks and clear levels!
And What's More:
• Powerful boosters help you beat difficult levels and progress faster!
• A smooth and addictive gaming experience. Perfect for anxiety relief after a long day!
• 100% free and no wifi needed. An offline game you can play anytime and anywhere without wifi or internet!
Makeover Master is a fun and creative free offline game that will challenge your mind with addictive match 3 puzzles and give you the satisfaction of creating your personalized home. It helps improve your cognitive abilities, spark your creativity, and provide anxiety relief. With its captivating storyline, multiple areas for renovation and decoration, powerful boosters, and offline gameplay, you'll find it's your perfect game to relax and unwind. Any questions? Contact us at makeover@bigcool.com. We value your feedback!
Get Makeover Master for free now and begin your journey of house design makeover!

bluejetty:00168680:ios.description:
Call-On-Doc is a telemedicine platform was designed by medical practitioners with the patients in mind. We utilize a measured balance of technology and safe healthcare practices built on a safe, private, and compliant data-encrypted IT infrastructure. All patient visits and corresponding personal information entries are completely confidential and are secured by the latest data encryption technology. Our platform enables patients to engage with our team of physicians for online medical consultations and prescription medications related to everything from relatively minor issues like ear infections and allergies to more chronic conditions such as diabetes, asthma, and hypertension. We even offer referrals for imaging and lab testing as well as provide prescription refills for existing medications and doctor’s notes!
PRICING
Our mission at Call-On-Doc is to make healthcare affordable and accessible for everyone, that’s why most of our visits cost $39.99, the average price of most insurance carriers co-pays for doctor’s visits. 
BENEFITS
Available 7 days a week including nights, weekends and holidays
No appointments needed, start a visit instantly
Prescriptions to any US pharmacy in 1-2 hours or choose home delivery
Expedited visits available (30 minutes or less)
Over 70 different conditions treated online
Ages 1+
HOW IT WORKS
Choose between an asynchronous visits or a phone visit with a medical provider.
To get medical care from a provider simply select a condition, answer some questions about your medical history and symptoms, then pick-up your prescription from your pharmacy within 1-2 hours.
CONDITIONS WE TREAT
Call-On-Doc treats over 70 conditions online for ages 1+. Our conditions are segregated into categories such as: urgent care (Sick Visit), STDs, Women’s Health, Men’s Health, Primary Care (Chronic Health Management), Mental Health, Dermatology, Lab testing, imaging, prescription refills, doctor’s notes and more!

Monthly installment: IDR 348,247

- Easy registration using your e-KTP, with a limit of up to IDR 30 million*
- Interest starts at 2%* per transaction, can be used on Gojek, GoPay, Tokopedia, and other merchants, and paid in installments

ImmaginAI is using Stable Diffusion to make all of this possible.
