bluejetty:00185744:ios.description:
This is the official mobile app of the Cincinnati Bengals. Make your iPhone or iPod Touch a unique part of your gameday experience for Bengals games. Want to catch breaking news of the team? See real-time statistics for every drive? Watch video-on-demand clips of press conferences and player interviews? Follow postgame blogs and pregame previews of the matchups?
Now, you can stay in touch with the Bengals anytime, anywhere, on your iPhone or iPod Touch.   
Features include: 
– News: Real-time breaking news from the Bengals, previews of upcoming matchups, postgame news and blogs 
– Video: Video-on-demand clips of Bengals press conferences, and coach and player interviews 
– Photos: Gallery of game-time action 
– Stats: Real-time statistics and scores from the official NFL stats engine, head-to-head stats of the matchup, player stats, drive-by-drive stats, box score, out-of-town scores around the league 
– Standings: Division and conference standings 
– Fantasy: Keep track of your favorite fantasy players 
– Depth chart: Shown by offense, defense and special teams 
– Social media: Aggregated twitter of the Bengals official tweets, check in to the stadium on gameday, one-click tweet of all media items, one-click Facebook posting of all media items 
– Schedule: Schedule of upcoming games, and scores/stats of previous games from the season, ticket purchase for games 
– Evolving home-screen: Pregame, in-game, postgame, offseason countdown, draft-day
Follow us @bengals on Twitter for updates or visit bengals.com.
Follow us @yinzcam on Twitter for updates or to ask questions and provide feedback.
Please note: This app features Nielsen's proprietary measurement software which contributes to market research, like Nielsen's TV Ratings. Please see https://priv-policy.imrworldwide.com/priv/mobile/us/en/optout.html for more information.

bluejetty:00068979:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00068979:ios.description:
The app you thought you didn’t need, but realized it’s the one you can’t live without!
What you track and what you repeat, becomes a positive habit! Japa 108 enables you to instill a positive habit in your life through the ancient practice of Mantra repetition, bringing about an uplifting energy and creating an armor around you.
Whether you have an existing Japa practice that you want to track and build on, or if you want a vehicle to help drown out the thoughts in your mind in order to meditate, Japa 108 encourages you to do something for yourself over and over again, until it becomes a natural part of your every day and creates transformation in your life.
Either by using your existing mala or replacing the beads by tapping anywhere on your phone screen, the app will track the counts, mantras and the time that you’ve chanted, providing comprehensive stats to keep you motivated.
The app can be used on and offline and you can use it wherever you are; on a plane, on a train on your way to work, in the car if you're a passenger and even while you're sitting on a park bench, again with or without your mala beads!
By using Japa 108 you instantly become a part of the Japa 108 community. A global community of chanters and like-minded spiritual people who are using Japa mantra chanting to enhance their life. You can encourage your friends by liking and commenting on their feed as well as see a global weekly leaderboard of the top chanters and the top mantras that are being used.
WHAT’S INCLUDED:
•⁠ ⁠Japa Counter and Tracker - what you track, becomes a habit
•⁠ ⁠Personalized Daily Mantra Remedies/recommendations
•⁠ ⁠Daily Mantra Suggestions
•⁠ ⁠Personalized Mantras Based On Your Birth Chart
•⁠ ⁠Mantra Collections
•⁠ Do a Japa journey with one of our Rituals & Challenges
•⁠ ⁠Play audio for mantra pronunciation
•⁠ ⁠Save your favorite mantras to your shortcuts and access them OFFLINE
•⁠ ⁠Pick from many Mantras in the extensive list we’ve curated
•⁠ ⁠Can’t find the Mantra you want on our list? It’s ok, add your own
•⁠ ⁠View Stats - see your Japa streak, number of counts, most chanted mantras ++
•⁠ ⁠Earn Awards for key Japa-counting milestones
•⁠ ⁠See a global real-time feed of the Japa 108 Community
•⁠ ⁠View the top chanters on the Japa 108 Leaderboard
•⁠ ⁠Set Reminders for ‘Time to do Japa’ notifications
•⁠ ⁠Engage with the Japa 108 community by COMMENTING & LIKING their activity
•⁠ ⁠Sattva Meditation app integration - merge your Japa and meditation practice
Your Japa 108 subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Charges for renewal occur within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription. While the current subscription term cannot be canceled, you can manage or turn off auto-renewal in your iTunes account settings at any time.

bluejetty:00096948:ios.description:
Solitaire Word Fun – Where Classic Solitaire Meets Fun Word Puzzles!
Play word games mixed with strategic solitaire games. Sort and match words in satisfying puzzles. From exciting words connecting challenges to relaxing solitaire card games, every level is designed for a quick break or your daily brain workout!

bluejetty:00186336:ios.description:
PCalc is the powerful choice for scientists, engineers, students, programmers, or indeed anybody looking for a feature rich calculator. It includes an optional RPN mode and multi-line display, a choice of button layouts, an extensive set of unit conversions and constants, a paper tape, multiple undo and redo, engineering and scientific notation, as well as support for hexadecimal, octal, and binary calculations.PCalc Lite is a fully functional and free taste of our very popular scientific calculator. It includes an optional RPN mode, multiple undo and redo, unit conversions and constants, as well as two stylish themes and our highly praised design. A great choice for your new iPad!
If you like what you see, the full version has many more settings and themes, a paper tape, engineering and scientific notation, and full support for hexadecimal, octal, and binary calculations. You can also now purchase extra features directly from inside PCalc Lite. Buy them individually, or buy everything.
Includes an Apple Watch app, so you can calculate on your wrist!

bluejetty:00064178:ios.description:
Train your brain with the ultimate Sudoku experience. Thousands of classic number puzzles, anytime, anywhere, fully offline.
Sudoku - Classic & Killer is a polished Sudoku built for iPhone and iPad, designed for quick daily sessions and deep logic training. Whether you are discovering number puzzles for the first time or chasing a personal best on Expert, there is a difficulty and a mode made for you.
SUDOKU FOR EVERY SKILL LEVEL
- Five difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert and Master
- Over 10,000 handcrafted puzzles, each with a single unique solution
- New puzzles added every week
- Daily Challenge with monthly trophies to collect
- Killer Sudoku mode for an extra layer of logic
SMART FEATURES THAT HELP YOU IMPROVE
- Pencil notes to track candidates, just like on paper
- Auto-notes and auto-check to speed up your solving flow
- Explanatory hints that teach technique, not just the answer
- Duplicate highlighting to spot mistakes instantly
- Unlimited undo, redo, pause and resume
A CLEAN, RELAXING DESIGN
- Minimalist interface built for focus
- Light and dark themes for day and night
- Adjustable number size and colour accents
- Distraction-free board with smooth animation
- Sound effects you can switch off
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
- Detailed statistics for every difficulty
- Personal bests, streaks and win rates
- Progress charts as your logic sharpens
- Achievements and milestones
PLAY ANYWHERE
- Fully offline, no connection required
- Made for commutes, flights, waiting rooms and bedtime
- Auto-save, so you never lose a puzzle in progress
- Built for iPhone and iPad, portrait and landscape
WHY PLAY EVERY DAY
Sudoku is a daily workout for your attention. Regular play sharpens memory, builds concentration and gives you that small, satisfying win that makes the rest of the day run smoother.
Download Sudoku - Classic & Killer and start your first puzzle in seconds.

bluejetty:00165021:ios.name: ArtLoop: How to Draw Together
bluejetty:00165021:ios.summary:
Unlock Your Artistic Potential with Our Drawing App!
Discover ArtLoop – a playful drawing game where learning to draw happens through fun, challenges and experiments, not boring lessons. From calm step-by-step tutorials to fast multiplayer
bluejetty:00165021:ios.description:
Unlock Your Artistic Potential with Our Drawing App!
Discover ArtLoop – a playful drawing game where learning to draw happens through fun, challenges and experiments, not boring lessons. From calm step-by-step tutorials to fast multiplayer battles, ArtLoop turns your screen into a creative playground for any skill level.
Draw in Different Styles:
Follow clear, step-by-step tutorials to draw characters, objects, food, animals and more.
Explore a wide variety of styles: from simple doodles and cute cartoons to more detailed illustrations.
Practice at your own pace – repeat drawings, try new colors and build your own gallery of finished artworks.
Pixel Art & Neon Glow:
Pixel Art Mode – create retro-style pictures pixel by pixel, like a tiny digital mosaic.
Neon & Glow Drawings – draw with bright glowing lines on a dark canvas.
Experiment with different looks and turn simple sketches into bold, stylized art.
Dynamic Drawing Modes:
Use dynamic brushes with animated strokes that wobble, pulse and move, making your lines feel alive.
Combine classic drawing with playful effects so every sketch feels fresh and satisfying.
Draw Rush – Speed & Precision:
In Draw Rush, you copy simple shapes and lines as quickly and accurately as you can.
Race against the timer, focus on precision and try to beat your own score in short, intense rounds.
Great for quick drawing challenges when you only have a few minutes.
Art Battle:
Join Art Battle and compete in drawing challenges with friends!
It’s all about fun, creativity and friendly competition – not about being “perfect”.
Fun Challenges, Not Stressful Lessons:
No strict rules, no pressure – just a safe space to experiment and enjoy drawing.
No prior art skills needed: simple guidance helps you start, and varied modes keep you motivated.
User-Friendly Interface:
Enjoy a clean, intuitive interface that keeps the focus on your drawing, not on menus.
The drawing pad is comfortable for both finger and stylus, so you can relax and focus on your lines, colors and ideas.
Paint Offline
Keep drawing even when you’re offline.
Most tutorials and practice modes work without an internet connection, so you can sketch on a trip, in a café or anywhere else.
For Anyone Who Loves to Draw (or Wants to Start)
Whether you’re:
a beginner taking your first steps in digital drawing,
a casual doodler who wants fun challenges, or
a more experienced artist looking for new styles and modes to play with,
ArtLoop gives you a playful way to practice, experiment and grow your skills over time.
Jump into ArtLoop today and turn everyday doodles into a fun drawing habit!
Privacy Policy: https://artloop.netlify.app/privacy-policy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://artloop.netlify.app/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00014302:ios.description:
▶ Los trabajos y las ofertas de empleo comienzan en InfoJobs.
Hacemos que buscar trabajo entre miles de ofertas de empleo se convierta en una experiencia cómoda y sencilla.
Comienza a buscar trabajo en InfoJobs e inscríbete en las ofertas de empleo de los trabajos más afines a tu currículum y experiencia laboral . 
Entra en InfoJobs y encuentra el trabajo perfecto para ti entre miles de ofertas de empleo. ¡Tu nuevo trabajo te espera! Prepara tu currículum y entra en la app líder en ofertas de empleo de España. 
TE RECOMENDAMOS OFERTAS DE EMPLEO Y TRABAJOS A MEDIDA
En función de tu currículum e inscripciones, nuestra app busca en la bolsa de trabajo y te recomienda ofertas de empleo personalizadas. Esos trabajos que no vamos a dejar que se te escapen. 
Nuestro trabajo es ayudarte a encontrar el empleo que quieres. Porque buscar empleo puede ser incluso divertido. Entra en InfoJobs y busca trabajo en las ofertas de empleo que más se ajusten a tu perfil. Entra, inscríbete y sigue tus candidaturas desde el móvil. Y ahora, ¡a encontrar empleo!
▶ ¿CONOCES LOS COOL JOBS DE INFOJOBS?
Buscar trabajo es sencillo, fácil e incluso divertido
Lo más nuevo en ofertas de empleo: Descubre la iniciativa de InfoJobs e inscríbete en las ofertas de empleo más originales llevando a cabo trabajos que jamás podrías imaginar. 
Actualiza tu currículum con tus estudios y trabajos más actuales, las mejores empresas publican aquí sus ofertas de trabajo y buscan, en InfoJobs, perfiles profesionales como el tuyo.
◉ FILTRAS PARA BUSCAR TRABAJO Y ENCUENTRA EL EMPLEO QUE NECESITAS
¡Ahora buscar empleo es tan sencillo como filtrar los resultados para obtener ofertas de empleo más precisas! ¿Buscas un empleo muy concreto?, ¿quieres encontrar un trabajo super específico? Marca lo que quieras: provincia de España, población, categoría (marketing, prácticas, comercial, ingeniero, freelance, turismo...), estudios, tipo de contrato, salario, jornada laboral o experiencia. Encuentra ofertas de empleo a tu medida. Con InfoJobs buscar trabajo es más rápido.
◉ DESCUBRE LOS PERFILES PROFESIONALES DEMANDADOS
¡Miles de trabajos te esperan! Se buscan perfiles con idiomas nativos, becarios y prácticas, comerciales autónomos, freelance, programadores, analistas de datos, dependientes, trabajo temporal, trabajos de verano, primer empleo, etc. Puedes buscar trabajo filtrando tu búsqueda.
◉ INFORMACIÓN DETALLADA DE LAS OFERTAS DE EMPLEO
Para buscar trabajo, conoce los detalles de los anuncios de empleo que más te interesan: nivel del puesto, estudios mínimos, experiencia, tipo de contrato, jornada laboral... Todo lo que necesitas para decidir si ese trabajo es tu trabajo.
◉ INSCRÍBETE A LAS OFERTAS DE EMPLEO Y TRABAJOS QUE TE INTERESEN
Ves una oferta de empleo que te gusta y te inscribes. Con la app de InfoJobs puedes ser el primero en enterarte de los nuevos trabajos que se publican.
◉ BUSCAR EMPLEO ES MÁS FÁCIL Y RÁPIDO
InfoJobs es uno de los portales de ofertas de empleo más conocidos a nivel nacional. Esta plataforma está orientada a la difusión de ofertas y la selección de profesionales para cubrir puestos de trabajo y vacantes para todo tipo de trabajos.
◉ CONSULTA LAS OPINIONES SOBRE EMPRESAS
Para buscar trabajo, descubre qué opinan los empleados sobre sus empresas. Estas opiniones pueden ayudarte a decidir en qué ofertas de empleo inscribirte y así encontrar tu trabajo ideal!
Olvídate de las apps para buscar empleo en España que no tienen ofertas con trabajos para ti. Cualquier momento es bueno para buscar trabajo. Inscríbete a las ofertas de empleo que te interesen. Las mejores oportunidades llegan cuando menos te lo esperas en la bolsa de empleo.
Si tienes alguna duda o sugerencia escríbenos a: reviews@infojobsnet.zendesk.com. 
Con InfoJobs buscar trabajo y empleo es más sencillo. Descarga Infojobs y encuentra el trabajo perfecto.

bluejetty:00169742:ios.description:
Leaf identification helps you to identify plants just by taking a photo of them with your phone. Our AI technology will recognize what plant is this in a snap, very convenient and fast.
You want to inspire your child to learn more about nature and teach them to identify plants, herbs, flowers in the wild? Say no more, this plant identifier app is what you're looking for. You can easily check for the plant even without internet connection. Whether you're working in your garden or going out for a walk, whenever you encounter a beautiful, unknown plant, simply use this app, take a picture and we will tell you everything. 
Main features:
- Flowers, trees, plant scanner with AI technology that will identify plants instantly
- A huge database of plant id
- Plant recognition by genus/family
- Check your plant identification history at any time
- Simple interface, easy to use for everyone
- Easily share your plant identification to any devices
Leaf Identification can identify 20,000+ species with a guaranteed accuracy of 97%. We understand that there are many trees that look alike and their only difference lies in the very small details. Therefore, our AI system is constantly learning so it can identify plants, flowers, herbs,... more accurately and better everyday. 
With Leaf Identification, you can turn your smartphone into a handy plant identifier. Impress your friends and family the next time you go hiking with your collection of plant identification.
Terms of Services: https://rockybrain.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://rockybrain.com/policy/

bluejetty:00077280:ios.description:
TradeLocker is the next-gen day trading platform built by listening to the needs and preferences of over 2.5 million traders.
It's designed to help both novice and experienced users make quick and accurate market decisions.
Experience the future of trading with TradeLocker, featuring high-quality charts and indicators for well-informed decisions, advanced risk management tools such as stop loss and take profit features, and a versatile platform for trading anytime, anywhere, and on any device.
TradeLocker Features:
- TradingView Charting
Gain access to hundreds of customizable charts and custom indicators with our TradingView integration.
- Risk Calculator
Set a SL price and specify the $ amount you are willing to risk and the platform will automatically calculate the order amount.
- SL&TP Calculator
Auto-calculate Stop Loss & Take Profit values in $, %, ticks or the market price.
- Trailing Stop Loss
Unlike a regular stop loss that remains at a set level, a trailing stop loss automatically adjusts if the trade moves in a favourable direction.
- On-Chart Trading
Execute trades directly on the chart for a more streamlined experience.
- One-Click Trading
Streamline your trading and open positions quicker with a single click.
- Micro Lot Trading
Trade a minimum lot size of 0.01 to spread high-volume trading risks.
- Trader-Friendly Interface
 Easily navigate and perform trading activities on our clean, customizable and intuitive interface.
- 500+ Trading Assets
Choose your favorite instrument pairs, including Forex majors, crypto, stocks and shares, metals, indices and more.
How to start using TradeLocker:
Currently, TradeLocker is only accessible via a broker (both Demo and Live accounts) or through a prop firm challenge (Demo).
Not sure which broker to use? Simply go to tradelocker.com, fill out a form and choose available brokers or prop firms.
Once you've chosen a broker, select TradeLocker as your platform of choice and your broker will send you an email with your credentials.
If you're ready to take your trading to the next level, download TradeLocker and join the future of trading.
Let’s connect on Discord where you can chat with our team, discuss potential features, share feedback and exchange experiences with fellow traders.

This app is a suite of trading tools, meant to be used in connection with an account held by a trader with their brokerage firm. If you intend on using this app for real trading, you should understand how various financial products work and the risks you will be undertaking on your own.
By using this app you will have access to information of a general nature (i.e., that does not address the circumstances of any particular individual). If you require further information, or otherwise a more comprehensive or complete statement of the related matters and regulations, you should seek the advice of a lawyer, your brokerage firm, or from a licensed financial service provider before you start trading."

bluejetty:00127891:ios.description:
TALLY is a simple tool to help you track absolutely anything.
Some uses for TALLY:
• Tracking habits
• Tracking medications / vitamins
• Daily planner / to-do list
• Tracking daily/weekly/monthly spending
• Budgeting or saving money
• Pain journal
• Symptom tracking
• Mood tracking
• Finding patterns in your life
Whether you’re trying to track how many times you ate vegetables this week, how many cups of coffee you drank, or whether or not you took your vitamins today, TALLY can help you get where you want to go.
With its simple and encouraging interface, logging activity is a delight. Each TALLY box will tell you the current tracker count and how long it's been since you last logged activity.
Each tracker is fully customizable. Set your tracker to reset every day, week, month, year or never. Use TALLY's charts, calendars, and notes to analyze activity and detect any progress or patterns. The main screen will display all of your trackers. You can use a filter to display your trackers in a way that makes sense to you. 
TALLY is FREE for up to 3 trackers. For more than 3, upgrade to the Premium Version or subscribe to the Growth Bundle.
TALLY Features:
• Quick logging with a Widget and Apple Watch app
• Enter custom values
• Tracking on a daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, or never basis
• Easily view progress with statistics
• Multiple reminders for each tracker
• Fun color options let you customize your list
• Easy to edit activities in the past
• Backup to Dropbox and iCloud
• Shortcuts and Siri Integration
TALLY also integrates with Apple HealthKit. This lets you set and track tallies automatically based on your activity. Ex. if you want to track how many steps you take every day, our HealthKit integration will help you with this by attributing your steps data from HealthKit directly in the app. Building amazing new habits has never been easier!
TALLY contains optional annual subscription. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, for the chosen plan's price. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iTunes/App Store Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://kodeon.ai/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://kodeon.ai/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00184126:ios.summary:

Bu kullanıcı dostu mobil uygulama sayesinde uluslararası pariteler, ser
bluejetty:00184126:ios.description:
Döviz piyasalarındaki anlık değişiklikleri takip etmek artık çok daha kolay! Döviz & Altın ile döviz ve altın piyasalarını kontrol altına alın ve her an güncel kalın. 
Bu kullanıcı dostu mobil uygulama sayesinde uluslararası pariteler, serbest piyasa güncel döviz kurları, güncel ve geçmiş altın kurları, TCMB kurları ve banka döviz kurlarını takip edebilir, anlık para birimi çevirisi yapabilir, geçmiş ve güncel piyasa grafiklerini görüntüleyebilir ve kendi sanal portföyünüzü oluşturabilir, bu portföyü günlük kurlarla takip edebilirsiniz! 
Fiyat Takibi ve Çeviri
Euro fiyatı, dolar fiyatı ve altın, gram altın, çeyrek altın, külçe altın fiyatı gibi yatırım ve ticaret adına önem arz eden konularda analiz ve hesaplama olanağı sunan Döviz&Altın, kullanıcılarına dolar kuru, euro kuru gibi canlı döviz bilgilerini de anlık olarak sağlıyor. 
Döviz & Altın, altın yatırımına adım atmak isteyen, yeni başlayan ya da halihazırda yatırım yapmış olan tüm kullanıcıların tam altın, yarım altın gibi altın türlerine dair güncel altın fiyatlarına ve diğer verilere kolayca ulaşabilmesini sağlıyor. Özellikle altın borsası, altın alış - satışı, altınkaynakları, altın hesabı ve döviz hesabı gibi önemli konularda akıllı bir desteğe ihtiyaç duyanlar için bu bilgiler kritik önem arz ediyor
Anlık döviz çevirisi yapmak istediğinizde, Döviz & Altın size en hızlı ve doğru sonuçları sunuyor. Uygulamanın içindeki döviz çevirici sayesinde istediğiniz döviz cinsini seçerek anlık döviz kurlarını ve dolar TL, euro dolar gibi popüler döviz ikililerini anında, güncel kurlarla birbirine çevirebiliyor ve piyasadaki değişiklikleri sürekli olarak takip edebiliyorsunuz.
Farklı İhtiyaçlar, Tek Çözüm
Basit ama etkili yapısı sayesinde Döviz & Altın,
■ Altın ve döviz piyasalarını takip edenler
■ Düzenli olarak döviz al-sat, altın al sat ve gümüş al-sat gibi işlemler yapanlar
■ Yurtdışında yaşayanlar ve eğitim alan öğrenciler
■ İhracat, ithalat yapanlar ve yabancı para birimleri ile gelir elde edenler
■ Sık sık yurt dışına seyahat edenler
■ Ve turizm sektöründe çalışanlar başta olmak üzere her kesimden kullanıcıya hitap ediyor.
Ayrıca usd, euro ve diğer para birimleri cinsinden döviz borcu olanlar da uygulama sayesinde borçlarını takip edebiliyor ve alacakları finansal kararları anlık olarak şekillendirebiliyor.
Gelişmiş Teknoloji
Döviz & Altın, finansal verilerin güncellenmesi, güncel ve geçmiş döviz kurlarının ve altın fiyatının takibi, anlık alarmlar, hesap makinesi işlevi, grafik çizimi ve görsel veri sunumu için en güncel ve en akıllı mobil uygulama teknolojilerini kullanıyor.
Kişisel ve Kolay Kullanım 
Döviz & Altın'ın eşsiz kullanım kolaylığı ön plana çıkıyor. Basitleştirilmiş ekranlarla karmaşıklığın önüne geçiyor ve yalnızca yaptığınız işe odaklanmanızı sağlıyor.
Kişiselleştirilmiş ekran ve takip listeleri sayesinde ihtiyaçlarınıza özel bir deneyim yaşayabilmenize olanak sağlayan uygulama, sanal portföy takibi özelliği ile de yatırım kararlarınızı geliştirmenize destek oluyor.
Geniş Analizlere Destek
Güncel finans gündemi, günlük döviz, borsa haberleri, piyasa analizleri, altın yorumları, dolar yorumları, merkez bankası politikaları, döviz piyasası endeksleri, döviz fonu ve emtia fiyatları gibi birçok konuda haber takibi yapan bilinçli kullanıcılar, elde ettikleri bilgiyi Döviz & Altın’ın güncel veri takibi imkanı ile fırsatlara çevirebilme imkanı elde ediyor
■ Altın ve döviz dünyasını yakından takip etmek isteyen herkes için ideal bir çözüm olan Döviz & Altın, size güncel ve doğru bilgiler sunarak finansal başarıya giden yolculuğunuzda size rehberlik ediyor ve her adımda yanınızda yer alıyor.

Are you looking for a practice material to prepare for the learner’s license test or driver’s license knowledge test for the Pennsylvania state? Use our Pennsylvania DMV Permit Practice Test to prepare for the Driver’s License test and ace your driver’s permit with ease.
Our app provides questions based on the official manual from the Department of Motor Vehicle (DMV) of the Pennsylvania state. The app includes driver’s permit module for the car, motorcycle and Commercial Driving License CDL. The app is a ready to use study guide material for those who want to prepare for their driver’s license test. Our app can be used to practice for the Car, Motorcycle and CDL Drive’s license.
Followings are the features of Pennsylvania DMV Permit Practice Test app.
QUESTIONS FROM OFFICIAL REFERENCE MATERIAL 
The Pennsylvania DMV Driver’s Manual served as the inspiration for all of the content and questions that have been included in the app. Prepare yourself for the questions that will be on the test by going over them in advance. 
PRACTICE CATEGORY WISE QUESTIONS
The app includes a practice module that allows to get familiar with questions that fall under different categories like Traffic Rules, Road Signs and Rules of Safe driving. It also keeps track of the progress you have made in each category. It contains questions from following categories:
* Traffic Laws
* Road Signs
* Rules of Safe Driving
* CDL endorsements : Hazardous Materials, Schools Bus, Passenger Vehicle, Combination Vehicle, Tankers, Double/Triples
* Pre-trip Inspections
* Air Brakes
MOCK TEST (TEST SIMULATOR)
The application also includes a module that gives you the opportunity to take a test consisting of questions drawn at random from different categories. This section will give you an idea of what to expect from the actual exam that you will be taking.
TEST RESULT
You will get the test result based on the official criteria to pass the Driver’s License Test. You will also be able to find out what questions you've done wrong after taking the test.
TEST HISTORY
The application keeps history of how you have performed in the previous mock tests so that you get an idea of your progress.
CUSTOM TEST CREATOR
You can generate speedy, short quizzes with the help of this application by picking questions from a list of unpracticed questions or by selecting questions that you have previously gotten wrong. You also have the option to choose the total number of questions on the practice test.
QUESTION CHALLENGE
This is a unique feature of our application. It allows you learn while playing a challenge game. Your score will go up by one point each time you correctly answer a question up until the point where you get it wrong. It keeps record of your high score. 
WHY Pennsylvania DMV Permit Practice Test app?
- Over thousands questions designed from the official Pennsylvania DMV manual.
- Practice questions category wise and keep track of how you are progressing.
- Go through the questions you answered wrong.
- Real time test simulator.
- Bookmark questions that you think you want to refer them later on.
- Question Challenge - Learn by playing game.
*Disclaimer:
We are not associated with any government state agency. This app is not intended to be relied upon in any dispute, claim, action, proceeding or for legal advice. For official law descriptions and administrative centres, please consult the respective state body. It is also highly recommended that new drivers take an approved driver education course to learn the rules and laws of the road, and to develop responsible driving habits. We have developed this app to help you to pass the DMV permit test with ease. The questions are designed based on the latest official Driver's handbook. But we do not claim the accuracy of information and this information can not be used in any legal case.

bluejetty:00178747:ios.summary: The world of Fluvsies is a happy place. But bad guys stole a Fluvsies egg! A rainbow unicorn cat Fluvsie hatched from this egg and managed to escape. Now the hero pet is on a mission to rebuild the world and save other little pets. Play Flu
bluejetty:00178747:ios.description:
The world of Fluvsies is a happy place. But bad guys stole a Fluvsies egg! A rainbow unicorn cat Fluvsie hatched from this egg and managed to escape. Now the hero pet is on a mission to rebuild the world and save other little pets. Play Fluvsies Pocket World game and help the little hero! Join the hero adventures, explore the world, solve puzzles, play mini games. Hatch cute pets!
RESCUE LITTLE PETS
Explore the Fluvsies world and find surprise eggs. There are 31 new eggs for you to hatch! Have new adventures with pets. Bring them home and help baby animals hatch! Feed them yummy treats! There are so many new Fluvsies: panda, tiger and even a cactus pet!
PET DRESS UP
Dress up your cute Fluvsies in adorable clothes! Turn Fluvsies into the most stylish little pets! Explore a huge variety of clothing - dresses, costumes, accessories! 
REBUILD THE WORLD & EXPLORE
Sail across the oceans to explore Jungle, Desert, Ice, Fairytale islands. Help hero Fluvise make them nice and safe! Grow plants, build mini houses for baby Fluvsies, decorate, rescue animals and fight the bad guys! 
PLAY MINI GAMES
There is so much to do in the Fluvsies world! Find the items the bad guys stole. Rescue little goldfish! Explore mysterious temples! Help the cute bird to find its nest! Play dress up with Fluvsies! 
GET NEW REWARD
Play and collect diamonds! Rescue animals, water plants, build bridges, find stolen objects and pick up fruit! Play the game every day to get bonus eggs! Complete mini games to collect gift boxes! Collect keys to unlock new locations! 
Play Fluvsies Pocket World – the cutest animal rescue and pet adventure game!

bluejetty:00100789:ios.description:
Key Features:
- New American Standard Bible (NASB 1995)
- Legacy Standard Bible (LSB)
- English Standard Version (ESV)
- New King James Version (NKJV)

- Customized bible text formatting
- Free and offline

- Word search with visual search filtering
- Notes and highlights within verses
- Bookmarks with multiple colors
- Dark mode and color themes
- Passage history
- Free online backup and sync
Literal Word is a quick and powerful Bible app thoughtfully designed for engaging the word of God.
Literal Word exists to promote the word of God and not much else. No ads. No articles. No distractions. Simply the Word. We believe that the Bible contains the most important information that anyone could ever come across and that accessing it should be as easy as possible.
This belief has driven every decision we've made designing Literal Word. The app is 100% free and functional even when you're offline. The NASB 1995, LSB, ESV, NKJV, and KJV translations of the Bible were selected for faithfully utilizing a word-for-word instead of a thought-for-thought translation method. Each passage of the Bible is clean, customizable, and convenient to access, allowing the reader to focus exclusively on the God-breathed content. Word searches are simple but powerful, featuring a unique visual interface for organizing results with precision, and complete lexicons for original Hebrew and Greek words can be viewed with just a couple taps.
It really comes down to the fact that a straightforward approach to a Bible app maximizes attention to the word of God.

bluejetty:00082216:ios.description:
SeaPeople: Marine Weather, Boat Tracker, Trip Planner & Cruising Guide Built by Real Boaters
SeaPeople helps you plan around the weather, discover where to boat, track every journey and build your personal digital logbook, powered by 16 million miles of real boating adventures.
Whether you're heading out for an afternoon cruise, exploring a new anchorage, planning a coastal passage or crossing an ocean, SeaPeople brings marine forecasts and local knowledge together to help you make every trip better.
Marine Weather & Departure Windows
Plan your trip around the conditions that matter to you.
• Explore 10-day forecasts for wind, waves and precipitation
• See hourly forecast detail for the first 48 hours
• Create a route on the map and view weather along your passage
• Set your personal wind and wave limits
• Compare departure windows and see when forecast conditions fall inside or outside your limits
• Compare GFS, the European model and Google WeatherNext to see where forecasts agree and differ
• Export your route and weather as a float plan to share with loved ones
Discover Where to Boat
Explore real boating destinations recommended by the people who've actually been there.
• Discover marinas, anchorages, mooring fields and local favorites
• Find hidden gems and popular destinations
• Browse millions of miles of real boating routes
• Check forecast conditions and shelter at anchorages
• Learn what makes each destination worth visiting with LocalGuide
• See where boaters go before and after every stop with RouteIntelligence
Plan Better Boat Trips
Turn community knowledge into your next adventure.
• Explore routes traveled by other boaters
• Save destinations for future trips
• Build itineraries from real boating activity
• Find stops along the way
• Combine community knowledge with weather forecasts for your planned route
Boat Tracker & Digital Logbook
Track every trip with a single tap. No extra hardware required.
• GPS boat tracking
• Live trip sharing with friends and family
• Distance, speed, duration and route statistics
• Digital logbook for every adventure
• Crew tracking and trip history
• Organize every journey in one place
Share Your Adventures
Bring others along for the journey.
• Share your route and forecast as a float plan before you leave
• Share your location live while underway
• Add photos and updates throughout your trip
• Create a lasting record of every adventure
• Choose who can see your trips and location
Connect with the Boating Community
Join a global community of sailors, cruisers and recreational boaters.
• Connect with nearby boaters
• Join boating groups and conversations
• Exchange local knowledge and recommendations
• Discover new destinations through the experiences of others
Built for Every Boater
Whether you sail, cruise, fish, paddle or explore by powerboat, SeaPeople is your companion for every day on the water.
Built by lifelong mariners and powered by 16 million miles of real boating adventures, SeaPeople combines marine weather, a boat tracker, trip planner, cruising guide, digital logbook and boating community into one app, helping you spend less time searching and more time on the water.
Plan with the weather. Learn from boaters who've been there. Keep every adventure.

bluejetty:00089522:ios.description:
Welcome to the ultimate educational game that transforms you into a rhetoric expert! Dive into the world of persuasive speech, learn the secrets of winning arguments, and become quick-witted with our interactive AI-based learning experience. Whether you're gearing up for a debate, a crucial job conversation, or just want to sharpen your communication skills, Debate Arena is your perfect companion.
Key Features:
- Learn and Master Rhetorical Devices: Uncover an extensive library of rhetorical figures and devices. Understand the power of Straw Man, Ad Hominem Attacks and Red Herring and how to use them effectively.
- Interactive Learning with AI Opponents: Test your skills in engaging challenges against sophisticated AI. Learn by doing and become adept at employing rhetoric in real-time scenarios.
- Discuss current real life events and find the common ground, even if you think there is none.
- Get argument feedback as well as references for your own arguments.
- Real-World Applications: From asking for a raise to acing debates, our scenarios are crafted to help you apply your rhetorical skills in everyday situations.
- Recognition Training: Learn to identify when someone else is using rhetorical devices on you. Stay one step ahead in conversations.
- Quick Wit Development: Enhance your spontaneous speaking abilities. Learn to think on your feet and respond with confidence and flair.
- Career Advancement: Use your newfound rhetorical skills to communicate more effectively in the workplace. Make your case for that well-deserved raise with persuasive prowess.
- Engaging and Fun: Who said learning can't be entertaining? Enjoy a gamified approach to learning rhetoric, complete with rewards, achievements, and more.
Why Debate Arena?
- Win Arguments: Gain the upper hand in debates and discussions.
- Never Lose an Argument Again: Equip yourself with techniques that make your points unbeatable.
- Become Quick-Witted: Respond with agility and wit in any conversation.
- Persuade Effectively: Master the art of persuasion in personal and professional contexts.
Ready to elevate your communication skills and become a master of rhetoric? Download Debate Arena now and start your journey to becoming an eloquent and persuasive speaker!

bluejetty:00023995:ios.description:
If you travel a lot or are going to visit different cities and countries, this quiz is for you!
This quiz dedicated to all travelers and geography lovers! You will have to guess different cities, countries by photo.
Guess the cuisine of the world, as well as flags. Also you will have to answer interesting questions, for example - Which continent is the only one to not have ants? Or In which country is the humble ‘thumbs up’ gesture considered a great insult? You can find out all this in our quiz.
GAME MODES:
Travel by country
You will be shown pictures of different countries of the world, where you have to guess the right answer
Travel by city
You will visit different cities and capitals of the world. Answer correctly to visit the next city.
Country flags
Guess the flags of countries. The game contains both easy and difficult flags of the world.
World Cuisines
The most interesting section of our quiz. You will be shown pictures of different cuisines of the world, which you will have to guess.
Geography test
Answer the geography-related questions correctly.
Traveler's test
Learn new things about the customs of other nations. Answer interesting questions about cities and countries around the world.
FEATURES:
- The game is free and you can play without internet
- Compete in online tournaments with other players.
- Participate in worldwide player rankings
- New quizzes and questions are added with every update
- Play in the quiz as a family!

bluejetty:00140472:ios.description:
PERSONALIZED NEWS
Keep up with the topics that matter most to you.
NOT JUST ARTICLES... MULTI-PERSPECTIVE STORIES
Particle brings you news from many sources and shows multiple perspectives in one place. See the different sides of a story with "Opposite Sides", and understand how a story is being covered with Particle's political spectrum chart.
SUMMARIZED, YOUR WAY
Read the news in summarized bullet points that tell you what you need to know. Choose from different summary styles, like "Explain Like I'm 5", "The 5Ws", or even a different language to help you understand the story in the best way for you. 
DISCOVER RELEVANT PODCASTS 
Particle listens to podcasts to identify key moments, clip them, and place them right inside the stories you're already reading. 
LISTEN TO THE NEWS
Hit "Play" to listen to your personalized feed of news—perfect for your commute or being hands-free!
FOLLOW ANYTHING
Follow people, places, and things to always get news about them right in your feed. Follow journalists and publishers to always see content from them, too. Want it even faster? When something you follow is making news, you can choose to get notified right away.
INTERACTIVE
Need to learn more? Ask a question about any story, and Particle will answer it for you. Browse questions to learn from what others have asked.
DAILY DIGESTS
Get push notifications for your top news every day.
UPGRADE YOUR EXPERIENCE WITH PARTICLE+
Become a premium subscriber for access to even more customization. Premium subscribers get: Custom Summaries, Voice Choice, Private Questions, access to the entire crossword archive, and a variety of App Icons. 
Terms of use: https://particle.news/terms

bluejetty:00039432:ios.description:
Welcome to the Mytrip app!
Our app puts the world in the palm of your hand. Fast, simple, safe and secure–instantly access your booking details and experience real-time updates and notifications so you never miss a flight again. Easily update your booking with baggage and other services from our pre-travel store. Get access to exclusive offers like early check-in for free (a $15 value), plus save up to 70% on flights, hotels rental cars and so much more!
What are you waiting for? Download now and let’s get traveling!  
FREE EARLY CHECK-IN
- Exclusively for our app users, passengers can now check-in for their flight, months in advance – for free! Let us do the hard work for you and we’ll send your boarding pass directly to your mobile device. 
BOOKING INFO AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
- Multiple bookings? No problem! All your bookings in one place–no need to head to the airline’s website or download their apps
- Easily access your booking info. From your reservation details, boarding passes the app has everything you need. Plus you’ll receive real-time notifications on gate or schedule changes in real-time, so you’ll never miss a flight again
BOOK FLIGHTS TO ANY DESTINATION, WORLDWIDE:
- Search and compare more than 650 airlines, big and small, to find the best deal there is.
- Flexible booking options – we get it, changes happen! Choose our Flexible Ticket option and change your flight when you need to.
AVAILABLE FOR A WIDE SELECTION OF BRANDS
- Get your booking info for many popular booking platforms including Gotogate, Supersaver, Supersavertravel, Flybillet, Travelstart, Travelfinder, Goleif, Travelpartner, Seat24, Flygvaruhuset, Avion, Budjet, Trip, Mytrip, Pamediakopes, Airtickets24, Flight Network and FlyFar.
ADD SERVICES ON THE FLY
- Already booked? Travel just the way you want by adding baggage, choosing your seat and more from our pre-travel store. 
PAY YOUR WAY
- Choose from a number of payment options available throughout the world.
FIND AND MAKE RESERVATIONS AT GREAT HOTELS
- The best places, the best prices – with more than 300,000 hotels to choose from, there’s something for everyone.
CHEAP CAR RENTAL ANYWHERE AND ANYTIME
- Search and find great deals on rental cars. Take the scenic route and explore your destination at your leisure.

bluejetty:00122519:ios.description:
Discover the Beobank app. View your latest operations and news from your home page. One-click access to all the most common features.
Not yet a Beobank customer? Become a customer easily in less than three minutes using our app with itsme® .
Are you using the app for the first time? Activate it directly with itsme® or with your username, password and Digipass if you have one. Then log in with your passcode or your Face ID / Touch ID.
With the Beobank app you can:
- view your accounts, cards and transaction history
- manage your budget with our budget management tool
- make transfers (instantly or scheduled) between your accounts or to your beneficiaries
- create, consult and modify your standing orders and direct debits
- consult and pay your invoices via Zoomit
- easy access to Payconiq by Bancontact
- manage transfer limits and debit card limits
- consult all of your documents (account statements, contracts, etc.)
- manage your insurance contracts and report your claims
- manage your securities accounts
- check your loans
- apply for products and follow your requests
- chat with Pixy, our virtual assistant
- contact and make an appointment with your advisor
- validate your purchases securely on the internet via your app
A problem? A question ? Do not hesitate to contact Beobank Service Center on 02 622 20 00 or your branch.
More informations ? Visit www.beobank.be

bluejetty:00122006:ios.description:
History of the fastest and the most furious entertaining Shogi begins here! 
Shogi Wars, officially approved by Japan Shogi Association, is a completely new type of Shogi app with fancy performance, fantastic graphics and the world-class AI. 
This app defies the common wisdom that Shogi is only meant for certain experts, allowing everyone from a novice to an expert to enjoy speedy match-ups online with different time controls: 10MIN, 3MIN, and 10SEC. 
The app also provides offline match-ups with computers. And with the rank (dan/kyu) of Shogi Wars, players can apply for Menjo (dan diploma: from 6 dan to 5 kyu) that is also officially approved by Japan Shogi Association.
So come and experience a high realistic sensation of Shogi.
■Charge
free to 3 battle a day

•Premium ¥600
- unlimited play for monthly
- kishin
•Super Premium ¥960
- unlimited play for monthly

- kishin Quiz

You can restore the status of subscription by logging in with your account at shogiwars.
Please log in to iTunes with the same Apple ID as you purchased subscription before playing Shogi Wars.
■How to turned off auto-renewal subscription
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
https://support.apple.com/ja-jp/HT202039

BETTERHELP: INSURANCE OPTIONS MAY BE AVAILABLE
BetterHelp makes it easy to connect with a licensed therapist online, whether you choose self-pay or explore insurance options that may be available. Where insurance options are available, eligible members may access therapy with an average copay of $23 per session.*
Answer a few questions and get matched with a licensed therapist from our community of over 30,000 based on your needs, preferences, and location.
-------------------------------------------
WHY BETTERHELP?
-------------------------------------------
• Insurance options now available
• Average copay of $23 per session for eligible members
• Over 30,000 licensed, accredited, and experienced therapists
• Match with a therapist based on your needs, preferences, and location
• Message your therapist anytime
• Schedule weekly live video or phone sessions
• Access educational group webinars
• Choose self-pay or explore insurance options that may be available
PROFESSIONAL SUPPORT, TAILORED TO YOU
Finding the right therapist can make a meaningful difference. BetterHelp matches you with a licensed therapist who understands where you are and where you want to go. You can message your therapist anytime and schedule live sessions from wherever you are, online. (Please note: when using insurance, certain BetterHelp features may be limited or unavailable, including chat-based sessions, groups/classes, and select self-help tools.)
LICENSED AND TRAINED THERAPISTS
BetterHelp therapists are licensed professionals with at least 3 years and 1,000 hours of hands-on experience. Our network includes psychologists, marriage and family therapists, clinical social workers, licensed professional counselors, and other similarly credentialed providers. 
All of our therapists hold a Master’s Degree or a Doctoral Degree in their respective fields and have been qualified and certified by their state professional board, having completed the necessary education, exams, training, and practice.
HOW MUCH DOES IT COST?
BetterHelp now offers more payment options, including insurance options that may be available. Insurance availability, coverage, and cost may vary by state, plan, provider network, therapist availability, and deductible status. Eligible members have an average copay of $23 per session.

* Continue watching – pause a video and pick up where you left off across devices

* Listen to articles – press the play button to listen instead
* Customize your text size – make the content bigger or smaller in your profile settings
* Weather where you are – hourly, 10-day forecasts, and frequent video updates
Free to download. Subscribers enjoy unlimited access to breaking news updates, analysis, and more.

Organize your Secret Santa effortlessly with this app!

And here's how it works:
bluejetty:00159302:ios.description:
Organize your Secret Santa effortlessly with this app!
• Ad-free
• No costs
• No email required
• Various Secret Santa variants
• Optional exclusions for Secret Santa partners
• Optional wish lists or gift hints
And here's how it works:
• Create a group with the essential details: meeting location, date, and maximum gift value.
• Share the group with your friends or relatives via a link or group code.
• Once all members have joined the group, the group creator can let the Secret Santa partners be generated.
• Each participant only sees their assigned Secret Santa partner and their wishes.
• Use the integrated chat to discuss gift ideas and event details.
• Meet at the agreed time and place to exchange gifts.
Available on all modern platforms:
Invite people regardless of what smartphone you or they use. Even people without the app can participate.
Secret Santa is a popular gift-giving game, especially during the Advent and Christmas season. There are different variations, but the basic principle remains the same: a group of people exchanges gifts with each other without knowing who will receive a gift from whom.
Each participant randomly draws the name of another person from the group.
The drawn person is then gifted without knowing who the gift is from.
There is often a price limit in advance to ensure the gifts have a similar value.

bluejetty:00120078:ios.description:
EasyMeasure AR brings real-time Augmented Reality (AR) measurements at your fingertips! With years of experience from our App Store Hit EasyMeasure®, we now bring AR to the world of geometry. Height, width, length, area.. EasyMeasure AR does it all! 
EasyMeasure AR analyzes your surroundings to create a virtual representation of the real world. Next, you can simply aim your camera at objects you want to measure and start measuring in real-time augmented reality. Drag your ruler along the sides of objects to measure its dimensions.
UNIQUE FEATURE: When closing a measurement loop, EasyMeasure AR calculates the enclosed area by fitting a flat plane through the measurement points, projecting the points on the plane and determine the area. 
Features
- Measures length, width, height and camera distance to objects up to a distance of 2 meters. For longer-distance measurements, get the original EasyMeasure app
- Measures enclosed planar areas of polygons (upgraded version)
- Supports metric and empirical units
- Take photos of your measurements and share with friends
- Store measurements (photos and dimensions) in the EasyMeasure AR Measurement Album for interactive review
- Export measurements to text files
EasyMeasure AR - Measure the World with Augmented Reality !
NOTE: Measurements taken with EasyMeasure AR are not as accurate as measurements taken with standard tools. Do not use EasyMeasure AR for construction or other uses where inaccurate measurements could cause personal injury or property damage.

bluejetty:00028714:ios.description:
Organize fast and flexible Round Robin tournaments.
This app handles player distribution, court assignments and match generation automatically, so you can focus on playing instead of planning.
Enter the players, choose your format, select the number of courts and start the tournament. The app creates all rounds needed and ensures that everyone plays fair and balanced matches.
Included Formats
Round Robin Singles
Every player meets all other players once. Perfect for single player rotation.
Round Robin Doubles, Fixed Teams
Set predefined teams and let every team face each other once.
Round Robin Doubles, Random Teams (Americano)
All players are paired with everyone else one time. Full coverage without repeats.
Mixed Round Robin
Teams are automatically formed with one woman and one man per team.
Unlimited Doubles
Players can join or leave at any time. Rounds are generated continuously and sit-outs are evenly distributed. Ideal for spontaneous or shifting groups.
Mexicano
Matches are generated based on the current leaderboard so that players meet opponents of similar level. Creates balanced rounds throughout the tournament.
Mixicano
The same matchmaking logic as Mexicano, but every team always contains one man and one woman.
Super Mexicano
Mexicano with an additional scoring system where players earn extra points depending on how close they are to the winning court.
Team Mexicano
Mexicano played with fixed teams instead of rotating partners.
Club Team Round Robin
Players are divided into two teams and face each other over multiple courts using balanced matchups.
Beat the Box
Players start on assigned courts, play three matches, then move to new courts based on performance. Supports 8, 12 or 16 players.
Group Stages – Doubles
Create multiple groups where each group plays its own doubles Round Robin. Every player partners with all others inside the group.
Group Stages – Teams
Organize team-based group play where every team meets all other teams in the group.
Champions League
Play a structured format with up to 36 teams split into groups and subsequent knockout-style play.
Highlights
• Automatic generation of balanced rounds
• Support for many tournament structures and group sizes
• Intelligent court assignment
• Tools for managing player lists and bulk adding names
• Designed for both casual play and organized club events
Whether you run a weekly club session or arrange a larger event, this app gives you a complete and flexible toolkit for Round Robin-based formats.
Terms of Use: https://perkodar.se/terms

bluejetty:00120535:ios.name: River Crossing IQ Logic
bluejetty:00120535:ios.summary: In this fun and challenging game, you will find a complete collection of all known river crossing logic problems, plus some completely new riddles that you will not find anywhere else. If you want brain teasers to improve your IQ while you
bluejetty:00120535:ios.description:
In this fun and challenging game, you will find a complete collection of all known river crossing logic problems, plus some completely new riddles that you will not find anywhere else. If you want brain teasers to improve your IQ while you have fun, you’ve come to the right place.
Chances are that you’ve heard about the ancient river crossing riddles, but do you know them all? You may have heard about the farmer who must take a wolf, a goat, and some cabbage across a river, or a version featuring a fox, a goose, and a bag of beans. Maybe you know the problem of the three missionaries and three cannibals, or the “jealous husbands” variation.
Those are the classic river crossing puzzles. They are popular and well known, and they are all included in this game, along with many more.
River crossing problems date back to at least the ninth century, with the earliest known examples occurring in the Latin manuscript Propositiones ad Acuendos Juvenes (“Problems to Sharpen the Young”).
River crossing puzzles and their many variants represent ways of dressing up relatively straightforward mathematical problems. They invite attempts at a solution that range from trial and error to extensive mathematical analysis. 
These puzzles are frequently used in job interviews. They are also taught to children in schools to boost their IQs and improve their critical thinking, mathematical problem-solving, and strategy development.
Your goal in every level is to move all of the characters across the river while observing certain rules and restrictions. Once you have completed a level, you will receive one star for level completion. You can obtain an additional star if you finish the level in the minimum number of moves, and another if you finish the level in a set time that varies from level to level.
Try your best, work as quickly as you can, and keep your number of moves low to earn more stars. Your total number of stars will help you access more advanced levels.
Download the game now and unlock your brain’s abilities!

bluejetty:00045221:ios.name: Fox Trax
bluejetty:00045221:ios.summary: Fox Rehab app facilitates Fox users by allowing them to send referral orders straight from mobile app. Users can scan the referral document or fill the required information and upload it, where it will be processed and will be assigned by s
bluejetty:00045221:ios.description:
Fox Rehab app facilitates Fox users by allowing them to send referral orders straight from mobile app. Users can scan the referral document or fill the required information and upload it, where it will be processed and will be assigned by supervisor to an indexer. Major Features of Fox app are as:
- Send referral orders on the go.
- Scan and auto detect document and take picture of it.
- Multiple Documents can be uploaded for a single referral.
- Add patient Insurance and address.
- Add patient diagnosis in referral.
- Add procedure information in the referral.
- Create new patient or update patient demographics.
- Manually create the referral, view the final draft and sign it.
- Send message to your fellow colleagues or referral source.
- Create group chat with other users.
Fox Trax for Regional Directors:
Regional Directors can manage their region cases and clinicians using Fox Trax app. 
Regional Directors can do following using app
- View pending assignments of their assigned regions.
- Assign a case to a clinician based on smart suggestion by app.
- Hold a pending assignment case for later assignment.
- View case details and case history for more information.
- View and add notes for particular client.
- Ability to extend the hold on a case.
- Reassign a case to some other clinician.
- Add treatment team member to a cases.
- View the schedule of an assigned clinician.
- View the appointment history of an active client.
- View open issues relevant to a case.
- View and comment on the tasks assigned to them or their region.
- Approve or deny PTO requests.
- Reassign the void appointments during clinician PTO to other clinicians.
- Approve appointment reassign requests by the clinicians.
- View and update their regions clinician information.
Fox Trax for Account Managers:
Account Managers can do following using app
- Account Managers can view pending assignments of their assigned regions.
- Account Managers can view and update patient notes.
- Account Managers can view case details.
- Account Managers can view On Hold cases of their assigned regions.
- Account Managers can view active cases of their region.
- Account Managers can view appointment history of active cases.
- Account Managers can view discharged cases of their region.
- Account Managers have the ability to view and update the tasks assigned to them.
- Account Managers can view open issues of their assigned regions.
- Account Managers can view the Non Admit cases of their region.
- Account Managers can view clinicians and their details for their assigned regions.

bluejetty:00161321:ios.name: MoveInSync
bluejetty:00161321:ios.summary: MoveInSync stands as the world's largest employee commute platform, serving over 400 clients, including 97 Fortune 500 companies. Headquartered in Bangalore, India, MoveInSync pioneered the employee commuting solutions since 2009, offering
bluejetty:00161321:ios.description:
MoveInSync stands as the world's largest employee commute platform, serving over 400 clients, including 97 Fortune 500 companies. Headquartered in Bangalore, India, MoveInSync pioneered the employee commuting solutions since 2009, offering reliable, safe, and sustainable options for enterprises.
The solution empowers organizations to reduce carbon emissions through shared commutes, optimal fleet management, and the adoption of electric vehicles.
MoveInSync One offers a comprehensive employee transport solution, integrating fleet, technology, and operations. With over 7200 vehicles, including 925 EVs, we prioritize reliability, safety, and sustainability. Seamlessly integrating our fleet with cutting-edge technology and top-notch operational delivery, we provide an unparalleled way for clients to manage their operations.
The SaaS solution automates employees' office commutes, corporate car rentals, and workplace management (www.workinsync.io). It identifies and mitigates risks, ensures ESG compliance, and enhances employee satisfaction. It manages cabs, EVs, and shuttles for various travel needs, featuring scheduling, routing, tracking, billing, safety, security, compliance, and reporting.
MoveInSync has earned numerous awards, including Deloitte India Technology Fast 50 - 2023, G2 Best India Software Companies for 2023, and Mint W3 Future of Work Disruptor 2021.
With MoveInSync, whether managing your workplace or employee commute, everything becomes more straightforward. This single app can transform your workplace for the better.
Please Note: Register on the app using the mobile number or email available in your office records. Kindly reach out to your organisation's Transport Manager, Facility Manager or HR Manager in case you face any problem in registration on the app.

bluejetty:00131799:ios.name: Tempo - Metronome with Setlist
bluejetty:00131799:ios.summary: Tempo is the bestselling and most accurate metronome on the App Store. Featured as "New and Noteworthy" and "Staff Favorite" by Apple on the main iTunes landing page. If you'll like to try Tempo out before purchasing, download Tempo Lite fo
bluejetty:00131799:ios.description:
Tempo is the bestselling and most accurate metronome on the App Store. Featured as "New and Noteworthy" and "Staff Favorite" by Apple on the main iTunes landing page. If you'll like to try Tempo out before purchasing, download Tempo Lite for free now.
Ever since its release, Tempo has been consistently in the top 100 of the Music category in over 30 countries, and the top paid metronome app in most countries. Tempo's engine is written from the ground up for high accuracy and stability. It keeps going even in device lock mode, making it a useful aid for live drumming.
Tempo features an innovative interface that morphs between modes that each presents a different combination of functionalities optimized for the task at hand. Five modes are available on the iPhone: Basic, Preset, Setlist, Practice and Gig. On the iPad, Preset, Gig and Complete modes are available, the last providing access to all controls.
Visit www.frozenape.com for demo videos.
Features Summary
Configuration
• 35 different time signatures, including compound and complex meters: 1-13/2, 1-13/4, 3/8, 5/8(2 variations), 6/8, 7/8(3 variations), 9/8, 12/8 
• 6 rhythm patterns for simple meters and 3 for compound meters 
• Customize accents or turn beats off to create more complex rhythms
• Tap tempo function 
• Tempo ranges from 10 to 800
Display
• Visual feedback in the form of pulsating LEDs
• Two pendulum types, each with two animation types
• Flash whole screen
• Fullscreen display mode with gesture controls
Setlists
• Store presets in multiple setlists 
• Advanced setlist management including search, overwriting, copying between setlists and multi-deletion
• Quick editing
• Share setlists via email 
• Backup via iTunes File Sharing 
Tracker and Automator
• Track number of bars played or time your practice
• Stop playback automatically when limit reached
• Up to 2 bars of voice count in
• Automatic adjustment of tempo every n number of bars or n amount of time
• Loop and auto advance through setlists
• Coach Mode alternates between unmuted and muted bars
Sound
• Choose from 14 sound sets, including one optimized for live drumming click tracks 
• Voice counting 
• Vibration mode
• Pan audio left, right or centered
• Volume control and mute button
Control
• Control setlists, tempo and playback with AirTurn, iRig BlueBoard, PageFlip Cicada, headphones remote and other accessories
• Assign action to proximity sensor trigger
Miscellaneous
• Classical metronome and Italian tempo markings 
• Pitch pipe for playback of all 12 chromatic pitches (calibration from A = 414 to 466 Hz)
• Multi-tasking support: plays in background, with audio from other apps
• Four color themes
• Theme Editor to create unlimited custom themes

bluejetty:00140935:ios.description:
Experience the ease and convenience of managing your boat reservations with the new Freedom Boat Club app. Designed exclusively for Freedom members, this app puts everything you need to plan your next trip in the palm of your hand.
Not a member? You’re missing out. Visit freedomboatclub.com to explore membership options and discover how easy it is to enjoy Freedom on the water.
BOOK WITH EASE
Reserve your next trip directly from your iPhone, whether you're at home or on the go. Making a reservation is a breeze with quick and easy options customized to your boating preferences. Your homepage displays recently visited and nearby locations, as well as your total reservation count for easy tracking.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR SEARCH
Start your adventure by customizing your search. Select the date, your desired location and vessel type for your upcoming outings. The app helps you easily find a boat that matches your search criteria by displaying the available boats at nearby locations. Simply choose from the available options to finalize your boat selection and confirm your trip.
BROWSE THE FLEET
Our app helps you find the right boat faster than ever. Easily browse our fleet of premium, award-winning boats including bow riders, pontoons, center consoles, deck boats, and more. With detailed vessel information at your fingertips, you can confidently select the right make and model for your boating adventures.
MANAGE YOUR ACCOUNT
Managing your reservations on the app is simple. You can view upcoming and past trips, add them to your calendar, update the reservation time, and access trip details—all from one place. Need to adjust your plans? You can modify your existing boat reservations directly in the app.
Intuitive account management offers full control over your membership. Easily update your contact information, manage payment methods, and keep everything organized for a seamless experience.
COMING SOON
Waitlist: It’ll soon be possible to join the waitlist for a particular date, time, and vessel at your desired location.
Ready to book your next on-water adventure? Download the Freedom Boat Club app today and discover how easy and convenient boating can really be!

bluejetty:00161442:ios.description:
Start your day with God: today’s devotional, the whole Bible, the Psalm of the Day and a prayer. Daily Devotional is the Christian app for building the habit of reading the Word, one day at a time.
WHAT WALKS WITH YOU EACH DAY
• Today’s devotional: a short meditation in three steps (passage, devotional and prayer) to bring God’s Word into everyday life.
• The Bible in English: read any book and chapter of the Berean Standard Bible, save your favorite verses and share them with anyone.
• Verse of the Day, Psalm of the Day and Word for Today: three ways to start the morning with Scripture.
• Devotionals by topic: anxiety, prayer, perseverance, forgiveness, gratitude and many more.
• Reading Plans: guided devotional journeys of 3 to 21 days for every season of life.
• Spiritual Thermometer and personal journal: a private place to say how you really are, and to see your walk over time.
• Ask the Bible: ask your question and get an answer grounded in Scripture.
• Gentle reminders: you choose the time and the app keeps you company, without guilt.
WHY DAILY DEVOTIONAL
• Easy to use: simple navigation to reach the verse, the devotional or the Bible quickly.
• Made for your routine: today’s devotional in under two minutes, at the time you choose.
• To grow in faith: messages that build you up and bring you closer to God every day.
FREE FOR EVERYONE
Daily Devotional is free. Your Plus subscription removes ads, unlocks every Reading Plan and keeps the devotional free for those who can’t pay.
Download it today and strengthen your walk with God, one day at a time.

bluejetty:00073994:ios.description:
Another awesome word-search game from David L. Hoyt- the most-syndicated daily word puzzle creator in the world!
Word search like you’ve never seen it before with this great new app from the author of "Jumble" and inventor of "Just 2 Words", "USA Today Word Roundup" and many more great word games.
* 9,500+ FREE word-search puzzles, and more on the way!
* Two fantastic DAILY GAMES to keep your brain in shape.
* HAND-CRAFTED by David L. Hoyt: All puzzles are written by the world’s top puzzle creator.
* Traditional WORD SEARCH taken to a whole new level.
* Daily REWARDS and lots of BONUSES!
* Tons of great THEMES and puzzle FORMATS- there’s always something new to discover.
* More than just lists- find words to answer trivia, solve crosswords and MUCH, MUCH MORE!

David is the inventor of many word search games- you might have even played a word puzzle of his and not even have realized it! "Boggle BrainBusters", for example, is the original word link game, and there are so many word hunt and find the word games in the "Word Roundup" family of games that David has truly earned his title of "The Man Who Puzzles the World".
If you’re a word finder looking for your new favorite free game, your search is over! “Word Search World Traveler” is the top game for you- it is word search + so much more.

bluejetty:00015311:ios.name: Ice Cream Truck: Dessert Sim
bluejetty:00015311:ios.summary:
Build Your Dream Ice Cream Truck and Explore the Town!
Dive into the world of dessert logistics. From assembling the nuts and bolts of your truck to managing fruit inventory, this app offers a complete tycoon experience.
[Language: Tradit
bluejetty:00015311:ios.description:
Build Your Dream Ice Cream Truck and Explore the Town!
Dive into the world of dessert logistics. From assembling the nuts and bolts of your truck to managing fruit inventory, this app offers a complete tycoon experience.
[Language: Traditional Chinese] 
This app features Traditional Chinese text and voiceovers.
Visual Learning: Explore the detailed anatomy of an ice cream truck.
Structure Recognition: Learn the specific terms for vehicle parts (like the "Window Awning" or "Rooftop Cone") with clear Traditional Chinese labels.
[Game Features] 
● Factory Simulation: Start from scratch in the "Car Maker" workshop. Assemble the chassis, body, and decorative elements to build a functional vehicle.
● Inventory Management: Visit the Fruit Market and Candy Shop to stock up on fresh ingredients like apples, strawberries, and candies. Unlock new items as you progress!
● Creative Design: Customize your truck with unique patterns, colors, and toppings. Make it stand out in the neighborhood.
● Business Tycoon: Drive your finished truck to the town, park perfectly, and serve soft-serve ice cream to waiting customers.
● Immersive Audio: Enjoy realistic sound effects and Traditional Chinese voice prompts.
[How to Play]
Assembly: Drag and drop parts to construct the truck. Watch as the Chinese labels appear to teach you the structure names.
Shopping: Purchase necessary ingredients from the store using your checklist.
Decoration: Apply your favorite theme to the vehicle.
Service: Drive to the destination and start your sales!
Download now and start your engine! The sweetest adventure awaits.
Contact us:
E-mail: support@iappsteam.com
Website: http://www.iappsteam.com

bluejetty:00061277:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00061277:ios.description:
Hail Recon is the mobile hail reconnaissance companion app for your Interactive Hail Maps subscription. Features include:
Forensic Level Hail Maps
- Radar accurate hail swaths allow you to pinpoint where the hail fell in ten highly accurate levels, ranging from ½” to over 3” hail in ¼” increments.
- Location indicator lets you see exactly where you are in relationship to the hail swath.
- Hail Finder allows you to find hail storms based on map location - just zoom to any specific location and tap “Find Hail in Current Map”.
- On-the-ground hail reports confirms hail size and intensity with storm spotter measured hail hitting the ground. 
- View road map, satellite, and hybrid view by tapping the button at the bottom right corner of the map, then select one of the three map modes: Standard; Satellite; and Hybrid.
Address Markers
- Hail Recon makes it easy to take notes while you are in the field. 
- View where you’ve already canvassed, and where you’ve not yet been. 
- Drop a marker at your current location, or press the map for a second and it will drop there.
- Indicate damage severity, hail size, wind damage and comments.
- Drop a marker at a prospecting location and tap to get driving directions.
- Find any address - tap the button at the bottom-right corner of the map screen to enter an address to find, and Hail Recon will drop a marker at that address on the map.
- Generate, view, and email a comprehensive hail impact report based on any of your address markers.
- Review your address markers on the app or on the full screen maps.
- Your address markers are private to your account and cannot be seen by anyone else.
Push Notification Hail Alerts
- Alerts play different sounds for small, medium, and large hail reports.
- Each account may have any number of devices subscribed to your hail alerts - just sign in on the device once, and you’re set!
- Pause your alerts anytime with just a tap!
- Integrates with your Interactive Hail Maps subscription for access to all historical storm dates (over four years)
Keywords: hail, hail map, hail reports, storm reports

Have fun and train your brain with one of the most downloaded sudoku apps in the AppStore! Millions of people play sudoku daily and it’s truly a game for everyone! The Sudoku.com app has thousands of classic sudoku puzzles to help you keep your brain active, unwind from stress or relax. Install to play now!
Classic sudoku for beginners and advanced players. Whether you'd like to relax or keep your mind active – pass the time in a pleasant way! · Take part in Seasonal Events and win unique medals 
· View Statistics and track your progress
· Challenge yourself and figure out your mistakes, or enable Auto-Check to see your mistakes as you go
· Highlight duplicates to avoid repeating numbers in a row, column or block
· Express yourself with funny ninja stickers for iMessage!
Challenge your brain with Sudoku.com anywhere, anytime!

bluejetty:00150932:ios.summary: "Now, all your important health info is in one place, WellnessConnected. WellnessConnected gives you a complete view of your health combining the current line of three essential wellness devices connected to one easy to use app - A&D Connec
bluejetty:00150932:ios.description:
"Now, all your important health info is in one place, WellnessConnected. WellnessConnected gives you a complete view of your health combining the current line of three essential wellness devices connected to one easy to use app - A&D Connect. Lose weight, get in shape, monitor your blood pressure - all with one secure system from a trusted worldwide leader in connected health.
A&D Connect guides you through the easy device setup process and provides at-a-glance results, goals, and trends for you or your whole family. The app automatically connects to your account securely stored in the WellnessConnected cloud allowing you to sync to multiple mobile devices.
The WellnessConnected device suite consists of the Bluetooth Smart enabled A&D Deluxe Connected Blood Pressure Monitor and Weight Scale, as well as the LifeTrak family of activity monitors. We will be incorporating new sensors into our growing suite of supported devices so stay tuned.
Monitor Blood Pressure:
Manage your hypertension with instant indication, trending, and the ability to share results with your physician or family member. Gone are the days of manually recording your daily readings.
Lose Weight:
Track your calories burned, set goals and see your progress instantly with a daily weight history.
Improve Fitness:
Track your daily activity and heart rate. Monitor your sleep patterns to get more active, improve your rest, and feel better.
Share and Report:
Share with friends and family via Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram through your own. WellnessConnected account or a shared one for the family. Email reports to keep medical professionals informed about how you’re doing between office visits. 
Features:
 -Easy step-by-step device setup instructions.
 -Comprehensive dashboard provides at-a-glance info for all of your preferred devices.
 -Tap on the desired device in your dashboard to expose a more extensive view of your results, graphs, trends, and progress towards goals.
 -Set goals to help you keep moving forward towards your health and wellness objectives.
