bluejetty:00136305:ios.description:
Can you figure out what the gibberish really means?
Mad Babble is a hilarious word guessing game where nonsense phrases sound completely different when you say them out loud.
The rules are simple: read the strange phrase on screen, say it out loud a few times, and try to work out the real sentence hidden inside the gobbledygook. Some will click instantly. Others might have you repeating nonsense to yourself for minutes before the answer suddenly becomes obvious!
For example:
“PULL EASE LEAF MIA LONE”
Answer: “PLEASE LEAVE ME ALONE”
It sounds impossible at first, but once you hear it, you can’t unhear it!
Mad Babble is perfect whether you want a quick brain teaser by yourself or a fun game to play with friends and family. Take turns reading the phrases aloud, race to see who can solve them first, or simply work through the challenges at your own pace.
With 250+ phrases to decipher, there are plenty of funny, clever and frustrating challenges to keep you entertained. The difficulty varies throughout the game, so you’ll encounter everything from easy answers you spot immediately to much harder phrases that might require a hint.
TWO WAYS TO PLAY
1) Normal Mode
A fun collection of phrases suitable for players of all ages.
2) Adult Mode
Looking for something a little cheekier? Unlock Adult Mode for a spicier collection of phrases perfect for playing with friends.
FEATURES
• 250+ gibberish phrases to solve
• A mixture of easy, medium and challenging questions
• Hints available whenever you get stuck
• Normal and Adult game modes
• Simple and addictive gameplay
• Great for playing alone or with friends
• Perfect for parties, road trips and game nights
• Track your progress as you work through the questions
• Works offline, so no internet connection is required to play
• New challenges that will test how well you can hear through the nonsense
Mad Babble is easy to learn but surprisingly difficult to master. The trick is not to stare at the words for too long — say them out loud! The faster you read them, the easier it can be to hear the hidden phrase.
Think you’re good at word games, riddles and brain teasers? Put your ears to the test and see how many you can solve.
Download Mad Babble today and start guessing the gibberish!

bluejetty:00147319:ios.description:
About VTAlerts.  
This safety application is designed for the VTA bus and light rail system in Santa Clara County in California. The VTAlerts App offers riders a quick and discreet method for reporting safety concerns and suspicious activities directly to VTA Security or, in the event of an emergency, directly to police. Riders can send VTA security pictures, text messages, and locations of suspicious persons and/or activities making riding safer and more comfortable for all. 
  From the app home screen, riders have two easy options for contacting security: 
  1. The “Report a Problem” button allows riders to send text or photos directly to VTA Security. To ensure discretion, the camera flash is automatically disabled when photos are taken through the app. Riders can select station locations and report categories to assist VTA Security. Riders can also send reports anonymously if they choose. If you send a report in an area without cellular connectivity, it will be stored and sent when connectivity returns. The system is also designed to send the message before pictures so that VTA Security can get App reports as quickly as possible. 
2. The “Call 911” button will connect customers directly to the police.   
Additional Features 
  BOLO (Be On the Look Out) Alerts. BOLO Alerts on the See & Say App may display alerts from VTA Security about specific persons of interest. For example, VTAlerts may display information about a missing person or child, such as where they were last seen. If you see a person from a BOLO, immediately call 911 and send a App report to VTA Security discreetly.

bluejetty:00157140:ios.name: RoyalBook
bluejetty:00157140:ios.summary: Revolutionizing the barber industry, RoyalBook is an innovative social media booking platform designed to elevate the way barbers connect with their clients and manage appointments. Clients can easily book appointments directly in-app anyti
bluejetty:00157140:ios.description:
Revolutionizing the barber industry, RoyalBook is an innovative social media booking platform designed to elevate the way barbers connect with their clients and manage appointments. Clients can easily book appointments directly in-app anytime, anywhere.
‣ Dynamic Feed:
With RoyalBook, barbers can showcase their skills and talents through a dynamic feed. Share your stunning cuts, grooming techniques, and create a captivating online presence to attract a vast audience of potential clients. For clients, connect with more barbers near you and get the haircut you want. Want to find a specific barber, use the Find Barbers tab to search or populate barbers closest in distance from your current location.
‣ Seamless Appointment Management:
Gone are the days of confusing scheduling systems! RoyalBook simplifies the booking process for both barbers and clients. Set your availability, manage your appointments effortlessly, and ensure your chair is always filled with loyal customers. A client's appointment created a gap in your schedule? Simply drag and drop the appointment to a more convenient time and we will notify your client. And as you use RoyalBook, all clients booked with you over time will be saved in the connections folder for your convenience.
‣ Nationwide Reach:
Expand your clientele and reach a diverse audience from all corners of the country. With just a few taps, clients can easily find you, view your portfolio, and book appointments conveniently through the app. This platform's unique opportunity enables you to gain recognition and stay ahead in the competitive market. Share your custom profile link on Instagram and watch your bookings soar!
‣ Elevate Your Barber Business
Our team is dedicated to providing support and guidance every step of the way. We ensure you have the tools and resources to excel and thrive in the industry. We want barbers to charge premium rates for your outstanding services while enjoying the flexibility of living anywhere you desire.
We allow clients to pin a RoyalBook barber's post to their in-app profile as a reference for their next haircut. That along with haircut notes makes you not need to worry about what haircut to expect this client to ask for. And if you want an early consultation, just message the client directly with our in-app messaging system to get a better understanding.
Download RoyalBook now and embark on a transformative journey in the barber world. Embrace the future of barbering with RoyalBook today!

bluejetty:00086138:ios.summary: Playing Matreshka RP you can be whoever you want to be. Choose from various starting professions: miner, builder, logger, truck driver, or cash transporter. Want more? Join the police to protect the citizens, or choose the criminal path and
bluejetty:00086138:ios.description:
Playing Matreshka RP you can be whoever you want to be. Choose from various starting professions: miner, builder, logger, truck driver, or cash transporter. Want more? Join the police to protect the citizens, or choose the criminal path and become a part of a dangerous gang. But remember: every decision has consequences!
Dive into an online open world to explore and make it your own. Ready to claim it? Whether you’re shooting your way to the top or tearing up the streets in late-night races, the story is yours to write.
- A world shaped by your choices
The game’s realistic economy means your actions matter. Earn your way through trades, services, or... let’s say less-than-legal activities. Build a booming business, or risk it all with shady deals - it’s totally up to you!
- Hit the streets
In this city, you need a car. Upgrade the engine, add body kits, slap on custom paint jobs, wraps, and stickers - then show it off. Race, drift, or cruise through the city with your friends. Cars are a big deal in Matreshka RP, so make yours unforgettable.
- Squad up or go solo
Everything’s better with friends. Team up to create a family or gang, and run a business together. Take on challenges, write your story as a team and make some new friends along the way!
- We’re always improving
Our developers are all about the community. We listen to your feedback and regularly roll out updates with cool new features to keep things fresh and fun. Got an idea? Share it! Help us shape the future of Matreshka RP.
This is your space to live the life you’ve always wanted. Whether you’re exploring the city, joining events, or building your empire, Matreshka RP is the perfect place to start something new. 
Our reality is virtual, but it feels real!

bluejetty:00029364:ios.summary: AirDroid Cast is a cross-platform screen mirroring app. It offers seamless screen mirroring via USB / AirPlay / wireless local and remote network, for all devices, including iOS, ,Windows, and Mac. You can share up to 5 screens simultaneous
bluejetty:00029364:ios.description:
AirDroid Cast is a cross-platform screen mirroring app. It offers seamless screen mirroring via USB / AirPlay / wireless local and remote network, for all devices, including iOS, ,Windows, and Mac. You can share up to 5 screens simultaneously, and remote control the mobile is supported.
AirDroid Cast also has a web version: webcast.airdroid.com, enabling screen sharing to any browser without requiring installation on the receiving device.
>>>Key Features of AirDroid Cast 
-Cross-platform Screen Casting
This screencasting app is compatible with multiple systems, including iPhone, Windows, and Mac. Supporting screen mirroring from your iPhone/Mac/Windows to your computer or vice versa without hassle. 
-Connect Devices wirelessly or via a USB cable
This app offers you three distinct connection options: wireless, AirPlay, or USB cable. Connect your devices in a way that works best for you. 
-Mirror the Screen Remotely with Ease
AirDroid Cast also works seamlessly in remote networks, providing greater accessibility for remote collaboration. It enables you to effortlessly share your screen with colleagues from afar, making it easier to collaborate on projects, provide feedback, and make changes in real time.
-Control Mobile Devices from Computer
With its Control feature, you will fully control your iOS device (iPhone/iPad) screen from a laptop or computer. It helps to relax your hand by not having to hold your phone all the time.
AirDroid Cast supports casting a maximum of five devices onto a single screen simultaneously, making it ideal for businesses or individuals who need to multitask efficiently.
>>>Perfect for Various Screen Mirroring Occasions 
-Personal use 
-Business Meeting 
-Online class/Education 
-Live streaming 
-Movies/Sports video mirroring 
-Presentation 
-Gaming 
-Work from home 
>>> Payment 
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase 
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period 
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan 
- The user may manage subscriptions, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase 
- Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription 
> >>Feedback: 
For any further suggestions or questions, please feel free to contact us at support@airdroid.com
Privacy Policy: https://cast.airdroid.info/#/Privacy
EULA: https://cast.airdroid.info/#/Eula

bluejetty:00022109:ios.summary:
Beat Note — Drum Notation for Drummers, Teachers, and Content Creators

bluejetty:00022109:ios.description:
Beat Note — Drum Notation for Drummers, Teachers, and Content Creators
The fastest way to write, hear, practice, and share drum notation. Built by a drummer, for drummers.
FOR DRUMMERS — FROM YOUR HEAD TO THE PAGE IN SECONDS
You have a groove idea. Beat Note gets it down before you lose it.
Tap the sequencer grid to build beats. Watch them turn into clean, professional drum notation in real time. Hit play and hear exactly what you wrote — at any tempo, with a click track, on loop.
- Transcribe songs to check your ear and lock in what you hear
- Compose your own grooves, fills, and exercises from scratch
- Count in with a visual on-screen "1, 2, 3, 4" so your eyes and ears are ready together
- Use Beat Note as your in-ear metronome during rehearsals — your beats, not just clicks
"Been waiting a long time for an app like this. Clearly built by a drummer." — App Store review
FOR TEACHERS — WRITE IT, PLAY IT, SEND IT
What used to take 30 minutes in a desktop notation program now takes 2 minutes on your phone or iPad.
Write exercises on the fly — during the lesson, not after it. Play back the notation so students hear exactly how it should sound. Share a link so they can listen at home. Export a PDF they can print and bring to the kit.
- Use the sequencer as a live music whiteboard, in person or online
- Build a library of exercises organized by tag, ready for any student
- Send a shareable link or export a high-quality PDF in one tap
"What would normally take 30 minutes on a computer has become 2 minutes from my mobile device. My students love it." — App Store review
FOR CONTENT CREATORS — PROFESSIONAL NOTATION VIDEOS, IN MINUTES
Export your beat as an animated MP4 — portrait for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts, or landscape for YouTube and Vimeo. Choose 720p, 1080p, or 4K. Pick a color theme. Preview before you export.
PDF, PNG, WAV or AAC audio, shareable link, and animated MP4 — all from one app.
NOTATION THAT LOOKS RIGHT
Professional drum notation, consistent across every format you export. What you see on screen is what your students get in the PDF, what your followers see in the video, and what you hear in playback.
- All standard drums, cymbals, and articulations
- Subdivisions from 8th notes to 32nd notes, plus triplets, quintuplets (5s), and septuplets (7s)
- Common and compound time signatures, including 6/8, 9/8, and 12/8
- Linear, split hands/feet, or split drums/cymbals voicing
- Sticking annotations (R, L)
- Single-measure repeat symbol (%) — renders automatically when measures repeat
ORGANIZE AND DISCOVER
- Tags, search, and sort to manage your beat library
- Discover tab: curated educational beats for all skill levels
- Beat templates to get started fast
- Customize tempo, click track, count-in, and timer
MADE BY A DRUMMER, SHAPED BY THE COMMUNITY
Beat Note was built by me — an independent developer with 35+ years behind the kit. But the direction comes from the community. Every major feature on the roadmap has been voted on, requested, and refined by drummers, teachers, and creators just like you.
Join the conversation at roadmap.beat-note.app — vote on upcoming features, share ideas, and see what's coming next. I'm here to make sure it all comes together into something that actually works.
Premium subscription required for full access. Educator and Creator tiers available. Free trial included.
Payment is charged through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription auto-renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period via iTunes Account Settings.
Terms and Privacy Policy: https://www.beat-note.app/privacy-and-terms

NOTES

• This app is not affiliated with Synology.

• For CUSTOM, you have the privilege to add a custom date time of any period.
• For CURRENT format, it fetches the current timings from your iPhone/iPad.

• Only Free app to insert 4 stamps at a time on images.
• Only application to add an original timestamp to pre-captured photos.

Functionalities of Respective Stamps
- Date and Time
It is one of the most renowned stamps due to the fact that it has endless uses. Whether it's for birthday or anniversary you always strive to give your best shot capturing it. Inserting a Date and Timestamp on photos will preserve those adoring memories for you eternally.

- Add Text to Photo
This stamp facilitates you the functionality to insert taglines or captions on your photographs in the form of a Signature stamp.

It can also be utilized as a trademark and copyright stamp to shield your picture from cloning and counterfeiting.

Branding is the first thing if you want to establish authority and at the same time staying ahead of your competitors. 
With the help of Logo Watermark feature, you can easily add a logo on photos that you have already captured to create brand awareness. It can also be used to defend all your photos from any illegitimate use.
- GPS Geotagging
Quickly add a customized GPS Geotag stamp on your photographs of the location where they were snapped and make those memories eternal. Having a location tag on your photos from last get-away makes it easier to recognize and share. 
Geotagging is the best bet if you are celebrating holidays at an unknown place where even Google Satellites cannot track you!
Simply insert your custom location and you’re good to go!

bluejetty:00135661:android.description:
Lock screen live wallpaper - Lock screen by passcode - fingerprint - auto change wallpaper
Lock screen Live Wallpaper is a smart application that helps keep your privacy safe, preventing others from trying to illegally access your phone.
Lock Screen with key screen lock and integrated fingerprint screen lock, is extremely secured and is the best privacy protection for your phone nowadays
- A simple, easy to use screen lock application which is suitable for all ages
Feature:
- Create passcode to lock your phone
- Key lock screen with high-level encrypted 6-character password, extremely safe
- Add personality and flair to your device: Lock screen live wallpapers can be a great way to express your personal style and interests. There are a wide variety of wallpapers available, so you're sure to find one that you love.

- The lock screen integrates a fingerprint lock which increase the device protection
- Enhanced Visual Appeal: Lock Screen Live Wallpaper keeps your lock screen visually captivating, transforming your device into a canvas of stunning imagery.
- Personalized Experience: Tailor the wallpaper selection and update frequency to create a lock screen that perfectly reflects your unique style.

1. Enable lock: ON
2. Set up PIN - PASSCODE
3. Done!
With those extremely simple steps above, you have set up a lock screen to protect the privacy of your device.
After activating the lock, if you want to increase security and unlock faster, please activate the fingerprint lock.
Lock Screen is a completely free application, let’s install and set a screen lock to further protect your phone privacy.

bluejetty:00028699:ios.description:
Track the rocket launch schedule on Florida's Space Coast with Space Coast Launches. This app contains the schedule of rocket launches from the Kennedy Space Center and Cape Canaveral Space Force base from organizations like NASA, SpaceX, ULA and more with a clean and convenient user experience. Receive T-2 hour and T-5 minute launch notifications, live launch feeds, a map of popular viewing locations and rocket experiences on Florida's Space Coast, and much more.
Space Coast Launches will help you make the most of your rocket launch experience. 
This is your one-stop-shop for everything about rocket related in east Florida:
- Learn about all of the exciting upcoming launches from Kennedy Space Center and Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.
- Receive notifications for upcoming launches 24 hours and 5 minutes before countdown.
- Live stream rocket launches in the app.
- Access our exclusive "Ultimate Astronaut Itinerary" to learn about all the unique experiences on Florida's Space Coast that fuel your inner Space Nerd.
- Learn tips and FAQs for watching a launch while you're visiting Florida's Space Coast.
- Find the perfect viewing location with the interactive map.
- Use the AR compass to point you towards the correct launch pad so you don't miss a thing.
- Keep track of how many launches the Space Coast has had this year!

bluejetty:00032825:ios.name: AR Draw Sketch & Trace ©
bluejetty:00032825:ios.summary:
AR Draw Sketch is a creative drawing application for iPhone/iPad devices, using augmented reality (AR) technology to turn your ideas into unique works of art.
Convert all beautiful moments into unique works of art with the Draw Sketch app.
bluejetty:00032825:ios.description:
AR Draw Sketch is a creative drawing application for iPhone/iPad devices, using augmented reality (AR) technology to turn your ideas into unique works of art.
Convert all beautiful moments into unique works of art with the Draw Sketch app. With AR Draw Sketch, you can express your creativity through various key features:
* Sketch: Allows you to draw freely from real images. You can use your phone's camera to create freehand artwork from real-life images. Draw, sketch, and paint, bringing your artistic visions to life like never before.
* Draw on paper: Transfer an image into line work from a photo or artwork. You place your tracing paper over it and draw the lines that you see. This feature is very useful for beginners learning to draw, helping them practice basic skills such as line drawing, and perspective,...
* Video Recording: Capture your AR artwork in time by capturing snapshots of your creations. Share your unique sketches with friends and social media, showcasing the intersection of your imagination and the real world.
* You can learn from AR Draw Sketch to make art an immersive experience with many different drawing objects:
+ Animals
+ Anime
+ Chibi
+ Doodle
+ Butterfly
+ Learn to Draw
+ For kid 
+ Flowers
+ Nature
+ Vehicle
And more...
Advanced Features:
- Edge size: Adjust the edge size to make your strokes thicker
- Opacity: Make the drawing template more or less transparent
- Start with basic drawing exercises to familiarize yourself with the drawing tools. Experiment with different brushes, colors, and line styles.
* Easy to Use: AR Draw Sketch is designed for artists of all levels. The user-friendly interface ensures a seamless experience, allowing you to focus on your creativity without any technical hurdles.
AR Draw Sketch is an iOS application suitable for all ages, from beginners to professional artists.
-------------Using-------------:
1. Position the phone on a stable stand
2. Open the AR Draw Sketch & Trace app
3. Import or select photos from Art Gallery
4. Convert your photo into a contour sketch
5. Adjust the AR version of the image on canvas or paper
6. Create your own beautiful masterpieces
Try AR Draw Sketch today and explore the exciting world of creativity!
If you find AR Draw Sketch & Trace helpful, please rate us and share the app with your friends. Thank you!
Links to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy can be found below
https://sites.google.com/view/btb-ios-group/
ToS: https://sites.google.com/view/btb-ios-group-tos/

bluejetty:00039517:ios.description:
Number Book: Al-Kashif — identify unknown callers, block spam calls, and filter unwanted SMS before they disturb you.
Stop wondering who's calling. Number Book: Al-Kashif gives you instant caller ID for unknown numbers in Saudi Arabia, a powerful reverse phone lookup, spam call blocking, and a smart SMS filter — all in one app.
FEATURES
UNKNOWN CALLER ID
Instantly see the name behind incoming numbers you don't recognize. Know who's calling before you answer.
REVERSE PHONE LOOKUP
Search any phone number to find the owner's name. A fast reverse number lookup built for Saudi numbers.
SPAM CALL BLOCKING
Automatically block telemarketers, scammers, and nuisance callers so they never disturb you.
SMART SMS FILTER
Detect and filter spam and unwanted text messages before they clutter your inbox.
WHY NUMBER BOOK: AL-KASHIF
- Fast and accurate caller identification for Saudi Arabia
- Clean, simple interface in Arabic and English
- Works in the background so unknown callers are identified automatically
SUBSCRIPTION & PRICING
Number Book: Al-Kashif is free to download. Unlock the full experience with a premium subscription:
- 3-day free trial on the weekly plan
- $4.99 per week
- $29.99 per year
Prices may vary by region.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and turn off auto-renewal in your App Store account settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a submission.

Privacy Policy: https://prismlensapps.com/privacy

bluejetty:00071415:ios.summary:
Potatso is a Mihomo (Clash) compatible network proxy tool for iPhone and iPad. Import your servers or subscriptions, choose how your traffic is routed, and keep an eye on your connections.
== Multiple Proxy Protocols ==
Manage servers usin
bluejetty:00071415:ios.description:
Potatso is a Mihomo (Clash) compatible network proxy tool for iPhone and iPad. Import your servers or subscriptions, choose how your traffic is routed, and keep an eye on your connections.
== Multiple Proxy Protocols ==
Manage servers using Shadowsocks, ShadowsocksR, HTTP(S), SOCKS5 (including TLS), VLESS (including Reality), VMess, Trojan, Hysteria2, AnyTLS, and Snell.
== Imports and Subscriptions ==
Import through links, files, or QR codes, or add servers manually. Bring in supported servers, policy groups, rules, and DNS settings from Clash/Mihomo, V2Ray/Xray, and Surge configurations. Check the import preview for compatibility details.
Keep subscriptions and remote resources up to date with automatic updates, while retaining your local changes to subscribed configurations.
== Flexible Routing ==
Switch between Rule, Global, and Direct modes. Select nodes manually or let policy groups choose automatically. Add custom rules, install community rule sets, and manage GeoIP/GeoSite data to route traffic to suit your setup.
== Live Connection Details ==
See upload and download speeds, traffic charts, and active connections, including their matched rules and proxy chains.
== Custom DNS ==
Configure DNS servers and domain-based resolution policies, with support for DNS over HTTPS and DNS over TLS.
== Widgets and Quick Controls ==
Check connection status, control your connection, and switch between available nodes from Home Screen widgets. On iOS 18 and later, use the Control Center connection toggle.
== Potatso Pro ==
Pro lets you create multiple profiles, run node latency tests, and remove ads. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Prices are shown in the app.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and renewal is charged within 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings.
== Before You Connect ==
Potatso does not provide proxy servers. Use your own servers or an existing proxy subscription.
== Privacy Policy ==
https://www.potatso.com/docs/privacy
== Terms of Use ==
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
== Feedback and Support ==
hi@potatso.com

bluejetty:00153513:ios.description:
Step onto the field with PolyFootball and build your dream dynasty!
FAST ARCADE FOOTBALL
Pick it up in seconds, with plenty of depth when you want it.
• Drag to aim and release to throw, or tap with a second finger for a bullet pass into a tight window
• Swipe to slide in the pocket, juke defenders, dive for the line, or hold to truck through tacklers
• Play with a joystick or classic swipe controls
• Bone-rattling tackles, big hits that send helmets flying, and replays to relive them
• Kick into the wind, choose deep kickoffs or squibs, and return kicks and punts live
CAREER MODE
Create your player and start from nothing as a Quarterback, Running Back, Wide Receiver or Kicker.
• Play for the high school state title, earn scholarship offers and make your name in college
• Raise your draft stock at the Combine, ace the pre-draft interview and walk across the stage on draft night
• Earn your playing time by impressing your coach in practice and when your number is called
• Face the media in press conferences, sign sponsorship deals and negotiate your own contracts
• Test free agency, take workouts and tryouts, or ask for a trade
• Spend your earnings on a starter home, a suburban upgrade or a mansion with a garage, home gym, game room and trophy room
FRANCHISE MODE
Take control of your team's future and chase the ultimate prize - a PolyBowl.
• Make draft picks, scout prospects and develop your rookies
• Build multi-player trades, sign free agents and steal talent from other teams' practice squads
• Manage the salary cap with contracts, signing bonuses and early extensions
• Hire coordinators, handle injuries and keep your locker room happy
• Follow the league on Bitter, where fans react to every upset, trade and meltdown
MORE WAYS TO PLAY
• Exhibition: pick any matchup, or sit back and watch it play out
• Online: take on real players head to head
• Playbook Editor: design your own plays and call them in game (PolyFootball Pro)
UNLOCK AND CUSTOMIZE
• Footballs (some designed by PolyFootball fans!), fields and trails
• Touchdown celebrations
• Player upgrades and achievements
• Refer a Friend and earn rewards together
Whether you want to build a dynasty or become a legend, PolyFootball lets you leave your mark.

bluejetty:00073773:ios.description:
Smart Closet is a clean, smart and easy-to-use tool to help you manage your wardrobe and daily outfit.
It supports:
* Select clothing from thousands of brands/retailers and add them to your closet easily.
* Add your own clothes from picture or taking photo. 
* Auto-remove background of your clothes by one-click.
* Edit details for your clothes, including category, color, brand, price, season and more.
* Create your looks by combining your clothes freely.
* Get lots of random looks by your custom rules.
* Plan what to wear in your calendar. Get daily notification if need.
* Pack your clothing & looks for travel.
* Get detailed statistics result of your closet. Know your favorite color/brand/look.
============================
SmartCloset Pro Subscription options
============================
$0.99 per month
$9.99 per year
You can subscribe to get access to auto backup & sync on multiple devices feature within SmartCloset app.
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. 
You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
Terms of Use:
https://smartcloset.me/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00015038:ios.name: Bible Coloring Book for Kids
bluejetty:00015038:ios.summary: Bible Coloring Book for Kids is a truly free Christian Coloring and Bible Games app made especially for children. Kids can Color Bible pictures, play Memory Games and solve Jigsaw Puzzles while discovering stories about God, Jesus and the B
bluejetty:00015038:ios.description:
Bible Coloring Book for Kids is a truly free Christian Coloring and Bible Games app made especially for children. Kids can Color Bible pictures, play Memory Games and solve Jigsaw Puzzles while discovering stories about God, Jesus and the Bible!
The app includes beautiful Bible illustrations from the Old and New Testament and offers a calm, simple and child-friendly experience for families, churches, Sunday school, Bible school and children’s ministry.
## Bible Coloring, Memory and Puzzles
Children can enjoy three fun activities in one app:
* Coloring beautiful Bible scenes and Christian pictures
* Playing memory games with Bible-themed images
* Solving jigsaw puzzles with meaningful Christian illustrations
Each activity is designed to be simple, peaceful and enjoyable for kids.
## Made for Children and Families
Bible Coloring Book for Kids helps children learn about Bible stories in a joyful and creative way. While coloring and playing, children can discover Christian themes and create natural conversations with parents, grandparents and teachers about God, Jesus, faith, kindness, prayer and the Word of God.
The app is a great choice for:
* Christian families
* Parents and grandparents
* Sunday school
* Bible school
* Children’s ministry
* Church activities
* Quiet creative time at home
* Faith-based learning for kids
## Key Features
* Bible coloring pages for kids
* Beautiful pictures from the Old and New Testament
* Coloring, Memory and Jigsaw Puzzle games
* Freehand drawing mode with border protection
* Tap-to-fill coloring mode
* Erase mode and full page reset
* Save and share children’s artwork
* Relaxing background music
* Simple child-friendly interface
* No ads
* No in-app purchases
* Works on iPhone, iPad and iPod touch
## Benefits for Children
* Encourages creativity and imagination
* Helps improve focus and concentration
* Supports hand-eye coordination
* Helps develop fine motor skills
* Introduces children to Bible stories in a fun way
* Creates opportunities for conversations about faith
## Loved by Families and Churches
“Bible stories come alive. So much fun, yet educational.” — Diana deer
“My grandkids absolutely love this game. They play it every time they come to visit.” — TripleAMom2
“The kids at my church absolutely love coloring and learning about Jesus.” — KateyLynn'15
“Everything is so vibrant and colorful.” — Fher96
Download Bible Coloring Book for Kids and give children a joyful way to explore Bible stories through coloring, memory games and puzzles!

bluejetty:00069493:ios.description:

디자이너의 손길을 거친 듯 빛나는 작품으로 만들어 드립니다.
▼▼ 주요 기능 안내 ▼▼
1. 홈
- 영감을 주는 작가와 작품들로 더 다양하고 풍성해졌습니다.
2. 발견
- 원하는 글·작품·작가를 검색해 직접 탐색하거나 나의 취향에 맞는 글들을 추천받을 수도 있습니다. 로그인 전이라면 에디터 추천 글과 관심사 주제별 최신 글을 만나 보세요.
3. 라이브독서 & 독서노트
- 라이브독서로 하루의 독서 시간을 기록하고 차곡차곡 쌓아 보세요.
- 책을 읽는 동안 떠오른 생각과 문장은 독서노트에 남길 수 있습니다.
4. 구독 
- 마음을 사로잡은 작품과 작가를 구독하면 한곳에 모아 보실 수 있습니다.
5. 내 서랍 
- 최근 본 ・ 라이킷한 작품과 글을 다시 보고 싶다면 '내 서랍' 탭에서 꺼내 보세요. 작가 활동을 위한 글쓰기, 통계 등도 함께 관리할 수 있습니다.
6. 작가를 위한 초강력 '에디터' 그리고 '통계'
- 간단하지만 멋진 글 쓰기 및 커버 꾸미기
- 다양한 텍스트 스타일링과 자유롭게 배치하는 그룹이미지 만들기
- 26가지 필터와 자르기, 회전으로 간단하게 사진 꾸미기
- 느낌 있는 구분선, 시원한 사진과 동영상, 카카오톡 스티커 첨부
- PC와 모바일 앱 구분 없이 글 발행 및 편집 가능
- 글마다 제공되는 상세한 통계
- 실시간으로 알려주는 댓글/언급/인용/구독 알림
* 원활한 브런치 앱 사용을 위해 다음과 같은 접근권한을 요청합니다.
[선택 권한]
- 알림: 댓글, 구독 등 서비스 활동에 대한 새로운 소식 알림을 수신하기 위해 필요한 권한
- 사진: 이미지, 동영상을 첨부하기 위해 필요한 권한
- 카메라: 이미지, 동영상을 바로 촬영할 경우 필요한 권한
- 마이크: 동영상을 바로 촬영할 경우 필요한 권한
** 선택적 접근권한은 동의하지 않아도 앱을 사용하실 수 있습니다.

* 개인정보 처리방침 : https://www.kakao.com/policy/privacy?lang=ko

bluejetty:00177680:ios.description:
Inspirational and motivational quotes. Daily reminders to help you overcome adversity, persevere, achieve your goals, succeed. Start your day with a quote from our thoughtfully curated collection.
DAILY QUOTE WALLPAPERS
Meaningful photography and typography, hand-picked, and carefully combined to make quotes more impactful.
IMPORTANT: iPhone wallpapers are optimized for iPhone XS, iPhone XS Max, iPhone XR, iPhone X, iPhone 8 & iPhone 8 Plus, iPhone 7 & 7 Plus, iPhone 6s & 6s Plus!
AUDIO QUOTES 
Have quotes read aloud by Siri! From your lock screen! Get a “pick me up” whenever you need it with Audio Quotes.
Use a phrase, such as “Motivate me”, “Inspire me”, “Activate positivity”. Choose from different categories:
• The Quote of the Day
• Our Most Popular Quotes
• Inspirational Quotes
• Motivational Quotes
• Positive Mindset Quotes
• Success Quotes
Audio Quotes require an in-app purchase. See below for more details.
SIRI SHORTCUTS
In addition to Audio Quotes, you can personalize and add Siri Shortcuts for most essential features.
Why should you download the Daily Quote app?
• Downloaded and enjoyed by MILLIONS of people!
• Recognized as one of the "favorite gadgets" of former Girl Scouts CEO Anna Maria Chávez.
• Featured in Success Magazine article titled "A New You: Reinvent yourself with these apps"
Here are just a couple reviews we're proud of (and truly humbled by):
Amazing! by Sam.i.am
Amazing is only one word to describe this app. It always has meaningful quotes that really can push yourself to do better! I would definitely encourage people to get this app!
Works well by LolaBarbie
I had this app for about 3 years! Works well!
Daily Inspiration by 123becky
Love seeing my DailyQuote. They put hope for the day and motivate me with a positive attitude in facing each new day. Especially since I am handicapped living in pain every day. So I do look forward to my daily inspiration.
It's simple but helpful! by NickiBYU
I've had this app for over a year now and it's been great. No kinks or anything just a simple quote every morning to remind me of important ways to be that help me throughout the day. I love it!
FEATURES
Our goal is to provide motivational and inspirational quotes each day. 
• Set reminders to view your daily quote
• Save your favorite quotes
• Add hashtags to your favorite quotes so you can easily find them later
• Add quotes
• Set a custom background photo, or choose from our free collection
• Browse a mix of quotes from our collection
Create And Share
• Create quote wallpapers for uses as backgrounds and lock screen wallpapers
• Customize font size, font color, and layout, before saving or sharing 
• Add emoji or add additional text to quotes
• Select from custom background photos and background colors
• Easily share quotes on Instagram
"Create And Share" requires our companion app, QWP, which is also available as a free download. 
PREMIUM FEATURES
• Audio Quotes
• Quote Search
• Ad-free usage
Daily Quote is free to download and use. We also have premium features that require an in-app purchase. You can choose a single, one-time purchase, for lifetime access. Or you can purchase a yearly, or monthly, auto-renewing subscription. 
If you choose to subscribe, your subscription will automatically renew and charge your credit card through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited after purchase.
DailyQuote privacy policy: http://dailyqotd.com/privacy
DailyQuote terms of use: http://dailyqotd.com/user-agreement
We're grateful for your continuous support. If you have any questions or suggestions on how we can improve the app, please do not hesitate to contact us at http://dailyqotd.com/feedback

bluejetty:00046704:ios.summary: O CondoSócio vai muito além de uma ferramenta de gestão condominial. Ele é uma plataforma completa e integradora, desenvolvida para oferecer mais segurança, praticidade e eficiência na rotina de condomínios, moradores, visitantes e equipes
bluejetty:00046704:ios.description:
O CondoSócio vai muito além de uma ferramenta de gestão condominial. Ele é uma plataforma completa e integradora, desenvolvida para oferecer mais segurança, praticidade e eficiência na rotina de condomínios, moradores, visitantes e equipes de portaria.
Com recursos avançados de controle de acesso e integração com dispositivos de reconhecimento facial, o CondoSócio torna o processo de entrada e saída muito mais ágil, seguro e inteligente. A identificação e autorização de visitantes, prestadores de serviços e moradores acontecem de forma simples, fluida e confiável, reforçando a segurança e garantindo que apenas pessoas autorizadas tenham acesso ao condomínio.
Para os moradores, a experiência também está ainda melhor. Com poucos toques no aplicativo, é possível autorizar visitantes, acompanhar acessos, solicitar serviços, realizar reservas e interagir com as funcionalidades do condomínio de forma rápida e intuitiva.
E agora, com a nova atualização, o CondoSócio apresenta um novo estilo visual, mais moderno, organizado e agradável de usar, proporcionando uma navegação ainda mais clara e eficiente. Além disso, o app passa a contar também com o cadastro de pets, um novo recurso pensado para trazer mais praticidade ao dia a dia dos moradores e fortalecer a gestão das informações dentro do condomínio.
Essa evolução reforça o compromisso do CondoSócio em inovar continuamente, oferecendo soluções que unem tecnologia, segurança e comodidade em uma única plataforma. Mais do que acompanhar a rotina condominial, o aplicativo transforma a experiência de viver e administrar condomínios de forma mais inteligente, conectada e segura.

bluejetty:00063714:ios.description:
Do you love dogs? If yes, you’ll just love to play Merge Puppies! - DISCOVER about 100 new dog breeds 
- EXPLORE new interesting locations!
- DECORATE dog rooms, master your interior design skills and become a master of remodeling!
- FEED and take care of your pretty little cuties!
- FUN, easy and free-to-play game!

Every dog deserves to have a cozy home and a loving human! Giving love, shelter & care to our beloved and precious little furry friends is the least we can do! Saving one dog will not change the world, but surely for that one dog, the world will change forever!
Our puppies are waiting for you to join our cute magic adventure and start your exciting Merge Puppies: Pet rescue journey!

bluejetty:00026194:ios.description:
Distance Tool allows for quick and easy calculations to find distances between points on a map, including area calculations for non-overlapping polygons drawn. Includes metric (meters, kilometers) and imperial units (yards, miles, feet for altitude) for distances. Co-ordinates can either be displayed in decimal or degrees, meters and seconds.
Useful for mapping fields in agriculture, plots of land/home boundaries, or for general interest in distances and areas!
Functionality to drop a point at your current location (GPS or otherwise), and to email the results. Tap briefly to drop points anywhere on the map.
Share your drawing (shape) by email, which includes a file that can be opened on any device with Distance Tool.
Allows the standard map views of standard, satellite and hybrid.
Supports quick altitude calculation without data connectivity. Find out how high up you are! Or see the altitude of ANY point (requires data).
Freehand draw: Draw any shape on the map to quickly calculate area.
Follow Mode: Calculate distance or areas simply by moving!
Subscription terms:
- The subscription auto-renews at the end of each term.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy policy and Terms of Use: https://applorium.com/privacy-distance-tool

bluejetty:00018000:ios.summary: Highland Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by
bluejetty:00018000:ios.description:
Highland Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Highland Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes, and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Highland Bank app, you must be enrolled as a Highland Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and log in with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00179767:ios.description:
The Simple Repeater is committed to creating the best audio player and is an easy-to-use English reading software that makes learning more efficient and easier!
Added recording function for learning anytime and anywhere.
Added subtitle editing function, supports automatic sentence breaking, and speech recognition.
Added video playback, supporting video to audio conversion.

1. Variable speed MP3: Supports playback at 0.1-6.0 times speed and ensures sound quality.
2. Universal import function: Supports WIFI transmission and iTunes import.
3. Folder functions: folder creation, file movement, and deletion.
4. Document function: Supports viewing more than ten types of documents such as PDF, Word, Excel, PPT, etc., and supports opening them in the player interface for easy learning.
5. Subtitle lyrics files are automatically recognized and parsed, and subtitle text size and font can be set.
6. Support subtitle collection and playback.
7. AB Repeat: Carefully crafted AB interval repeat function, freely set to play unlimited repeat.
8. Fast forward/rewind: default 5-second fast forward/rewind and can be set separately.
9. Subtitles support switching between previous and next sentences.
10. Recording comparison: a powerful tool for learning English.
11. Large subtitle support.
12. Sleep timing.
13. Lock screen control and line control support.
14. Support video AB segmentation and saving, and support video to audio conversion.
15. Support intelligent audio segmentation, subtitle editing, and speech recognition.
Thank you all for your use and support. Welcome to provide valuable feedback!

Active work is underway to develop and improve gameplay. So write in the comments, what would you like to see in the next updates!

bluejetty:00175357:ios.summary:
RESALE IS EVERYWHERE. GOOD TASTE ISN'T.
Poshmark is a fashion marketplace where style comes alive through discovery, self-expression and human connection. On Poshmark, good taste is personal, shaped by millions of individual closets and the
bluejetty:00175357:ios.description:
RESALE IS EVERYWHERE. GOOD TASTE ISN'T.
Poshmark is a fashion marketplace where style comes alive through discovery, self-expression and human connection. On Poshmark, good taste is personal, shaped by millions of individual closets and the people behind them.
Shop and sell new and pre-owned clothing, shoes, handbags, jewelry, luxury fashion, home decor and more. From everyday staples and recognizable brands to vintage, sold-out and trending finds, discover distinctive style you won't see everywhere, all at better prices.
GET PARTY-READY
Find holiday dresses, party separates, evening bags, statement jewelry, shoes and coats for every plan on your calendar.
Shop real listings across a range of price points and find a look that feels like you for dinners, parties, travel and New Year's Eve.
DISCOVER WHAT FEELS LIKE YOU
Explore a personalized feed shaped by your style and activity. With new listings added every day across millions of closets, there is always another brand, style or unexpected find to discover.
See something you love? Use Posh Lens to search by photo and find similar styles across the marketplace in seconds.
GIFT GOOD TASTE
Good taste comes at every price on Poshmark. Shop curated Gift Guides by recipient, category and price point.
Find handbags, jewelry, accessories, home gifts and wishlist brands at better prices, along with distinctive pieces you can't find everywhere else.
Whether you're shopping for someone on your list or getting what you really wanted, Poshmark makes it easier to find something special within your budget.
SHOP POSH LIVE
Join Posh LIVE shopping shows to discover exclusive fashion finds, connect directly with sellers and shop deals in real time.
Explore LIVE Shows across fashion, luxury, accessories, home and more.
SELL IN MINUTES
List clothing, shoes, handbags and more in a few taps. Smart List AI can suggest a title and details, helping you get items ready to sell quickly.
Whether you're clearing space or earning toward what's next, the pieces you no longer wear have earning potential. Every new listing also gives someone else the chance to discover their next favorite find.
SHOP AND SELL WITH CONFIDENCE
Every order is backed by Posh Protect, with secure payments, tracked shipping and support available if something goes wrong.
Detailed listings, condition information and seller ratings help shoppers make informed decisions. Posh Authenticate is also available on eligible luxury items.
MILLIONS OF CLOSETS. ENDLESS POSSIBILITIES.
Every closet brings something different to Poshmark. Shop brands you love at better prices, discover styles you won't see everywhere or list something ready for its next owner.
Download Poshmark to shop, sell and discover what feels like you.

bluejetty:00120528:ios.name: REALITi
bluejetty:00120528:ios.summary:
REALITi is a new simulation ecosystem incorporating a realistic patient condition simulator and video review in a single system.
Starting with 2 iPads, REALITi is a highly advanced patient monitor simulator which mimics proprietary monitor
bluejetty:00120528:ios.description:
REALITi is a new simulation ecosystem incorporating a realistic patient condition simulator and video review in a single system.
Starting with 2 iPads, REALITi is a highly advanced patient monitor simulator which mimics proprietary monitors and defibrillators.
By expanding the system with more iPads, a complete in-situ simulator can be created.
Add REALITi Chart to use a simulated patient electronic medical record.
Add REALITi Camera to incorporate live audio video streaming with vital sign display. Optionally stream via AirPlay to Apple TV. Instant video review once the simulation has ended is built into the system.
Add REALITi Engage to allow observers to comment, vote and view media.
Features:
• Easy to use Dial and Button interface.
• Over 75 ECG waveforms
• Dynamic 12 lead ECG library.
• Comprehensive Radiology image library with over 250 images.
• Extensive and configurable laboratory results library.
• Simulate ectopics, sinus arrhythmia, artefacts and interference on the ECG with ease.
• Easy to use Checklist interface for simple student assessment.
• Easy scenario creation with single screen scenario running and editing.
• Many defibrillator and monitor screens included.
• CPR Feedback
• QCPR Screen
ATLAS ALS Manikin compatible

bluejetty:00169835:ios.description:
Live Translator is your reliable companion for translation, communication, and language learning. Whether you travel, study, learn a new language, or run a business, it provides you with powerful tools to overcome language barriers, communicate confidently, and expand your vocabulary. Translate in over 200 languages, learn new words with flashcards, practice with personalized learning materials, and track your progress, all in one app.
Main Features:
Voice Translation:
Communicate effortlessly using your voice. Simply speak naturally, and Live Translator will quickly recognize your speech and translate it into the desired language. It is a convenient way to get instant translations while traveling, working, studying, or communicating in everyday situations.
Language Learning:
Build your vocabulary and improve your language skills with interactive learning tools. Study words with flashcards, choose from different vocabulary categories based on your interests and goals, and track your learning progress over time. Practice with a variety of texts to learn new words in context and make language learning more engaging and effective.
Conversation:
Have real-time conversations in different languages and communicate more naturally. Live Translator helps both sides understand each other through a dynamic exchange of translated speech, making it easier to connect with people while traveling, at work, or in everyday life.
AI-Powered Translation Model:
Get fast and accurate translations powered by an advanced AI model. It takes the context of your text into account to provide more natural and precise results across over 200 languages, including less commonly used languages and dialects.
Text Translation:
Translate written text quickly and easily across over 200 languages. Enter or paste your text to understand messages, documents, websites, and other written content whenever you need it.
Camera Translation:
Translate the world around you using your camera. Point it at signs, menus, documents, or other printed text in a foreign language to quickly understand what you see without manually entering the text.
Camera AR Object Translation:
Use your camera to interact with objects around you and receive information in your preferred language. It provides a simple and visual way to explore your surroundings and understand unfamiliar objects.
We simplify communication and language learning, making both more intuitive and effective. Translate when you need to communicate, practice when you want to improve, and build your language skills at your own pace. Whether you're discovering new words or having real conversations, Live Translator helps you understand, learn, and connect with confidence.

bluejetty:00174173:ios.summary:
Empty is a simple and intuitive fasting tracker used for Intermittent, Circadian Rhythm, and Custom fasting. Choose your favorite fasting type and Empty will track and remind your ongoing progress. 
Empty supports the following fasting typ
bluejetty:00174173:ios.description:
Empty is a simple and intuitive fasting tracker used for Intermittent, Circadian Rhythm, and Custom fasting. Choose your favorite fasting type and Empty will track and remind your ongoing progress. 
Empty supports the following fasting types:
16-Hour Intermittent Fasting (16/8): Popularized by Hugh Jackman (Wolverine) as a efficient way to remove extra weight. 16/8 fasting means eating within a window of eight hours each day such as from 12pm to 8pm and not eating during the remaining 16 hours. It helps get us into the sweet metabolic state of fat burning called Ketosis.
Circadian Rhythm Fasting: Based on the research of Dr. Satchin Panda, the confining caloric consumption to about 12-hour period as people did just a century ago. It helps staving off high cholesterol, diabetes and obesity.
Custom Fasting: Setup a custom program to meet your fasting goals. You choose your fasting hours per day, and days per week.
Features:
+ Create Custom Fast
+ Smart Reminder (Remind you when your fasting completes even when the app is turn off)
+ Create your own custom alarms to fast
+ View the progress of the current fast
+ Show the full detail of your fasting days
+ Show the recent 7 fasts in chart and list
+ Get the average fasting time right in the Main Interface
+ Get the total hours of fasting in the Main Interface

bluejetty:00040573:ios.description:
Nutrilio is the ultimate calorie counter and macro tracker powered by AI, designed to make food tracking simple, fast, and effective. Take control of your health by snapping a quick photo of your meal, and Nutrilio’s advanced AI instantly calculates calories, macros (carbs, fats, and proteins), and more. Whether your goal is weight loss, muscle building, or simply improving your overall nutrition, Nutrilio is the perfect companion for achieving your goals.
Tracking what you eat has never been easier. Nutrilio’s AI-powered calorie counter allows you to analyze your meals in seconds, providing detailed insights into the nutritional content of your food. Forget the hassle of manually logging every ingredient—Nutrilio does it for you, so you can focus on building healthier habits.
Nutrilio is more than a calorie counter. It is a complete nutrition tracker designed for anyone who wants to monitor their diet, track macros, and achieve health goals. The app adapts to your lifestyle, providing valuable insights and trends that help you make better food choices every day.
WHY CHOOSE NUTRILIO?
Nutrilio combines powerful tools with simplicity to help you achieve your nutrition goals. Its AI-driven food tracker ensures fast, accurate calorie and macro tracking, making it easy for you to:
- Analyze meals and understand your calorie intake
- Track macros (carbs, fats, and proteins) for a balanced diet
- Set and monitor goals like weight loss, maintenance, or muscle gain
- Build sustainable habits with reminders and insights
HOW DOES NUTRILIO WORK?
1. Snap a photo of your food, and Nutrilio’s AI instantly analyzes the meal, calculating calories and providing a detailed macro breakdown.
2. Track additional factors like water intake, fasting hours, or fitness goals.
3. Set daily reminders to log meals, stay hydrated, and remain consistent with your goals.
4. Monitor your progress with intuitive charts and trends that highlight your calorie consumption and macro balance.
Nutrilio’s focus on macros makes it ideal for anyone following a diet that emphasizes carb, fat, and protein intake, whether it’s for weight loss, muscle building, or overall health improvement.
TOP FEATURES OF NUTRILIO:
- AI-powered calorie counter for quick and accurate food tracking
- Advanced macro tracker to analyze carbs, fats, and proteins
- Goal-setting tools to support weight loss, muscle gain, or balanced eating
- Water tracker and fasting reminders for complete nutrition monitoring
- Personalized insights to help you reflect on your eating habits and improve
ADDITIONAL FEATURES:
- Over 30 customizable categories for tracking food, water, fasting, and more
- Visualize your progress with charts and detailed trends
- Set hydration goals with the integrated water tracker
- Monitor your fasting hours to stay aligned with your diet plan
- Export your data for sharing with professionals or further analysis
Nutrilio stands out by combining the power of a calorie counter and macro tracker into one app. It helps you monitor not only calories but also the breakdown of carbs, fats, and proteins, giving you the full picture of your nutrition. Whether you want to lose weight, improve your diet, or maintain your current fitness level, Nutrilio makes tracking your food and nutrition effortless.
Nutrilio’s AI simplifies food analysis, allowing you to save time and focus on achieving your health goals. You can set personalized goals, track progress with charts, and gain valuable insights into your diet and habits. It’s the ultimate tool for staying on top of your health, whether you’re starting your journey or looking for advanced tracking features.
READY TO TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR DIET?
Nutrilio helps you track calories, monitor macros, and crush your nutrition goals. Download now and join thousands of users transforming their health with Nutrilio.

bluejetty:00148174:ios.description:
Tap.az – Azərbaycanda onlayn alqı-satqı üçün bir nömrəli pulsuz elanlar saytıdır! İstifadə etmədiyiniz əşyaları satın və ya arzuladığınız məhsulu ucuz qiymətə tapın. Hər bir elan minlərlə potensial müştəri tərəfindən dəyərləndirilir. Tap.az, Azərbaycan üzrə ən böyük elanlar bazasına malikdir. İstər yeni bir avtomobil, istərsə də ən son model iPhone axtarırsınızsa, doğru ünvandasınız.
Niyə Tap.az?
Asan və sürətli: Tətbiqdən istifadə çox rahatdır. Sadə interfeys və cəmi bir neçə kliklə qeydiyyat prosesi. Axtardığınız məhsulu rahat filtrlərlə anında tapmaq imkanınız var! Elan yerləşdirmək isə çox sadədir.
Sərfəli alış-veriş: Mağazalardan daha sərfəli təkliflər! Burada ikinci əl və yeni məhsulları ucuz qiymətə satın. Bir çox elan tamamilə pulsuz yerləşdirilir. Həmçinin gündəlik endirim və xüsusi təklifləri də izləməyi unutmayın.
Geniş kataloq və minlərlə təklif: Geniş kataloq sayəsində axtardığınız hər şeyi bir yerdə tapa bilərsiniz. Hər gün yenilənən minlərlə aktiv elanlar da sizi gözləyir.
Əsas kateqoriyalarımız:
Nəqliyyat
Xəyalınızdakı avtomobil burada. Hər büdcəyə uyğun yeni və işlənmiş maşın elanları. Nəqliyyat üçün ehtiyat hissələri və aksesuarlar bölməsində axtardığınız hər şeyi Tap.az-da tapın.
Daşınmaz əmlak 
Yeni bir ev və ya mənzil axtarırsınız? İstənilən növ daşınmaz əmlak burada satılır və ya kirayə verilir. Hər zövqə uyğun bina evləri və ya həyət evləri üçün Tap.az-a üz tutun.
Elektronika və məişət texnikası 
Ən son model Samsung və iPhone! Hər növ elektronika, telefonlar və məişət texnikası bir məkanda. Axtardığınız smartfon modelini asanlıqla tapın.
Ev və bağ üçün 
Evinizi yeniləmək üçün hər şey: mebel, dekor və bağ ləvazimatları. Bir sözlə, ev və bağ üçün müxtəlif kateqoriyalı məhsulları buradan alın.
Şəxsi əşyalar 
Qarderobunuzu yeniləyin! Dəbli geyim və aksesuar modelləri ilə tanış olun. Şəxsi əşyalar bölməsində hər zövqə uyğun məhsul çeşidləri ilə stilinizi yeniləyin.
Uşaq aləmi 
Hər yaşda uşaq üçün lazım olan müxtəlif əşya və məhsullar: geyim, oyuncaqlar, arabalar və s.
Heyvanlar 
Sevimli dostunuzu tapın və ya ona yeni sahib axtarın. Tap.az-da müxtəlif heyvanlar üçün qida və ləvazimatlar mövcuddur.
İş elanları və xidmətlər 
Karyeranızı bizimlə qurun! Hər gün yenilənən yüzlərlə iş elanları arasından özünüzə uyğun olanı seçin. Peşəkar xidmətlər və biznes təklifləri ilə yeni müştərilər qazanın. Sizin üçün uyğun iş mütləq tapılacaq.
Hobbi və asudə 
Asudə vaxtınızı daha maraqlı edin. İdman, musiqi, kolleksiya və səyahətlə bağlı olan elanları Tap.az-ın müvafiq bölməsində izləyin.
Mağazalar
Onlarla tanınmış mağazalar artıq Tap.az platformasında öz məhsullarını təklif edir. Brend məhsulları sərfəli qiymətə əldə edin.
Tap.az tətbiqini indi yükləyin və milyonlarla istifadəçidən ibarət böyük pulsuz elanlar platformasına qoşulun. Hər şey sizin üçün bir ünvanda!

bluejetty:00075966:ios.description:
Welcome to Winner, the best tournament manager and tournament organizer app.
With Winner, creating your dream tournament is just a few clicks away!
Try our tournament manager app now, it's free!
- Main Features -
- Fast tournament creation -
With Winner creating a tournament is fast and easy.
You can create multiple teams, multiple players or an entire match schedule with just a single click!
- Multiple sports types -
With Winner you can create a tournament for any sports type: 
football, soccer, basketball, tennis, cricket, ice hockey and many more.
- Multiple tournament formats -
With Winner setting your tournament format is easy.
You can choose from a predefined set of formats: league, cup, group stage, round robin, playoffs, series, knockout, single elimination bracket, double elimination bracket or create your own custom format.
- Match schedule -
With Winner you can create a match schedule for your tournament manually or randomly, and edit the match teams or players, date, time and location.
- Tournament sharing -
With Winner sharing your tournament is easy.
You can make your tournament public and let friends and family follow your tournament matches.
- Match events -
With Winner you can add events to your matches.
Goals, assists, penalty kicks, yellow cards, red cards and substitutions.
- Match venues -
With Winner you can set up your own match venues to host your tournament matches.
- Offline and online mode -
With Winner you can update your tournament from any place and at any time, even when you're offline!
- Customized logos for tournaments, teams and players (PRO) -
With Winner you can further customize your tournaments by setting custom logos and pictures for tournaments, teams, players and venues.
- Multiple admins -
With Winner you can set your tournament followers as admins. Admins can also update match results and help you manage your tournament easily.
- Winner PRO Auto-renewable Subscriptions -
Winner offers 3 different PRO subscriptions: 
• Bronze- 1 month (1.49$)
• Silver - 3 months (4.49$)
• Gold - 1 year (12.99$)
With Winner PRO you can: 
• Enjoy the app with no ads
• Create more tournaments, teams and players
• Customize the icons of tournaments, teams and players
• Edit the date, time and location of the matches
- Winner PRO Subscriptions Details - 
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

Winner is the app for you!

bluejetty:00123292:ios.description:
The Vermillion State Bank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Vermillion State Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Vermillion State Bank App, you must be enrolled as a Vermillion State Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00084110:ios.description:
Join Life Key, meet the future and become a better person! Here you will know that the future is in your own hands, and you can also meet the future yourself! Integrating psychological functions can help you explore yourself and discover your true inner world. Let's explore together!
//AI baby//
Have you tried the recently popular AI photos? Come and see what your mini version generated by AI looks like. The latest artificial intelligence technology analyzes facial features to accurately predict your AI baby's face. There are a large number of cute and cute templates in Life Key for you to choose from, and you can generate your AI baby photo with one click. Come and try it!
// Tongyan Time Machine
Do you miss the good childhood days? LifeKey Child Face Time Shuttle takes you back to your youth! Whether it’s childhood or youth, just click upload and you can become younger with one click. Come and share your young self with your friends~
// AI Lab
Do you want to know what your baby looks like? If you want to predict your cute baby in the future, just upload a photo of you and your partner, and select the baby's gender, and then you can see the baby's photo.
// Aging time machine
Take a ride on LifeKey’s fun time shuttle, along with the time shuttle, to see how you look when you grow old, see how much time has changed, and predict the secret of freezing age! You can choose photos of your family or friends. You can choose photos of your family and friends to see how everyone looks when they grow old.
// Fun test questions
LifeKey has a variety of psychological test questions, such as love, health, personality, family, workplace, interpersonal, etc. that the public cares about most, to explore their true heart from different angles.
Life Key offers auto-renewal subscription options：
*Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
*Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
*Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of renewal.
*Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
*Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.

Terms of service：http://resource.divinationlove.com/Lifekey/service.html

bluejetty:00014075:ios.name: EZO
bluejetty:00014075:ios.summary:
EZOfficeInventory is an asset tracking software designed to simplify
asset management, ensuring you know where your assets are and who they are assigned
to. Assign barcodes to assets and scan to check in and check out items. Minimize loss a
bluejetty:00014075:ios.description:
EZOfficeInventory is an asset tracking software designed to simplify
asset management, ensuring you know where your assets are and who they are assigned
to. Assign barcodes to assets and scan to check in and check out items. Minimize loss and
save time and effort! 
Its advanced inventory management features enable monitoring and tracking asset
movement in different locations and maintaining an accurate record of what’s where. Now
you can track assets throughout their lifecycle and also get real-time performance updates
so you know when to repair, refurbish, or retire assets. 
The EZOfficeInventory app provides actionable insights to empower your decision-making.
With reliable asset information, you can run assessment reports to identify bottlenecks and
eliminate inefficient practices. 
Key features:  
- Maintain a record of all critical item information through barcode scans, identification
numbers, and computerized AINs. 
- Use the availability calendar to view which items are available, checked out, and in
service. This helps with conflict-free reservations, scheduling service sessions, and
simplifying workflows. 
- Run automated purchase order management and ensure optimal stock levels at all
times. Manage costs, vendor details, and inventory in a centralized information hub.
- Enter locations and sub-locations and link them to relevant assets, asset stock, and
inventory. Easily track asset movements as soon as they are added to or checked
out of a location. 
- Maintain a history trail of all asset actions taken by users in EZOfficeInventory. 
- Cater to business requirements by using advanced customization in the app. Create
custom fields, rename items, and populate custom roles to accommodate your
workflows. 
- Experience easy fixed asset management. Calculate depreciation and receive
notifications every time an asset is about to expire to dispose of it on time. 
- Manage teams by assigning user roles, and associate them to assets for verified
custodianship. 
- Send out alerts for asset checkouts, member offboarding, service initiation, asset
retirement, and more to notify team members anywhere, anytime. 
About EZOfficeInventory
EZOfficeInventory is a powerful asset management software built to track and optimize your
physical assets. Easily control ownership, procurement, and service of all items across their
lifecycle and maintain reliable real-time data for asset operations. Achieve higher productivity
and efficiency!
EZOfficeInventory is the leading asset tracking software used by 1000s of businesses.
IMPORTANT: 
1. Requires an EZOfficeInventory (PAID) account. For details visit EZOfficeInventory webpage
2. Access to your Location is required for reporting geolocation of asset barcode scans

Never take notes again! Transform speech into text and notes in real-time with Record It—the revolutionary app that listens, understands, and organizes your world. Live AI Transcription
Capture every word in real-time during meetings, lectures, or conversations with industry-leading accuracy. Watch ideas transform into text as you speak, with no lag or interruptions.

Get instant feedback at any point in the live transcription, simply click on any text and have complex topics broken down or get told what to say in response.

Never miss a task! Record It detects commitments and deadlines in conversations, generating ready-to-share to-do lists for teams or personal use.
Easy Export
Access polished transcripts, summaries, and notes. Export and share directly to most major platforms.
PERFECT FOR
Professionals
Turn meetings into minutes instantly. Get real-time summaries, track decisions, and assign tasks before the discussion ends.
Students & Educators
Transform lectures into annotated notes with AI explanations. Review key concepts faster and study smarter.
Journalists & Researchers
Analyze interviews on-the-spot—identify themes, extract quotes, and generate draft outlines in seconds.
Creatives & Entrepreneurs
Capture ideas mid-flow and let AI expand them into actionable plans. Voice-to-text meets brainstorming brilliance.

bluejetty:00064886:ios.description:
First National customers – Now you can “bank where you are” with First National Mobile Banking. Fast and secure, plus the mobile app is free to download. Using your current Online Banking login information you can start mobile banking today.
Features:
Check account balances
View recent transactions
Transfer money between your accounts
Locate ATMs and Branch locations
Text Messaging available for:
BAL (Balance on all eligible accounts)
HIST (Review recent transactions on all eligible accounts)
**Standard text messaging and data usage charges may apply through your wireless carrier.
Security: At First National, protecting your personal information is our top priority. We use the latest technology to ensure security and confidentiality. As an added safeguard, access to mobile banking requires prior enrollment into First National’s Online Banking. 
For more information about First National’s commitment to online security and how you can sign up for Online Banking, please visit our website at www.fnblivingston.com.
To get started with Mobile Banking:
STEP ONE: Enroll in First National’s Online Banking at www.fnblivingston.com. If you are already enrolled proceed to STEP TWO.
STEP TWO: Download and install First National’s app. This app is available through the application store for your iPhone.
STEP THREE: Sign in to First National’s Mobile Banking using your Online Banking username. Make sure your security image and phrase are correct before entering your Online Banking password.
OPTIONAL: Once enrolled in Mobile Banking visit the Users Option tab in Online Banking to manage your mobile Banking Profile. 
This feature will allow you to:
Add additional phones
Change your phone number
Select or unselect accounts to see in Mobile Banking
Assign Nicknames for accounts to be used in Text Messaging
Set a different time zone
Compatible with: iPhone
First National Bank of Livingston was chartered in 1902 and has been delivering the finest service you will find anywhere in the banking industry. As we continue to grow with the community, be assured we will never outgrow our commitment to superior customer service. Our great staff combines with the latest technology to produce a banking experience that our customers have referred to as the best they have ever seen. If you are not already banking with us, give us a try. We think you will like it. For more information contact us at 800-324-9279 or visit our website at www.fnblivingston.com. Member FDIC.

apple-macos:486626129.name: Folder Tidy
apple-macos:486626129.description:
Continuously Featured on the Mac App Store for Over Six Years
Transform disorganized folders into neatly organized subfolders effortlessly. Choose from the 22 built-in rules or craft your own to sort files with precision. Leveraging multi-core processing, Folder Tidy swiftly manages even gigabytes of files.
ONE-CLICK ORGANIZATION
A single click swiftly tidies up cluttered files, relocating them into categorized subfolders—be it Pictures, Music, Spreadsheets, or Source Code. apple-itunes:1349015402.description:
SELPHY Photo Layout is an application that allows you to create/save layouts of images to be printed with SELPHY using images stored on your smartphone or tablet.
[Key Features]
- Connect your smartphone or tablet wirelessly with SELPHY printers and enjoy high-quality photo printing.
 ("Canon PRINT" must be installed separately for CP1300, CP1200, CP910, and CP900.)
- Easily print photos directly from the ‘Photos’ menu.
- Decorate and layout your photos freely with the ‘Collage’ menu before printing.
[Supported Products]
SELPHY CP Series
- CP1500, CP1300, CP1200, CP910, CP900*
SELPHY QX Series
- QX20, SQUARE QX10
[System requirement]
- iOS 17/18/26
- iPadOS 17/18/26
[Supported Images]
- JPEG, PNG, HEIF
[Supported Layouts / Functions ]
SELPHY CP Series
- Photos (Easily print an unmodified original photo)
- Collage (Have fun decorating or arranging multiple photos before you print)
- ID Photo (Print ID photos such as passport and driver’s license pictures from selfies.)
- Shuffle (Select up to 20 images, and they will be automatically arranged and printed on one sheet.)
- Custom Size (Print in any photo size)
- Tiling (split the photo into multiple tiles to print large)
- Snap a shot (Take a photo on the spot, decorate, and print)
- Bookmark (Print in a bookmark-style layout)
- Layout (Simply choose a photo to combine with a frame and print)
- Reprint (Print additional copies from your previously printed collection.)
- Collage Decoration Features (Include stamps, frames, text, paint tools, and embedded QR codes.)
- Pattern Overcoat Processing (Only for CP1500).
SELPHY QX Series
- Photos (Easily print an unmodified original photo)
- Collage (Have fun decorating or arranging multiple photos before you print)
- Custom Size (Print in any photo size)
- Snap a shot (Take a photo on the spot, decorate, and print)
- Layout (Simply choose a photo to combine with a frame and print)
- Reprint (Print additional copies from your previously printed collection.)
- Collage Decoration Features (Include stamps, frames, and text.)
- Pattern Overcoat Processing.
- Card & Square Hybrid Printing / Borderless & Bordered Printing (Only for QX20).
[Supported Paper Size]
- All available SELPHY-specific paper sizes for purchase *1
SELPHY CP Series
- Postcard Size
- L (3R) Size
- Card Size
SELPHY QX Series
- Square Sticker Paper for QX.
- Card Sticker Paper for QX (Only for QX20).
*1: availability may differ depending on region.
[Important Notes]
- If application does not operate properly, try again after shutting down the application.
- Features and services available in this application may differ depending on the model, country or region, and environment.
- Visit your local Canon Web pages for more details.
* CP900 does not support printing in ad-hoc mode with "Canon Print". Please use it in infrastructure mode.
